Om os

Akvariefisk, ulveskov og hverdagspædagogik er nogle af de ting, som findes i Børnehuset Derudá, hvor vi leder efter en pædagog til vores vuggestue nærmere bestemt Den Grønne Gren.

Her vil blandt andet David og Lene være dine nærmeste kollegaer. De er blandt meget andet 100 meter mestre i organisering, og har godt styr på overblikket. De er også meget åbne for dine idéer, hvis du har noget, som du brænder for pædagogisk.

Vi er et stort hus med med mulighed for åbne døre, men også med plads til ro og fordybelse bag en lukket dør til små grupper og større fællesskaber. Vi er både fælles og hver for sig.

Vi har en meget stor legeplads, hvor vuggestuen og børnehaven færdes frit. Her er svævebane, bålplads og et utal af krat, træer og gemmesteder til børnene.

Husets hjerte er køkkenfællesrummet, der binder vuggestuen og børnehaven sammen. Hver afdeling har også eget fællesrum, som vi i vuggestuen bruger til leg, musik og bevægelse.

Vuggestuen består af tre stuer (Orange Scene, Blåhvalen og Den Grønne Gren) med 11 børn på hver stue. Der går en hæk ned gennem vores legeplads, og ud fra hver vuggestue er der en lille gårdhave, hvor man bedre kan lave en afgrænset pædagogisk aktivitet. 

Vi tilbyder 

  • En arbejdsplads der vægter høj faglighed og sætter kerneopgaven i fokus. 
  • Tid til faglig sparring, refleksion og udvikling.
  • En medarbejdergruppe som er optaget af at evaluere på egen praksis og skabe endnu bedre lege- og læringsmiljøer.
  • En vuggestue, hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på strukturen og aktiviteter og være med til at udvikle praksis. 
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af huset. 
  • En masse dejlige børn og familier.
  • Koncentration i arbejdet med dagtilbud for alle og fokus på refleksion og evalueringskultur.
  • En fastansat sprogkonsulent i dagtilbuddet, som vi sparrer meget med.
  • Mulighed for at skifte stue eller afdeling, hvis opgaven kalder på det, eller man har ønske om det.
  • Opbakning til kurser og efteruddannelser.

Vi synes, det er fedt hvis du:

  • Formår at skabe gode læringsmiljøer og deltagelsesmuligheder for børnene og altid har fokus på kerneopgaven og barnets perspektiv – både det enkelte barn og fællesskabet.
  • Interesserer dig for børnenes intentioner og møder dem anerkendende og åbent samt er nysgerrig på, hvad der ligger bag deres handlinger.
  • Aktivt medvirker til udvikling, planlægning, gennemføring, evaluering og dokumentering af pædagogiske forløb.
  • Kan bringe dig selv i spil, gå forrest og give følgeskab, i dagligdagen og i samarbejdet med kollegaer og forældre.
  • Kan lide at lege og forstår vigtigheden af voksen indlevelse og deltagelse i børns leg.
  • Kan kommunikere professionelt med forældre, kollegaer og ledelse og ønsker at sparre, så vi sikrer god kvalitet.  
  • Er smilende og imødekommende, og at du er bevidst om, at du er en vigtig rollemodel i mange forskellige sammenhænge.

Ansøgning

Vi er ikke så vilde med traditionelle ansøgninger, og måske er du heller ikke. Derfor ønsker vi, at du sender et dokument, hvor du svarer på disse 5 spørgsmål. Svarene vil give os et bedre indblik i dig som pædagog og din faglighed.

  1. Fortæl om et barn, du havde svært ved at skabe relation til. Hvad gjorde du? Og hvad lærte du?
  2. Hvad er god pædagogik i en vuggestue efter din mening?
  3. Hvordan balancerer du omsorg og tydelige rammer?
  4. Hvilken rolle mener du, den voksen skal have i børns leg?
  5. Fortæl om noget, du har ændret mening om i dit pædagogiske arbejde gennem tiden og hvorfor. 

Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansættelsen er pr. 1. oktober 2026 men også gerne før.

Ansøgningsfrist:  14. august 2026
 
Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen
  
Ugentligt timetal: 37

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Kan du se dig selv i noget af ovenstående, eller har du nogle spørgsmål? Så er du velkommen til at kontakte pædagogisk leder Mette Hornemann på 23 37 20 27 eller på hornemann@aarhus.dk. Du kan også kontakte David – der er pædagog på Den Grønne Gren på 21266592.

Se mere om os på vores hjemmeside Børnehuset Derudá

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.   

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager to ICARS Would you like to be part of an international institution with highly skilled colleagues from more than 20 different countries? Would you like to join a purpose-driven institution contributing to global health and development where you will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen the support functions as we continue to grow and mature as an organisation? Then you may be our new Finance Manager.

This is a full-time position available as soon as possible.



About ICARS

ICARS is an autonomous, self-governing, non-profit organization, international in character, established by the Danish Government and overseen by the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs. ICARS receives funding from the Danish Government and other institutional donors and foundations and supports low- and middle-income countries in developing solutions to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation.

With an annual budget is around 100m DKK, 50+ FTE’s, more than 70 projects across 30+ countries, a growing global footprint, and increasing organisational complexity, the Finance Team plays a crucial role in the management of all financial aspects of ICARS’ projects and running ICARS as an organization.



We offer

We offer an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing team that is developing the scientific and organisational foundation of ICARS. Our team is composed of enthusiastic international pioneers from across the globe that all believe in ICARS’ mission and are highly motivated to ensure its success.

We are based at Statens Serum Institute in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Please visit www.icars-global.org for more information.



About the position

As an experienced Finance Manager, you will have overall professional responsibility for ICARS’ financial management, budgeting, reporting, annual and project auditing to ensure that ICARS meets all accounting and reporting requirements from funders. Furthermore, you are responsible for maintaining and further developing efficient work processes and promoting the effective use of IT systems and digital tools to support operational excellence.

While the role does not have direct people management responsibilities, it is expected to provide strong professional leadership by acting as a trusted sparring partner and subject matter expert for the team. The Finance team consists of 3.5 FTEs working closely together to ensure the effective delivery of financial services across the organisation.



Your main tasks

  • Take overall professional responsibility for ICARS’ financial accounting and ensure complete, accurate and timely financial records.
  • Lead preparation of ICARS’ annual organisational budget and consolidated project portfolio budget.
  • Lead the monthly, quarterly and year-end closing processes and the liaison with the auditors.
  • Prepare forecasting, financial analysis and reporting to the management and the board.
  • Coordinate and quality-assure finance activities and provide professional guidance to other finance and operations staff.
  • Advise budget holders and project managers on financial performance, risks and required actions, and ensure quality reporting according to donor requirements.
  • Act as functional owner of ICARS’ financial systems, reporting structures and finance data, including Navision Stat, Business Central.
  • Further develop and continuously improve ICARS financial reporting system, financial management structures, digital tools and automation.


Your background, professional and personal qualifications

We expect that you hold a degree in finances, economics, accounting or equivalent. It will be considered an advantage, if you have worked in an institution administrating funds from multiple donors, including the Danish government.

Professional qualifications

  • At least 3 years of proven success in a similar role.
  • Relevant professional experience in leading financial accounting, financial management and audit, including independent responsibility for financial closing, reporting or audit processes.
  • Understanding of Danish public-sector financial management, preferably gained in a Danish state institution, a self-governing institution or an organisation working closely with Danish government authorities.
  • Assuring compliance with regulations, standards and requirements associated with budgeting, financial reporting, grants and project administration.
  • Experience with international operations, foreign currency management, and partner-managed grants is an advantage.
  • Strong practical experience with Navision Stat, NAV, Business Central and associated state systems (SDI, RejsUd etc) or similar systems. Advanced Excel skills and the ability to develop useful financial analyses and reports.
  • Experience and interest in adopting AI to increase efficiency in finance controlling environment.
Personal qualifications

  • Excellent organisational skills with demonstrated ability to successfully manage competing priorities.
  • Combine strong attention to detail and accuracy with the ability to maintain an overview of the organisation’s overall financial position.
  • Work systematically, meet demanding deadlines and plan effectively around reporting and audit cycles.
  • Can explain complex financial matters clearly to colleagues without a finance background.
  • Ability to build strong relationships and good collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Interested in improving processes, systems and the use of data and automation in finance.
  • Proficiency in English (English is our working language). As you will be collaborating with Danish partners, experience in Danish will also be considered an advantage.


Terms of employment

This is a full-time position available as soon as possible.

Salary and appointment terms will be based on the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the recognised negotiating organisations, depending on the candidate’s educational background. We expect the position to be classified at the level of chief consultant (Chefkonsulent) according to the AC Collective Agreement.

For non-Danish citizens living outside Denmark, relocation is a requirement. In this case a monthly relocation supplement and a relocation package consisting of a lumpsum and administrative assistance by settling in Denmark is added to your salary.

Please note that your total income is subject to taxation according to ordinary Danish tax rules and not under special beneficial tax schemes.



Further information

For further information about the position, please contact Executive Director Helle Engslund Krarup, at +45 24852974.



Application and recruitment process

Press “apply for the position” and submit your CV and relevant diplomas along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and motivation for applying no later than August 17th, 2026, at 23.59.

title: PhD Stipend in Dynamic Modelling, Simulation and Optimization of Power-to-X Processes
description:
Aalborg University, Department of Energy, Campus Esbjerg, invites applications for a three-year PhD Stipend from October 1st or soon hereafter in dynamic modelling, simulation and optimization of Power-to-X processes for renewable fuel production. The project is primarily rooted in process engineering while also addressing the interaction between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid. You will contribute to interdisciplinary research spanning process engineering, power engineering and sustainable energy systems and help develop future large-scale Power-to-X solutions.

Your work tasks
In this PhD fellowship at AAU Energy, you will work with dynamic modeling, simulation and optimization of Power-to-X processes for renewable fuel production, such as green methanol and sustainable aviation fuel produced through Fischer–Tropsch and methanol-to-jet pathways. The project primarily focuses on the process-engineering aspects of renewable fuel production, with particular emphasis on the interactions among the electrical grid, electrolysers, fuel-synthesis processes, energy storage and heat integration in integrated Power-to-X systems.

You will develop and apply physics-based process models that describe the behavior of Power-to-X plants under varying operating conditions. This includes modelling electrolysers, fuel-synthesis units and supporting energy-system components and analyzing how these systems can operate efficiently and flexibly in response to fluctuations in renewable electricity generation, energy prices and wider energy-system conditions. The work will combine process simulation with operational optimization, techno-economic assessment and model validation.

The research will also examine the coordinated operation and control of Power-to-X processes, electrolysers and energy-storage systems in interaction with the electrical grid. You will contribute to research on grid-supporting operation and control strategies for integrated Power-to-X plants.

You will carry out your research in close collaboration with academic and industrialpartners in Denmark and across Europe. The position includes, among others, preparing scientific publications, presenting results at conferences and workshops, and participating in project meetings and activities. You will also make a limited contribution to teaching or supervision at Aalborg University, for example by supervising bachelor’s and master’s students working on relevant topics.

Your competencies 
You have, or are about to obtain, a master’s degree in chemical engineering, process engineering, mechanical engineering, energy engineering, sustainable energy engineering or a closely related field. You bring a solid foundation in areas such as process modelling, thermodynamics, heat and mass transfer, process dynamics and control, optimization or energy-system analysis, and you are interested in applying these disciplines to Power-to-X and renewable fuel production.

You have experience with process-modelling tools such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS or other related software and are motivated to develop and apply dynamic models of energy and chemical processes. You are familiar with programming languages and computational tools. Expertise in a particular software package is not required, but experience with one or more computational environments, such as MATLAB, Python or similar tools, will support your work in the project. Knowledge of Power-to-X, electrolysis, renewable fuels, process integration or energy storage will be advantageous.

Knowledge of electrical power systems, electricity markets, grid integration or the control of grid-connected energy systems would strengthen your profile but is not a requirement for the position. The core academic profile sought is within process engineering or a related discipline. You should have an interest in and motivation to learn about the interaction between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid, including how process-level operation and control affect plant flexibility and system-level performance.

You are able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research environment. You enjoy collaborating with colleagues and external partners and are comfortable discussing technical ideas across disciplinary boundaries.
You have good analytical abilities, scientific curiosity, and the ability to document and communicate your work clearly in writing and presentations. You have strong written and spoken English skills suitable for scientific collaboration and publication. We value your motivation and potential to develop across disciplines, and you are not expected to have prior expertise in every aspect of the project from the outset.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
You will join the Fluid & Process research group at AAU Energy, Campus Esbjerg, where you will become part of an international and interdisciplinary research environment combining process, chemical, energy, and electrical engineering. The group works with modeling, simulation, control, optimization, and experimental validation of fluid and energy systems, with applications including Power-to-X, carbon capture and utilization, green fuels, and sector coupling. The working culture is collaborative and informal, with close interaction among academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, PhD fellows, and students. We share an ambition to contribute to the green transition through research with practical relevance.

At Campus Esbjerg, you will work alongside academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, and PhD fellows across a range of energy-related disciplines. The campus setting supports close day-to-day collaboration across disciplines and research projects.

Collaboration with industry is an important part of the research environment, and many research and student projects are developed with external partners to address real-world engineering challenges. We aim to provide a supportive working environment with a healthy balance between professional commitments and life outside work.

The fellowship offers strong opportunities for professional and academic development.
As part of the three-year PhD program, you will conduct independent research under supervision and complete PhD courses corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS.
Courses may be taken at Aalborg University or other relevant institutions in Denmark and abroad. You will have opportunities to participate in specialized courses, summer schools, international conferences, and project workshops. The position will also provide experience in scientific publishing, research dissemination, teaching or student supervision, interdisciplinary project work, and collaboration with industrial partners.

AAU Energy offers access to modern experimental and computational facilities supporting research in sustainable energy systems. At Campus Esbjerg, these include facilities for thermal and fluid processes, electrical engineering, power electronics, renewable-energy control, offshore energy systems, and Power-to-X.

The research environment is being further strengthened through the C-TECH initiative, which is establishing a modular test site for carbon capture, electrolysis, and methanol synthesis at Campus Esbjerg. The facility is intended to support research, education, and industrial collaboration in Power-to-X and carbon capture, utilization, and storage. This creates an attractive setting for a PhD project connecting process modeling with industrial validation and integrated sustainable-energy systems.

Campus Esbjerg is located in one of Denmark’s major energy and offshore hubs, providing favorable conditions for collaboration with companies involved in renewable energy, Power-to-X, offshore technologies, and the wider energy transition. The relatively compact campus supports close professional relationships, close interaction with supervisors and colleagues, and collaboration across research and educational activities.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (4-5 pages), that:
    describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives.
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
When pursuing a PhD at Aalborg University, you'll receive a stipend which includes both salary
and pension benefits. The base salary starts at a minimum of 31.242,75 DKK before taxes, with an
additional 18,07% added for pension contributions. However, the final salary can be negotiated
based on your qualifications and experience, with seniority playing a key role in determining the
main salary.
Read more about pension options here.

At Aalborg University's Doctoral School, engineering PhD students enjoy unique career
development opportunities. These include personalized DISC profile assessments with feedback,
career-focused courses, and networking events with trade unions, employers, and other relevant
parties. Learn more about these initiatives at our Career Hub.

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish).

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (in Danish) 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: Medarbejder søges til entreprenørarbejde

title: Lead Data Engineer (m/w/d) (Data Engineer)
description:
Als **Lead Data Engineer (m/w/d)** verbindest du hands-on Engineering mit technischer Führung und prägst die Weiterentwicklung unseres Databricks-basierten Datenökosystems. Du spielst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenplattform. Du arbeitest eng mit Engineers, Architekt:innen, Product Ownern und Business-Stakeholdern zusammen und triffst technische Entscheidungen, die sowohl kurzfristige Anforderungen als auch langfristige strategische Ziele unterstützen. Du verstehst, wie die Arbeit des Engineering-Teams zu konkreten Geschäftsergebnissen beiträgt.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für das Data-Engineering-Team und prägst maßgeblich die technische Ausrichtung unserer Data-Engineering-Praktiken im gesamten Unternehmen. Du schreibst Code, definierst Standards und unterstützt sowie coachst andere Engineers. Gleichzeitig bist du die zentrale technische Eskalationsstelle für komplexe Herausforderungen.

Zu deinen Kernaufgaben gehören:

- Die Leitung von Design, Entwicklung und Optimierung von Data-Lösungen im Enterprise-Maßstab auf Databricks
- Die Konzeption und Implementierung skalierbarer Data-Ingestion-Frameworks für Batch- und Streaming-Workloads
- Die Verantwortung für Databricks Asset Bundles / Declarative Automation Bundles, Deployment-Pipelines und Multi-Environment-Konfigurationen
- Die Steuerung von Data-Governance-Initiativen über Unity Catalog, inklusive Access Management, Storage Credentials und Metadatenverwaltung
- Die Definition und Pflege von Engineering-Standards wie Coding Practices, Code Reviews, Dokumentation und Data-Quality-Frameworks
- Das Coaching anderer Data Engineers sowie die Übernahme der technischen Eskalation bei komplexen Herausforderungen

Profil

Du bist eine **hands-on technische Führungskraft (m/w/d)** mit umfassender Databricks-Erfahrung. Du denkst über die unmittelbare Aufgabe hinaus, hast die gesamte Plattform im Blick und triffst Architekturentscheidungen mit Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit und langfristige Datenstrategie. Du verstehst die Verbindung zwischen Engineering-Output und Business-Impact und findest die Balance zwischen schneller Lieferung und nachhaltiger Governance.

Wir stellen uns vor, dass du:

- Umfassende praktische Erfahrung mit produktionsreifen Databricks-Lösungen hast
- Sehr sicher in Python, PySpark und SQL bist – inklusive komplexer Transformationen, Performanceoptimierung und Query-Design
- Erfahrung im Design von Databricks Asset Bundles und im Deployment über mehrere Umgebungen hinweg mitbringst
- Fundiertes Wissen über Unity Catalog, Data Governance, Access Control und Best Practices im Datenmanagement besitzt
- CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps oder ähnlichen Technologien aufgebaut und betrieben hast
- Architekturentscheidungen und technische Trade-offs klar und verständlich kommunizieren kannst – sowohl technisch als auch nicht-technisch - auf Deutsch und Englisch

Zusätzlich von Vorteil sind:

- Erfahrung mit Databricks AI/BI Dashboards, Genie oder Semantic Layer Design
- Kenntnisse im Azure Identity- und Secrets-Management, z. B. Entra ID, OIDC Federation und Azure Key Vault
- Erfahrung darin, GDPR- und Vertraulichkeitsanforderungen in Data-Engineering-Lösungen zu integrieren

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG wirst du Teil einer ambitionierten und kollaborativen Organisation, in der Daten eine immer wichtigere Rolle für Innovation und geschäftlichen Mehrwert spielen. Du erhältst die Chance, unsere moderne Datenplattform aktiv mitzugestalten und an strategischen Initiativen im gesamten Unternehmen mitzuwirken.

Wir bieten dir ein flexibles und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld mit hervorragenden Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung, zum Wissensaustausch und zum beruflichen Wachstum. Dich erwartet eine Kultur, die von Zusammenarbeit, Vertrauen und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung geprägt ist.

Kontakt

title: Integration Developer (m/w/d) (Informatiker/in)
description:
Möchtest du eine Schlüsselrolle in einem der größten und ambitioniertesten Unternehmen Dänemarks übernehmen – in einem eingespielten Integrationsteam, in dem du Verantwortung, Freiheit und echten Einfluss darauf erhältst, wie DLG sein digitales Geschäft in ganz Europa vernetzt?

In der DLG Group IT bringen wir Business und Technologie zusammen. Wir entwerfen, entwickeln und implementieren Integrationen, die Systeme über DLG und unsere europäischen Tochtergesellschaften hinweg nahtlos miteinander verbinden. Wir erweitern unser Team und suchen einen Integration Developer (m/w/d), der leidenschaftlich gerne elegante, effiziente und zukunftssichere Lösungen entwickelt.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

DLG befindet sich mitten in einer spannenden digitalen Transformation. Unsere hybride Integrationsplattform, aufgebaut auf SAP und Microsoft Azure, unterstützt unter anderem ReGen, ein strategisches Transformationsprogramm, in dem Daten, Automatisierung und Innovation Hand in Hand gehen.

Wir entwickeln aktiv unseren Digital Integration Hub weiter und bewegen uns in Richtung einer stärker ereignisgesteuerten Architektur. Als Integration Developer wirst du Teil des Teams, das diese Vision Realität werden lässt – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, Business-Stakeholdern und Tochtergesellschaften in ganz Europa.

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business und Technologie und gestaltest mit, wie Daten und Prozesse innerhalb der DLG fließen. Deine Hauptaufgaben umfassen:

- Design, Entwicklung und Implementierung von End-to-End‑Integrationen, die Systeme miteinander verbinden
- Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung des Digital Integration Hub sowie an ereignisgesteuerten Integrationsmustern
- Technischer Sparringspartner für Projekte und Tochtergesellschaften in der gesamten Organisation
- Mitgestaltung und Nutzung von KI‑gestützten Funktionen innerhalb der Integrationslandschaft

Profil

Du arbeitest gerne an der Schnittstelle von Technologie und Business und möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, in dem Integrationen eine zentrale Rolle bei der digitalen Transformation einer internationalen Organisation spielen. In dieser Rolle bringst du sowohl technisches Verständnis als auch eine kollaborative Arbeitsweise mit.

Wir stellen uns vor, dass du Folgendes mitbringst:

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Integrationsentwicklung oder in vergleichbaren Rollen
- Erfahrung mit dem Microsoft‑Azure‑Integrationsstack oder der SAP Integration Suite – und die Motivation, deine Kompetenzen weiter auszubauen
- Sicherheit darin, Geschäftsanforderungen in technische Lösungen zu übersetzen
- Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Stakeholdern
- Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse, in Wort und Schrift

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG wirst du Teil eines kleinen, starken Integrationsteams, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Professionalität und Einfluss Hand in Hand gehen. Du bist weder ein kleines Zahnrad in einer großen Maschine, noch wirst du mit Verantwortung allein gelassen. Stattdessen arbeitest du eng mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen und spielst eine zentrale Rolle dabei, Systeme, Daten und Geschäftsprozesse in einer internationalen Unternehmensgruppe zu verbinden.

Wir bieten dir eine Rolle mit einer engen Verbindung zwischen Ideen und Umsetzung – in einem Umfeld, in dem Neugier, Feedback und Wissensaustausch zum Arbeitsalltag gehören. Konkret kannst du dich auf Folgendes freuen:

- Ein eingespieltes Team engagierter Integrationsspezialisten, das sowohl mit SAP‑ als auch mit Microsoft‑Azure‑Technologien arbeitet
- Breite technologische Einblicke über mehrere ERP‑Plattformen, Geschäftsbereiche und Integrationsmuster hinweg
- Die Möglichkeit, aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung des Digital Integration Hub beizutragen und den Weg hin zu einer stärker ereignisgesteuerten Architektur mitzugestalten
- Arbeitszeiten am Tag, keine Rufbereitschaft und ein gesundes Work‑Life‑Balance‑Umfeld
- Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen sowie attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen, einschließlich betrieblicher Altersvorsorge und weiterer Benefits

Kok på Center Parcs Nordborg Resort

fastansættelse eller sæsonjob

Fuldtid / Deltid

Siden juni 2025 har vi været en del af Center Parcs Nordborg Resort med mange forskellige gastronomiske koncepter, og vi søger dig som kok! Vi søger et fast medlem til vores team – ikke kun for en sæson.

Vi kan tilbyde:

- Attraktiv løn : En løn, der matcher dine kvalifikationer og din erfaring
- Spændende udfordringer : Bliv en del af en ny afdeling og vær med til aktivt at forme udviklingen og succesen af vores gastronomiske tilbud.

- Internationalt arbejdsmiljø : En pålidelig international virksomhed og en fast ansættelse eller også for sæsonen – alt efter hvad der passer dig bedst
- Medarbejderrabatter : Få bl.a. rabat på måltider i vores restauranter
- Muligheder for videreuddannelse : Din karriere, din fremtid – muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling på nationalt og internationalt plan

Dine opgaver:

Som kok er du en del af vores køkkenhold og sørger for, at vores gæster hver dag får et gastronomisk tilbud af høj kvalitet og med stor variation.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

- Tilberedning af retter til f.eks. morgenbuffet
- Kreativ tilberedning med både friske råvarer og convenience-produkter
- Planlægning og organisering af indkøb og opbevaring
- Tilberedning af à la carte-menuer

Din profil:

- En afsluttet uddannelse som kok eller tilsvarende erhvervserfaring inden for gastronomi
- Erhvervserfaring, f.eks. fra restaurant, hotel, kantine eller storkøkken, er en fordel
- Kvalitetsbevidsthed, ansvarsfølelse og glæde ved madlavning
- Et køligt hoved – også i stressede situationer
- Teamånd, pålidelighed og en struktureret arbejdsmåde
- Kreativitet og interesse for forskellige køkkenretninger
- Fleksibilitet og villighed til også at arbejde i weekender og på helligdage
- Gode danskkundskaber; engelsk- eller tyskfærdigheder er en fordel

Mere end 24.000 mennesker i 11 lande er allerede en del af Areas-familien. Vi brænder for det, vi laver, elsker rollen som værter og byder vores gæster velkommen med lækker og indbydende mad

Vi ser frem til at lære dig at kende! Ansøg nu via e-mail til: karriere@areas.com eller via online ansøgningsskemaet!

Vi opfordrer alle interesserede til at søge uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, handicap, eller etnisk tilhørsforhold.

In diesem Geist denken wir lösungsorientiert und pragmatisch, sind mutig und entscheidungsfreudig und können somit schnell und zielorientiert im Sinne des Kunden und der Mitarbeiter reagieren.

Da wir stetig wachsen, suchen wir als Verstärkung ab sofort eine(n)

Vorrichter/Rohrschlosser (m/w/d)

So passt du zu uns:

- Du übernimmst Verantwortung für dein Handeln gegenüber unseren Kunden und Kollegen.
- Du arbeitest gerne in einem Team, da du Spaß daran hast, vernetzt zu sein und über deinen Bereich hinaus zu denken.

- Du hast Spaß am Umgang mit internationalen Kunden, bist reisebereit und kannst Dich gut auf Deutsch und Englisch ausdrücken - vielleicht beherrscht Du sogar noch eine weitere Fremdsprache.

-  Du übernimmst bei der Montage unserer Dampfturbosätze die Vorrichtarbeiten für den Rohrleitungsbau.

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Rohrschlosser oder im Bereich Metallbau, Schweißtechnik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.

title: Rengøringsleder til Renseri
description:
Vi søger en engageret og struktureret Rengøringsleder til vores renseri hos Renserierne.DK ApS, ,Vester Farimagsgade 3 , 1606 København V

Som Rengøringsleder får du en central rolle i den daglige drift, hvor du sikrer, at arbejdsopgaver planlægges, koordineres og udføres effektivt. Du bliver bindeled mellem virksomhedens ejer og medarbejderne og bidrager til en høj kvalitet i både driften og kundeservicen.

Stillingen er en driftskoordinerende funktion uden personale- eller HR-ansvar. Du har ikke ansvar for ansættelser eller afskedigelser, men du har ansvar for at sikre en effektiv daglig drift, høj service og et godt samarbejde mellem medarbejderne.

Ansættelsen forudsætter, at du til enhver tid har gyldig arbejdstilladelse, hvis dette kræves.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Overvåge og koordinere virksomhedens daglige driftsaktiviteter for at sikre en smidig og effektiv arbejdsgang.

  • Koordinere medarbejdernes arbejdsplaner og sikre tilstrækkelig bemanding i forhold til den daglige drift og kundernes behov.

  • Vejlede og støtte medarbejderne i det daglige arbejde for at sikre høj kvalitet og effektiv kundeservice.

  • Modtage og betjene kunder, besvare henvendelser samt modtage servicebestillinger.

  • Håndtere kundefeedback og klager professionelt og sikre hurtig opfølgning.

  • Sikre en effektiv kommunikation mellem medarbejderne og virksomhedens ejer om den daglige drift.

  • Overvåge virksomhedens kundeservice og den samlede driftseffektivitet.

  • Følge kundetilfredsheden og komme med forslag til forbedringer af kundeoplevelsen.

  • Identificere daglige driftsmæssige udfordringer og foreslå praktiske løsninger, der styrker den operationelle effektivitet.

  • Bidrage med idéer til salgsfremmende aktiviteter og forretningsudvikling med henblik på at tiltrække nye kunder og understøtte virksomhedens vækst.

  • Sikre, at de daglige arbejdsopgaver udføres rettidigt og bidrage til et organiseret, sikkert og effektivt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Repræsentere virksomheden professionelt i kontakten med kunder.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring fra renseri, vaskeri, rengøringsbranchen eller en anden servicevirksomhed.

  • Er struktureret og god til at koordinere den daglige drift.

  • Har stærke samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner.

  • Er serviceminded og sætter en ære i at levere en høj kundeservice.

  • Er løsningsorienteret og arbejder selvstændigt.

  • Kan bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag og sikre, at opgaver bliver løst effektivt.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og alsidig stilling med ansvar for den daglige drift.

Vi sender to skønne kollegaer på pension og sørger derfor en pædagog til en 32 timers stilling pr. 1. oktober samt en pædagogmedhjælper/assistent til en 28 timers stilling pr. 1. november. Begge stillinger er til vores fantastisk specialafdeling fyldt med dygtige medarbejdere og 26 skønne elever.

Vi søger dig, der er engageret og faglig stærk og som vil være med til at skabe den bedste skole- og Dusdag for vores elever i specialafdelingen. Vi søger en person med et roligt nervesystem og som er robust og mødestabil. En som besidder en god portion empati og humor, og som brænder for at udvikle sit fag sammen med kommende kolleger, og som trives i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde med fokus på faglighed og trivsel.

Vi er et specialtilbud for elever med neuromassive indlæringsvanskeligheder. Elevgruppen er kendetegnet ved en generelt forsinket udvikling i forhold til kognitive, sproglige, motoriske og sociale kompetencer. Flere elever har diagnoser relateret til udviklingshæmning, hjerneskade, syndromer eller neuropsykiatriske vanskeligheder, og nogle har desuden fysiske handicaps. Eleverne har behov for omfattende støtte til at udvikle basale færdigheder og til at indgå i sociale fællesskaber.

Fælles for eleverne er, at de har et udviklingspotentiale, som kan understøttes gennem en målrettet, struktureret og relationsbåret indsats, hvor undervisningen og aktiviteterne i skole og dus tilpasses den enkelte elevs forudsætninger. 

Vi prioriterer vores forældresamarbejde og teamsamarbejde højt samt samarbejdet med vores eksterne samarbejdspartnere i kommunen. Opgaverne i stillingen kan variere alt efter, hvilke kompetencer du bringer med. Vores elever har et behov for støtte, guidning og kontakt til det pædagogiske personale, hvorfor det er yderst vigtigt, at du brænder for lige netop vores tilbud.   

Filstedvejens Skole er:

  • En skole hvor vi lykkes i fællesskab, og hvor der er højt til loftet
  • En velfungerende skole med ca. 580 glade og lærelystne elever
  • Fyldt med en dygtig og engageret medarbejderstab på 120 lærere, pædagoger, pædagogmedhjælpere, teknisk-administrativt personale og rengøringspersonale 
  • To- og tre sporet fra 0.-9.klasse i almen samt specialafdelingen 
  • Heldig at have både en normal- og special-DUS samt DUS-2 for elever fra 4.-6. klasse 

Vi tilbyder:

  • En attraktiv arbejdsplads med mange faglige muligheder.
  • En skole, hvor vi tager hånd om hinanden

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har stor lyst til at være en del af både skole og DUS
  • Er tydelig, nærværende og omsorgsfuld i arbejdet med børnene.
  • Er stærk i forældresamarbejdet
  • Er en teamplayer
  • Har gode samarbejds- og relationskompetencer.
  • Er aktiv med børnene i form af aktiviteter, der er tilpasset deres behov
  • Har erfaring indenfor specialområdet

  • Lade humør, seriøsitet og ansvarlighed gå ”hånd-i-hånd”

title: Research Assistant Positions in Development of AI-based Decision Support
description:
Applications are invited for two part-time research assistant positions with SDU Health Informatics and Technology (HIT), The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), University of Southern Denmark (SDU), Odense. Both positions are for 1 years at 25% (9,25 hours/week). The planned starting date for the positions is October 1, 2026.

 

Tasks

Both research assistant positions will focus on development of AI-based decision support. One position will be related to a joint project with Hospital Sønderjylland (Sønderborg) on personalized cardiovascular risk prediction and diagnostic support for patients with advanced kidney disease. The other position will be related to a joint project with Lillebælt Hospital (Vejle) on detection of smoking status and symptoms for lung cancer patients.

 

Ideal candidates

To qualify for the positions, you must hold a M.Sc. degree in software engineering, artificial intelligence, computer science, or a related discipline.

The ideal candidates will have many of the following competences.

  • artificial intelligence experience (including explainability and interpretability)

  • experience in development of AI-augmented decision support tools

  • experience in interdisciplinary work

  • experience in working with external stakeholders and domain experts

  • knowledge of the health domain

 

About MMMI and SDU HIT

MMMI is an internationally recognized research department that conducts research within robotics, drone technology, artificial intelligence, I4.0, software engineering as well as health and energy informatics.

SDU HIT conducts interdisciplinary research related to data driven health technology in close collaboration with experts from various fields. There is a strong emphasis on the development of high TRL systems related to intelligent monitoring and decision support; predictive models for prevention, early detection, diagnosis, treatment, and prognosis; digital health systems offering novel personalized data collection, treatment plans and interventions. SDU HIT has research activities in areas such as geriatrics, mental health, compassion, cancer, cardiology, kidney disease, osteoporosis, and multiple sclerosis.

 

Additional information

For further information about the positions, please contact Professor Uffe Kock Wiil, phone +45 6011 3565, email ukwiil@mmmi.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Complete list of publications, if you have any.

  • Publications most relevant for the position (max. 2).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is August 25, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms
This appointment as a research assistant is part-time and temporary for an initial 1-year period, and the preferred start date is from October 1, 2026. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. 

Employment as a research assistant requires qualifications at minimum master’s level (equivalent to a Danish master’s degree) at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for research assistant as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

title: Postdoc Positions in Autonomous Drone Flight in Confined Spaces for Wind Turbine Inspection
description:
The SDU UAS Center, part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, invites applications for one or more postdoc positions on autonomous flight in confined and cluttered environments for multi-rotor drones. The positions are for a two-year employment with a flexible start date.

 

What We Offer
The successful candidates will become part of the SDU UAS Center, where we conduct cutting-edge research in civilian drone technologies and future drone applications in critical sectors, such as agriculture, inspection, energy, and healthcare. At the heart of our mission is the creation of groundbreaking drone solutions that address key societal challenges. We are committed to fostering a dynamic and inspiring work environment where creativity flourishes. We often collaborate closely with world-leading companies, some of which are part of the vibrant robotic startup community around Odense.

The positions are tied to the development of an Automated Service Inspection (ASI) system for wind turbines, carried out in close collaboration with Vestas. Wind energy is a cornerstone of the green transition, yet the industry depends heavily on manual inspections and a shrinking pool of service technicians. Autonomous drones that can fly safely inside and around turbine structures are a key enabler for scalable, data-driven maintenance, promising less downtime, improved safety, and higher energy production across a growing global fleet.

 

Work Area
The successful candidates will conduct research and development within autonomous flight in confined spaces, where safety and robustness under real-world conditions are paramount. Flying close to and inside turbine structures, such as the tower interior, raises fundamental research challenges: navigation without reliable GNSS, perception in geometrically complex environments, and safe motion planning within centimetres of critical infrastructure. Concretely, the work will include the following:

  • State estimation and localisation in GNSS-denied, confined environments (visual-inertial odometry (VIO), simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM), sensor fusion).

  • Real-time perception.

  • Motion planning and control for safe, agile flight in close proximity to obstacles and infrastructure.

  • Prototyping of drones and payloads tailored to confined-space inspection, from concept and mechanical/electronics integration to flight-ready platforms.

  • Integration of autonomy with onboard inspection payloads (cameras, microphones) and existing turbine data.

  • Operation and flight testing of multi-rotor UAS, including experiments at turbine sites.

During the appointment, the successful candidates will also have the opportunity to work on related autonomy challenges across the center’s project portfolio, where autonomous flight under demanding real-world conditions is a recurring theme.

The positions may involve co-supervising related student projects. The candidates will be part of the SDU UAS Center and are expected to participate in the center's project portfolio and outreach activities.

 

We Expect

We expect that you hold a PhD degree or expect to be awarded one before the start date, within engineering, robotics, computer science, or another related field. You do not need to cover every area below, but you should have experience with, and a genuine interest in, some of the following:

  • Research and development within autonomous navigation, state estimation, or motion planning for robots or UAS.

  • Research and development within UAS platforms, subsystems, and payloads.

  • Prototyping of drones and payloads (mechanical design, electronics, systems integration).

  • Perception and machine learning for robotics.

  • Software design and development (C, C++, Python), including real-time and embedded systems.

  • UAS operations (experiments, piloting).

We furthermore expect that you publish findings at recognised international conferences and in top-ranked, peer-reviewed journals.

For certain projects and tasks at the Drone Labs at HCA Airport, a security check by relevant authorities and a driving license are required.

For further information, please contact Prof. Anders Lyhne Christensen (andc@mmmi.sdu.dk) and Associate Prof. Robert Ladig (rola@mmmi.sdu.dk).

We look forward to receiving your application.

 

Application

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.

title: Postdoctoral researcher position on monitoring tools for assessing animal health and welfare at the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Aarhus University
employer: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
description:
We are seeking a motivated postdoctoral researcher to join our international team working on monitoring animal health and welfare.

The position is for two years and will commence December 1, 2026, or soon thereafter. The position is within the research section Management and Modelling.

The research section Management and Modelling develop methods and tools for herd management to promote animal welfare, green transition, and economic viability. Further, the section integrates, develops, and disseminates knowledge of farm animal management and relationships between actors and animals. Researchers in the section teach BSc, MSc and PhD in animal and veterinary science educations and conduct research-based public advice for national and international authorities on animal welfare and health.

The research section is a dynamic multidisciplinary research group including animal scientists, veterinarians, economists, statisticians, and anthropologists.

The position

We seek a post doc to evaluate data and monitoring tools for assessing animal health and welfare in all major livestock production systems (cattle, pig and poultry). The post doc will contribute to identification of animal-based indicators for pig welfare to be used in pig welfare inspection. The post doc will also contribute to the development of training materials in targeting pig welfare inspectors in EU member states.

Your profile

We are looking for a candidate who:
  • Holds a PhD or equivalent academic qualifications.
  • Has research experience in monitoring animal welfare, health or production on any of the major livestock production systems (cattle, pigs or poultry).

Research tasks
  • Evaluating data and monitoring tools for assessing animal health and welfare in cattle, pig or poultry
  • Identification of animal-based indicators for pig welfare to be used in screening of pig welfare in relation to inspection
  • Development and evaluation of training and testing programmes targeting European pig welfare inspectors

The preferred candidate will also engage in and further develop ongoing research and teaching within the Management and Modelling group.

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal-experimental facilities
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities
  • A workplace characterized by equality and a good work-life balance, and an open discussion across different fields of research.

Who we are

Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to solve essential societal challenges within the green transition: food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, environment, climate, and health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for the research-based public sector consultancy and degree programs covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programs within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated in the research environment.

ANIVET has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies, situated in close connection to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and good industrial and professional collaboration.

Please refer to Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (au.dk) for further
information about the department; https://anivet.au.dk/en

Contact

Further information on the position may be obtained from Head of Research Unit, Professor Jan Tind Sørensen, phone: +4520783343, email: jantind.sorensen@anivet.au.dk.

Living in Denmark

Please visit the international staff website: https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential family.

Place of employment and place of work

The place of work is the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, AU Viborg, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele, and the area of employment is Aarhus University (AU) with related departments.


Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.


Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

title: PhD Positions in Autonomous Drone Flight in Confined Spaces for Wind Turbine Inspection
description:
The SDU UAS Center, part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, invites applications for one or more PhD positions on autonomous flight in confined and cluttered environments for multi-rotor drones. The positions are for a three-year employment with a flexible start date.

 

What We Offer
The successful candidates will become part of the SDU UAS Center, where we conduct cutting-edge research in civilian drone technologies and future drone applications in critical sectors, such as agriculture, inspection, energy, and healthcare. At the heart of our mission is the creation of groundbreaking drone solutions that address key societal challenges. We are committed to fostering a dynamic and inspiring work environment where creativity flourishes. We often collaborate closely with world-leading companies, some of which are part of the vibrant robotic startup community around Odense.

The positions are tied to the development of an Automated Service Inspection (ASI) system for wind turbines, carried out in close collaboration with Vestas. Wind energy is a cornerstone of the green transition, yet the industry depends heavily on manual inspections and a shrinking pool of service technicians. Autonomous drones that can fly safely inside and around turbine structures are a key enabler for scalable, data-driven maintenance, promising less downtime, improved safety, and higher energy production across a growing global fleet.

 

Work Area
The successful candidates will conduct research and development within autonomous flight in confined spaces, where safety and robustness under real-world conditions are paramount. Flying close to and inside turbine structures, such as the tower interior, raises fundamental research challenges: navigation without reliable GNSS, perception in geometrically complex environments, and safe motion planning within centimetres of critical infrastructure. Concretely, the work will include the following:

  • State estimation and localisation in GNSS-denied, confined environments (visual-inertial odometry (VIO), simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM), sensor fusion).

  • Real-time perception.

  • Motion planning and control for safe, agile flight in close proximity to obstacles and infrastructure.

  • Prototyping of drones and payloads tailored to confined-space inspection, from concept and mechanical/electronics integration to flight-ready platforms.

  • Integration of autonomy with onboard inspection payloads (cameras, microphones) and existing turbine data.

  • Operation and flight testing of multi-rotor UAS, including experiments at turbine sites.

During the PhD studies, the successful candidates will also have the opportunity to work on related autonomy challenges across the center's project portfolio, where autonomous flight under demanding real-world conditions is a recurring theme.

The positions may involve co-supervising related student projects. The candidates will be part of the SDU UAS Center and are expected to participate in the center's project portfolio and outreach activities.

 

We Expect
We expect that you hold an MSc, or expect to complete one before the start date, in engineering, robotics, or computer science, or another related field. You do not need to cover every area below, but you should have experience with, and a genuine interest in, some of the following:

  • Research and development within autonomous navigation, state estimation, or motion planning for robots or UAS.

  • Research and development within UAS platforms, subsystems, and payloads.

  • Prototyping of drones and payloads (mechanical design, electronics, systems integration).

  • Perception and machine learning for robotics.

  • Software design and development (C, C++, Python), including real-time and embedded systems.

  • UAS operations (experiments, piloting).

We furthermore expect that you publish findings at recognised international conferences and in top-ranked, peer-reviewed journals.

For certain projects and tasks at the Drone Labs at HCA Airport, a security check by relevant authorities and a driving license are required.

For further information, please contact Prof. Anders Lyhne Christensen (andc@mmmi.sdu.dk) and Associate Prof. Robert Ladig (rola@mmmi.sdu.dk).

We look forward to receiving your application.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. Vi er i udvikling og investerer løbende i nye maskiner og ny teknologi. Derfor får du gode muligheder for at udvikle dig fagligt og bringe din viden i spil i en moderne produktion.

Jobbet er primært på daghold. Derudover skal du være indstillet på at arbejde på aftenhold i gennemsnit ca. hver 6. eller 7. uge og have tilkaldevagt ca. hver 12. weekend. Der kan også forekomme perioder, hvor der er brug for din hjælp på natskiftet. 

Vi har stærkt fokus på sikkerhed. Hos os kommer sikkerhed altid først, både i måden vi arbejder på i produktionen, og i den måde vi passer på hinanden i hverdagen. Vi forventer, at du bidrager aktivt til et sikkert arbejdsmiljø.

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi leder efter dig, der er fagligt stærk og trives med at være en del af et team, hvor vi løfter i flok.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har en relevant baggrund som fx smed, landbrugsmekaniker, automekaniker, automatikmekaniker eller lignende

  • har erfaring med vedligehold

  • har kendskab til MAG/TIG svejsning, drejebænk, tegningslæsning, lejemontage, systematisk fejlfinding og pneumatikstyring

  • arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret

  • tager ansvar og hjælper dine kolleger

  • taler og skriver dansk

Hvorfor vælge ABENA?

Hos ABENA Produktion får du et spændende og afvekslende job i en virksomhed, hvor vi prioriterer både faglighed og mennesker. Du bliver en del af en afdeling med godt arbejdsklima, engagerede kolleger og gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling.

Vi lægger vægt på:

  • et stærkt fællesskab med samarbejde og godt humør

  • en moderne produktion med avancerede maskinanlæg

  • gode muligheder for udvikling og efteruddannelse

  • kantineordning, motionsrum og sundhedsordning

  • en arbejdsplads med tillid, retfærdighed og samarbejde

Hos ABENA skal det være trygt, rart og motiverende at gå på arbejde. Vi tror på ordentlighed, godt samarbejde og høj faglighed, og vi sætter en ære i at passe godt på hinanden, vores kunder og vores leverandører.

Er du vores nye kollega?

Send din ansøgning og CV snarest gennem vores ansøgningssystem. Vi behandler ansøgningerne efterhånden, som vi modtager dem, indtil vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Såfremt der er spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte vedligeholdelsesleder Bo Amdi Holm på tlf.: 51580560.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Erfarne asbestmedarbejdere Experienced Asbestos Removal Technicians søges i Vejle – 250 kr./time ved asbestarbejde + egen firmabil
description:
Skadeservice.nu vækster, og vi oplever en markant stigende efterspørgsel på specialiserede saneringsopgaver. Derfor udvider vi nu vores asbestafdeling i Vejle og søger 2-3 erfarne asbestmedarbejdere, som skal indgå i et nyt team.

Har du erfaringen og papirerne i orden, og vil du være med til at præge kulturen og samarbejdet i et nystartet team? Så er det dig, vi leder efter.

Om jobbet og din rolle

Som en del af vores nye team kommer du primært til at arbejde med større og mindre asbestsaneringsopgaver i og omkring Vejle. Arbejdet kræver høj faglighed og et kompromisløst fokus på sikkerhed og kvalitet.

Da vi er en skadeservicevirksomhed, kan der også forekomme almindelige skadeserviceopgaver, f.eks. i forbindelse med vand-, brand- og social rengøring.

Når du er oplært og klar til det, vil du desuden indgå i vores vagtrul sammen med dine kolleger. Du bliver naturligvis ikke sat på vagt, før du har den nødvendige introduktion og er tryg ved vores arbejdsgange og procedurer.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med dine faste makkere, og som en del af et helt nyt team får I stor medindflydelse på, hvordan arbejdsdagen tilrettelægges, og hvordan vi sammen opbygger en stærk afdeling i Vejle.

Din faglige profil
Vi leder efter kandidater, der kender håndværket til bunds og kan gå selvstændigt til opgaverne fra dag ét. Vi forventer, at du har stor respekt for de gældende sikkerhedsregler og procedurer på området.

Som person er du mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og en god holdspiller, som forstår vigtigheden af at kunne stole på sine kolleger, når man arbejder med miljøfarlige stoffer.

Vi tilbyder
Skadeservice.nu er en arbejdsplads med en flad organisation og højt til loftet. Vi passer på vores medarbejdere og sørger for, at udstyret altid er i orden.

Når du bliver en del af holdet, kan du se frem til:

Vi tror på åbenhed omkring løn og vilkår. Som medarbejder hos Skadeservice.nu aflønnes du med:

174,61 kr. pr. time i grundløn

Tillæggene udbetales afhængigt af den type arbejde, du udfører, og kan ikke kombineres.

title: Fitnessinstruktør/medhjælper til Loop Fitness Ringkøbing
description:
Vi er et center i udvikling og søger derfor nye medarbejdere – og meget gerne en studerende, fleksjobber, efterlønner eller lign. Der er tale om en timelønnet stilling omkirng 6-12 timer ugentligt primært tirsdag og torsdag eftermiddag og flere ved weekend, ferie mm. 

Beskrivelse af jobbet og forventninger:

En stor del af jobbet vil være kontakt med vores medlemmer, instruere brugerne af vores maskiner og koncept, samt rengøring.

Efter grundig kort oplæring af vores koncept, skal du udføre prøve- og instruktørtimer til nye og nuværende medlemmer ved guidning og fysisk instruktion.

Du skal på brugerniveau kunne benytte vores eget IT-system til at oprette nye medlemmer, oprette aftaler mm. Du skal kunne tale og skrive dansk, da du både er i personlig kontakt, telefonisk kontakt og skrivende kontakt med medlemmer og kollegaer.

Du skal være smilende, serviceminded og empatisk og du skal kunne kommunikere med kunder i alle aldre

Du skal fysisk kunne deltage i rengøringsopgaver i centret, da vi sætter stor pris på at vores center altid er pænt og rent, men opgaverne er tilpasset og opdelt.

Du skal kunne træne i vores udstyr og hvis man har lyst, er der mulighed for at kunne undervise i holdtræning.

Du skal selvstændigt kunne arbejde på vagter af 2-4 timers varighed ad gangen hvor man aktivt skal være i centret i hele vagten, gående og stående med afveksling. Vagterne kan ligge i både formiddags- og eftermiddagstimerne, samt i weekender.

Der vil til tider være arrangementer, events og outgoing opgaver.

Vi forventer at du er god til at skabe kontakt til andre mennesker, er ansvarsbevidst, selvkørende, smilende og udadvendt. At du kan få alle vores medlemmer til at føle sig velkommen, hver gang de kommer og træner.

Hvad kan du forvente af os:

I LOOP er vi kendt for vores gode service og nærvær og vores arrangement sammen med vores medlemmer, så du vil blive en del af et godt team, der hjælper hinanden og du vil få en arbejdsplads med skønne sociale medlemmer omkring dig.

Hos os kan du forvente et arbejde med frihed under ansvar, du vil blive grundigt oplært i den daglige drift, og der vil løbende være kurser der oplære dig i korrekt brug af maskinerne mm.

Lyder det som jobbet for dig, så send en mail til centerleder Rikke på ral@loopfitness.dk

Der vil løbende blive indkaldt til samtaler, med opstart snarest muligt.
