title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project: The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship
description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working at the intersection of cancer biology and endocrinology. The project aims to investigate stanniocalcin-2 (STC2) as a key mediator of adipose tissue–tumor crosstalk in obesity-related cancer.

The project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative, the Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC) network, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. Though this grant, 2/3 of the PhD salary has been secured.

Employment is therefore conditional upon the successful enrolment of the candidate as a PhD student at the PhD School at Faculty of Health Sciences, and the awarding of a one-year Faculty Scholarship. 

 

Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at KMEB, a research unit focused on clinical and translational endocrinology, under the supervision of Associate Professor Rikke Hjortebjerg and Professor Jan Frystyk. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the laboratory of co-supervisor Professor Henrik Ditzel, Cancer and Inflammation Research Unit, Department of Molecular Medicine, SDU. 

The candidate will work across two complementary research groups with access to state-of-the-art research facilities. Together, the groups provide a multidisciplinary research environment with close integration of clinical and experimental research. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about KMEB here: https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/kmeb

 

Project description

Our research centers around the insulin-like growth factor (IGF) system, a key hormonal regulator in several diseases. The project focuses on stanniocalcin-2 (STC2), an IGF system member that is linked to poor outcomes in most obesity-related cancers but paradoxically predicts favorable prognosis in postmenopausal estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) breast cancer. 

The aim is to examine how STC2 effects are modulated by obesity and estrogen signaling and how it regulates IGF-2/insulin receptor pathways in the tumor–adipose microenvironment. To establish clinically relevant models, the candidate will generate patient-derived xenograft (PDX) mouse models with human tumor tissue and participate in establishing patient-derived organoids and 3D co-cultures. These systems will be interrogated using genetically engineered STC2 and PAPP-A variants and analyzed with advanced sequencing, spatial, and single-cell omics.

The PhD student will:

  • Establish and analyze PDX mouse models of ER+ breast cancer.

  • Sample and process tumor and tumor-adjacent/distant adipose tissue from breast cancer patients.

  • Assess STC2 activity, IGF-2 signaling, and tumor growth under estrogen-controlled conditions.

  • Help analyze molecular data generated through sequencing and omics-based approaches.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in molecular biology, biomedicine, or related fields. 

  • Preferably prior experience with endocrinology or cancer research. 

  • An interest in working with animal models (mice) is a necessity.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Rikke Hjortebjerg

KMEB, Department of Clinical Research

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: rhjortebjerg@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)


Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date September 1, 2026

Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager to ICARS Would you like to be part of an international institution with highly skilled colleagues from more than 20 different countries? Would you like to join a purpose-driven institution contributing to global health and development where you will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen the support functions as we continue to grow and mature as an organisation? Then you may be our new Finance Manager.

This is a full-time position available as soon as possible.



About ICARS

ICARS is an autonomous, self-governing, non-profit organization, international in character, established by the Danish Government and overseen by the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs. ICARS receives funding from the Danish Government and other institutional donors and foundations and supports low- and middle-income countries in developing solutions to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation.

With an annual budget is around 100m DKK, 50+ FTE’s, more than 70 projects across 30+ countries, a growing global footprint, and increasing organisational complexity, the Finance Team plays a crucial role in the management of all financial aspects of ICARS’ projects and running ICARS as an organization.



We offer

We offer an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing team that is developing the scientific and organisational foundation of ICARS. Our team is composed of enthusiastic international pioneers from across the globe that all believe in ICARS’ mission and are highly motivated to ensure its success.

We are based at Statens Serum Institute in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Please visit www.icars-global.org for more information.



About the position

As an experienced Finance Manager, you will have overall professional responsibility for ICARS’ financial management, budgeting, reporting, annual and project auditing to ensure that ICARS meets all accounting and reporting requirements from funders. Furthermore, you are responsible for maintaining and further developing efficient work processes and promoting the effective use of IT systems and digital tools to support operational excellence.

While the role does not have direct people management responsibilities, it is expected to provide strong professional leadership by acting as a trusted sparring partner and subject matter expert for the team. The Finance team consists of 3.5 FTEs working closely together to ensure the effective delivery of financial services across the organisation.



Your main tasks

  • Take overall professional responsibility for ICARS’ financial accounting and ensure complete, accurate and timely financial records.
  • Lead preparation of ICARS’ annual organisational budget and consolidated project portfolio budget.
  • Lead the monthly, quarterly and year-end closing processes and the liaison with the auditors.
  • Prepare forecasting, financial analysis and reporting to the management and the board.
  • Coordinate and quality-assure finance activities and provide professional guidance to other finance and operations staff.
  • Advise budget holders and project managers on financial performance, risks and required actions, and ensure quality reporting according to donor requirements.
  • Act as functional owner of ICARS’ financial systems, reporting structures and finance data, including Navision Stat, Business Central.
  • Further develop and continuously improve ICARS financial reporting system, financial management structures, digital tools and automation.


Your background, professional and personal qualifications

We expect that you hold a degree in finances, economics, accounting or equivalent. It will be considered an advantage, if you have worked in an institution administrating funds from multiple donors, including the Danish government.

Professional qualifications

  • At least 3 years of proven success in a similar role.
  • Relevant professional experience in leading financial accounting, financial management and audit, including independent responsibility for financial closing, reporting or audit processes.
  • Understanding of Danish public-sector financial management, preferably gained in a Danish state institution, a self-governing institution or an organisation working closely with Danish government authorities.
  • Assuring compliance with regulations, standards and requirements associated with budgeting, financial reporting, grants and project administration.
  • Experience with international operations, foreign currency management, and partner-managed grants is an advantage.
  • Strong practical experience with Navision Stat, NAV, Business Central and associated state systems (SDI, RejsUd etc) or similar systems. Advanced Excel skills and the ability to develop useful financial analyses and reports.
  • Experience and interest in adopting AI to increase efficiency in finance controlling environment.
Personal qualifications

  • Excellent organisational skills with demonstrated ability to successfully manage competing priorities.
  • Combine strong attention to detail and accuracy with the ability to maintain an overview of the organisation’s overall financial position.
  • Work systematically, meet demanding deadlines and plan effectively around reporting and audit cycles.
  • Can explain complex financial matters clearly to colleagues without a finance background.
  • Ability to build strong relationships and good collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Interested in improving processes, systems and the use of data and automation in finance.
  • Proficiency in English (English is our working language). As you will be collaborating with Danish partners, experience in Danish will also be considered an advantage.


Terms of employment

This is a full-time position available as soon as possible.

Salary and appointment terms will be based on the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the recognised negotiating organisations, depending on the candidate’s educational background. We expect the position to be classified at the level of chief consultant (Chefkonsulent) according to the AC Collective Agreement.

For non-Danish citizens living outside Denmark, relocation is a requirement. In this case a monthly relocation supplement and a relocation package consisting of a lumpsum and administrative assistance by settling in Denmark is added to your salary.

Please note that your total income is subject to taxation according to ordinary Danish tax rules and not under special beneficial tax schemes.



Further information

For further information about the position, please contact Executive Director Helle Engslund Krarup, at +45 24852974.



Application and recruitment process

Press “apply for the position” and submit your CV and relevant diplomas along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and motivation for applying no later than August 17th, 2026, at 23.59.

title: Europcar søger en FP&A Manager

Udover den danske forretning, vil en mindre del af de opgaver, der hører til rollen, også gå med at supportere og drive den finske budget og forecast proces.

Med reference til vores Finance Director har du og dit team ansvaret for at sikre høj kvalitet i den månedlige rapportering samt drive vores forecast- og budgetprocesser i tæt samarbejde med forretningen. Du vil derfor spille en væsentlig rolle i videreudvikling af vores eksisterende, solide fundament.

Samtidig fungerer du som et centralt bindeled til koncernens finansfunktion, hvor du sikrer rettidig, konsistent og veldokumenteret rapportering og bidrager til at skabe transparens og sammenhæng i den finansielle performance.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

  • Sikre høj kvalitet i månedlig rapportering til ledelse og koncern

  • Koordinere og kvalitetssikre rapporteringspakker til Europcar Mobility Group Finance

  • Drive og udvikle budget- og forecastprocesser i Danmark og Finland

  • Udvikle og styrke brugen af forretningsdata, herunder rapporteringsværktøjer, dashboards og datagrundlag

I dag består vores FP&A afdeling af to controllere, der hver dag arbejder målrettet og ambitiøst for at levere til forretningen. Afdelingen er et godt sted i sammenhold og kultur. Og der er ønske om, at du som leder fokuserer på at teamet går fremtiden i møde med den rette støtte og ser løft af kompetencer og udvikling som vejen derhen.

Ansvaret for teamet indebærer også, at:

  • Sikre klare prioriteringer og høj kvalitet i leverancer

  • Udvikle teamets kompetencer og arbejdsprocesser

  • Skabe et motiverende og professionelt arbejdsmiljø

Udover dit fokus på os og teamet, har vi naturligt også et fokus på dig, så dit faglige og professionelle bidrag i virksomheden stemmer overens med det, vi søger.

Derfor forestiller vi os, at du:

  • Har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for økonomi, finans eller lignende

  • Har dokumenteret solid erfaring med FP&A, controlling eller reporting – gerne fra en større organisation eller koncern

  • Har erfaring med budget- og forecastprocesser

  • Kan demonstrere god forretningsforståelse og evner at omsætte data til indsigt

  • Trives i en rolle med både operationelle og udviklingsorienterede opgaver

  • Har ledelseserfaring eller er klar til dette næste skridt i din karriere

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen og synes vi lyder interessante, kan vi opsummeret tilbyde:

  • En central rolle med stor indflydelse på udvikling af afdelingen

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • En attraktiv markedsrelevant lønpakke. Yderligere oplyses forud for eventuel forhandling.

  • Indtræden i en finansafdeling med stærkt sammenhold og høj faglighed

  • En arbejdshverdag i en organisation, hvor der er højt til loftet og plads til mennesket.

Ansøgningsfrist d.17. august 2026. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og holder samtaler undervejs, da vi gerne vil finde den helt rette kandidat til stillingen. Vi opfordrer derfor interesserede til at søge hurtigst muligt.

Vi hører rigtig gerne fra dig via vores karriereportal. Men har du forinden spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Finance Director, Thomas Lyngholm Jacobsen +45 61 99 99 87 | TLJ@europcar.dk

We welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender reassignment, nationality, sexual orientation, age, disability status, religion, or any other dimension of diversity. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and fostering an environment of equity and inclusion, where respect for one another is essential. If you need any accommodations or assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know. Together, through mutual respect, we can create a more equitable and inclusive future.

Europcar Mobility Group is a global mobility player, with 75 years of mobility services expertise and a leading position in Europe.  “We help to change the way you move” is what we stand for and brings us together.

We offer to individuals and businesses a wide range of car and van rental services, be it for a few hours, a few days, a week, a month or more, on-demand or on subscription, relying on a fleet of more than 250.000 vehicles, equipped with the latest engines including an increasing share of electric vehicles.

Our brands address differentiated needs, use cases and expectations: Europcar® - a global leader of car rental and light commercial vehicle rental, with a premium positioning, Goldcar® - a frontrunner at providing low-cost car rental services in Europe, and Fox-Rent-A-Car®, one of the main players in the car rental market in the US, with a "value for money" positioning.

Customers’ satisfaction is at the heart of the Group’s ambition and that of our more than 8,000 employees, everywhere we deliver our mobility solutions, thanks to a strong network in over 130 countries.

title: PhD Stipend in Dynamic Modelling, Simulation and Optimization of Power-to-X Processes
description:
Aalborg University, Department of Energy, Campus Esbjerg, invites applications for a three-year PhD Stipend from October 1st or soon hereafter in dynamic modelling, simulation and optimization of Power-to-X processes for renewable fuel production. The project is primarily rooted in process engineering while also addressing the interaction between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid. You will contribute to interdisciplinary research spanning process engineering, power engineering and sustainable energy systems and help develop future large-scale Power-to-X solutions.

Your work tasks
In this PhD fellowship at AAU Energy, you will work with dynamic modeling, simulation and optimization of Power-to-X processes for renewable fuel production, such as green methanol and sustainable aviation fuel produced through Fischer–Tropsch and methanol-to-jet pathways. The project primarily focuses on the process-engineering aspects of renewable fuel production, with particular emphasis on the interactions among the electrical grid, electrolysers, fuel-synthesis processes, energy storage and heat integration in integrated Power-to-X systems.

You will develop and apply physics-based process models that describe the behavior of Power-to-X plants under varying operating conditions. This includes modelling electrolysers, fuel-synthesis units and supporting energy-system components and analyzing how these systems can operate efficiently and flexibly in response to fluctuations in renewable electricity generation, energy prices and wider energy-system conditions. The work will combine process simulation with operational optimization, techno-economic assessment and model validation.

The research will also examine the coordinated operation and control of Power-to-X processes, electrolysers and energy-storage systems in interaction with the electrical grid. You will contribute to research on grid-supporting operation and control strategies for integrated Power-to-X plants.

You will carry out your research in close collaboration with academic and industrialpartners in Denmark and across Europe. The position includes, among others, preparing scientific publications, presenting results at conferences and workshops, and participating in project meetings and activities. You will also make a limited contribution to teaching or supervision at Aalborg University, for example by supervising bachelor’s and master’s students working on relevant topics.

Your competencies 
You have, or are about to obtain, a master’s degree in chemical engineering, process engineering, mechanical engineering, energy engineering, sustainable energy engineering or a closely related field. You bring a solid foundation in areas such as process modelling, thermodynamics, heat and mass transfer, process dynamics and control, optimization or energy-system analysis, and you are interested in applying these disciplines to Power-to-X and renewable fuel production.

You have experience with process-modelling tools such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS or other related software and are motivated to develop and apply dynamic models of energy and chemical processes. You are familiar with programming languages and computational tools. Expertise in a particular software package is not required, but experience with one or more computational environments, such as MATLAB, Python or similar tools, will support your work in the project. Knowledge of Power-to-X, electrolysis, renewable fuels, process integration or energy storage will be advantageous.

Knowledge of electrical power systems, electricity markets, grid integration or the control of grid-connected energy systems would strengthen your profile but is not a requirement for the position. The core academic profile sought is within process engineering or a related discipline. You should have an interest in and motivation to learn about the interaction between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid, including how process-level operation and control affect plant flexibility and system-level performance.

You are able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research environment. You enjoy collaborating with colleagues and external partners and are comfortable discussing technical ideas across disciplinary boundaries.
You have good analytical abilities, scientific curiosity, and the ability to document and communicate your work clearly in writing and presentations. You have strong written and spoken English skills suitable for scientific collaboration and publication. We value your motivation and potential to develop across disciplines, and you are not expected to have prior expertise in every aspect of the project from the outset.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
You will join the Fluid & Process research group at AAU Energy, Campus Esbjerg, where you will become part of an international and interdisciplinary research environment combining process, chemical, energy, and electrical engineering. The group works with modeling, simulation, control, optimization, and experimental validation of fluid and energy systems, with applications including Power-to-X, carbon capture and utilization, green fuels, and sector coupling. The working culture is collaborative and informal, with close interaction among academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, PhD fellows, and students. We share an ambition to contribute to the green transition through research with practical relevance.

At Campus Esbjerg, you will work alongside academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, and PhD fellows across a range of energy-related disciplines. The campus setting supports close day-to-day collaboration across disciplines and research projects.

Collaboration with industry is an important part of the research environment, and many research and student projects are developed with external partners to address real-world engineering challenges. We aim to provide a supportive working environment with a healthy balance between professional commitments and life outside work.

The fellowship offers strong opportunities for professional and academic development.
As part of the three-year PhD program, you will conduct independent research under supervision and complete PhD courses corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS.
Courses may be taken at Aalborg University or other relevant institutions in Denmark and abroad. You will have opportunities to participate in specialized courses, summer schools, international conferences, and project workshops. The position will also provide experience in scientific publishing, research dissemination, teaching or student supervision, interdisciplinary project work, and collaboration with industrial partners.

AAU Energy offers access to modern experimental and computational facilities supporting research in sustainable energy systems. At Campus Esbjerg, these include facilities for thermal and fluid processes, electrical engineering, power electronics, renewable-energy control, offshore energy systems, and Power-to-X.

The research environment is being further strengthened through the C-TECH initiative, which is establishing a modular test site for carbon capture, electrolysis, and methanol synthesis at Campus Esbjerg. The facility is intended to support research, education, and industrial collaboration in Power-to-X and carbon capture, utilization, and storage. This creates an attractive setting for a PhD project connecting process modeling with industrial validation and integrated sustainable-energy systems.

Campus Esbjerg is located in one of Denmark’s major energy and offshore hubs, providing favorable conditions for collaboration with companies involved in renewable energy, Power-to-X, offshore technologies, and the wider energy transition. The relatively compact campus supports close professional relationships, close interaction with supervisors and colleagues, and collaboration across research and educational activities.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (4-5 pages), that:
    describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives.
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
When pursuing a PhD at Aalborg University, you'll receive a stipend which includes both salary
and pension benefits. The base salary starts at a minimum of 31.242,75 DKK before taxes, with an
additional 18,07% added for pension contributions. However, the final salary can be negotiated
based on your qualifications and experience, with seniority playing a key role in determining the
main salary.
Read more about pension options here.

At Aalborg University's Doctoral School, engineering PhD students enjoy unique career
development opportunities. These include personalized DISC profile assessments with feedback,
career-focused courses, and networking events with trade unions, employers, and other relevant
parties. Learn more about these initiatives at our Career Hub.

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish).

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (in Danish) 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: Director Sales and Key accounts
description:
You already know the maritime industry. You know who makes the decisions, why change takes time and why a trusted relationship matters more than a polished sales pitch.

Source2Sea combines the reach of a global maritime marketplace with the intelligence of a procurement platform. We are looking for a Global Key Account Director to join our Commercial team. Our people are our greatest assets and the driving force behind our mission, which is to enable ‘Shop with Insights. Spend with Confidence’.

We don't just digitalize procurement. We make it smarter. By combining marketplace reach with procurement intelligence, we help shipping companies, ship managers, caterers and suppliers make better purchasing decisions through data-driven insights, recommendations and intelligent procurement tools. We create value beyond the individual transaction, enabling buyers to gain greater visibility and control over spend while helping suppliers grow through digital collaboration.

Source2Sea is part of Wrist Group, the world leader in the field of procuring and delivering supplies to the maritime industry with a turnover in 2024 of more than DKK 5.7 billion.

Reporting to our CEO, you will become part of a strong and exciting commercial team. The position is based in Copenhagen.

Summary

The successful candidate will have excellent door opening skills at highest level in the industry - either through own network, via contacts or by creating an appealing proposition which begins a meaningful communication.

You are motivated by building B2B relationships – challenging customers to rethink how maritime procurement can create greater value through digitalization and data. Through active listening and strong problem solving skills, you are able toprobe and understand the customers pain points and opportunities, and can unlock these in a tangible way.

We expect you to have a “digital-first” mindset and to be the driving force within your area of responsibility; to build long-term partnership while managing day to day relationships.

Your primary responsibilities in this role will be:

Since Source2Sea is in high growth mode the tasks will be broad and varied and a high level of adaption to customer needs is expected. In other words you will be required to roll up your sleeves.

  • The predominant part of the role will be opening doors to shipping companies, listen and understand their business challenges and demonstrate how Source2Sea creates value through our marketplace and procurement platform.

  • Tactical planning and pipeline management to ensure a prioritized approach towards the right customers, based on their individual position, needs and likelihood to embark on the digital journey.

  • Drive customer dialog until commitment to trade on Source2Sea, while gradually looping in the Customer Success team, who will handle the onboarding process and experience.

  • Bring strategic customer insights back into Product, Customer Success and Leadership to help shape the continued development of the Source2Sea platform.

  • Create and maintain sales/account plans for target clients (forecasting, planning, budget management, follow-ups, etc.).

  • Together with the commercial team you will be planning and aligning buyer pipeline category and geographical needs with matching supplier pipeline.

We are looking for these Qualifications & Requirements:

  • A “digital-first” mindset, with the ability to see and sell the benefits of being digital.

  • Door opener and relationship builder, with a documented network with the ability to engage senior executives through a consultative, value-driven sales approach.

  • Minimum 7 years of sales experience at management level.

  • Experience in the maritime industry - from either Shipowner, Ship Manager, Supplier or Service Provider.

  • Active listener with strong problem solving skills.

  • Curiosity – it is not enough to ask "What?”. You want to know “Why?”

  • Ability to travel min. 7 days / month is expected.

In return we offer:

  • A combination of a financially robust enterprise that also offers a scale-up approach.

  • The opportunity to shape the future of maritime procurement.

  • Cutting edge use of technology incl. AI, driving efficiency and a unique customer experience – with a documented strong Net Promotor Score.

  • A modern, agile and forward-looking scale-up without legacy constraints.

  • An international team – currently 7 locations and +10 nationalities.

  • Highly digital and maritime-skilled colleagues to learn from.

  • A combination of working from home and at the office.

  • A professional and challenging job in a global company with an ambitious growth strategy.

  • High impact on own role with great personal development and growth opportunities.

  • The salary and benefits will correspond to your qualifications and results.

Visit www.source2sea.com or our LinkedIn profile to learn more about our great digital scale-up.

About Source2Sea

Source2Sea combines the reach of a global maritime marketplace with the intelligence of a procurement platform. We enable ‘Shop with Insights. Spend with Confidence’ across provisions, stores, spare parts and other vessel supplies through structured digital catalogues, intelligent procurement tools, actionable insights and recommendations.

By connecting shipping companies, ship managers and caterers with a global network of maritime suppliers, Source2Sea creates value beyond the individual transaction. The marketplace provides global supplier reach, greater choice and structured digital catalogues, while the platform transforms the maritime industry's strongest data foundation into greater spend visibility, smarter purchasing decisions, increased automation and more efficient supplier collaboration and growth.

Developed in close collaboration with leading shipping companies and suppliers, Source2Sea already supports global customers at scale and continues to expand its international supplier network and platform capabilities.

Source2Sea is an independent company founded and funded by Wrist Group, the global leader in marine supply and logistics. The venture was established in collaboration with BCG X in 2021 and is headquartered at Woods Augusthus in Copenhagen.

title: Supply Chain Consultant, Central Jutland, Denmark
description:
Six months in Delhi. A career without borders.
Are you ready to take your next career move? This opportunity will take you into the international world of fashion and textile business.Our client is a well-established Scandinavian private label and sourcing company with more than fifteen years of experience serving leading European fashion brands. From its headquarters in Denmark, supported by international sourcing and production teams across Asia and Europe, the business has built a reputation for reliability, long-term partnerships and responsible growth. Today, the company is financially strong, highly respected within the industry and entering an ambitious new phase of international expansion.Having successfully developed a mature sourcing platform in China, the next strategic step is India.

To support that journey, we are looking for an internationally minded Supply Chain Consultant who wants far more than another supply chain position.

A role that starts with an adventure... and becomes a career.
For the first six months, you will be based in Delhi. Not simply visiting suppliers. Not attending occasional meetings. But becoming part of the local organisation, working alongside experienced colleagues and helping establish the processes, collaboration and operational excellence that will support the company's future growth in India.You will experience the business from the inside, build relationships across cultures and gain an understanding of international sourcing that few professionals acquire this early in their careers.When first step og your assignment is complete, you will return to Denmark, continuing in an international position with regular travel between Europe and India, helping connect people, ideas and operations across continents. This is not a temporary assignment. It is the beginning of a long-term international career.

More than supply chain.
You will work with sourcing, production, governance, quality and operational processes. But your real contribution will be something much bigger. You will help transfer proven ways of working into a growing international organisation. You will build relationships between colleagues from different cultures. You will support local teams, develop new ways of working and help ensure that ambitious growth is matched by consistent execution. Success in this role will depend just as much on your ability to earn trust as your ability to optimise processes.

Who are you?
Perhaps you are already working as a Buyer, Merchandiser, Production Coordinator, Supply Chain Specialist or Sourcing Consultant within fashion, textiles or consumer goods.You have developed a solid commercial understanding of production and supply chain and now find yourself looking for something larger than the next promotion. You enjoy responsibility. You are naturally curious. You communicate confidently with people from different cultures. You don't mind leaving your comfort zone if it means accelerating your professional development.And while many people talk about wanting an international career, you are genuinely prepared to live it.Previous experience working with suppliers in India would be highly valued, although your attitude, curiosity and ability to build relationships will be equally important.

Why this opportunity stands out
Few organisations can offer the combination of stability and adventure that this role provides.You will join a profitable, well-established international company with an experienced leadership team, an ambitious growth strategy and a genuine commitment to developing its people.During your assignment in Delhi, accommodation and practical support will be provided, allowing you to focus on the experience itself rather than the logistics. This also means that you will have a driver available, as well as help in the household.More importantly, you will gain something that cannot easily be taught in a classroom or acquired through occasional business travel; international credibility, cross-cultural leadership experience, and the confidence that comes from helping build an organisation across borders.

Interested?
If you are looking for a career that combines international experience, meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to influence how an ambitious organisation grows, we would very much like to hear from you.We make it easy for you, so no written application is necessary. We simply ask you to register with your CV. Your interest will be handled with utmost discretion.

title: Hotelportier for Boutique Hotel Herman K
description:
Portier

We are looking for a professional, courteous, and service-oriented Portier who is passionate about hospitality and creating exceptional guest experiences for our Boutique Hotel in the heart of Copenhagen. As one of the first and last team members our guests encounter, you play a vital role in ensuring every arrival and departure leaves a lasting impression.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys being active throughout the day, and takes pride in delivering service with attention to detail. You are approachable, proactive, and professional, with the ability to remain calm and organized even during busy periods.

As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the daily operation of a luxury 5-star boutique hotel while working alongside dedicated colleagues who share a passion for excellence, teamwork, and genuine hospitality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Welcome guests warmly upon arrival and wish them a memorable farewell upon departure.

  • Assist guests with luggage to and from their rooms.

  • Support the Front Office team with arrivals, departures, and ensuring a seamless check-in experience.

  • Open doors and escort guests throughout the hotel when needed.

  • Provide information about the hotel, its facilities, and local attractions.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming entrance, lobby, and surrounding guest areas.

  • Coordinate with Hosts, Housekeeping, and other departments to deliver a seamless guest experience.

  • Respond promptly and professionally to guest requests with discretion and attention to detail.

  • Assist with luggage storage, deliveries, and other operational tasks as required.

  • Help create a warm, welcoming atmosphere that reflects the hotel's high service standards.

What We Offer

  • A key role in creating memorable first and last impressions for our guests.

  • The opportunity to work in a prestigious luxury 5-star boutique hotel.

  • A varied and dynamic working day with guests from around the world.

  • A supportive and professional team environment where collaboration, hospitality, and respect are at the heart of everything we do.

  • Opportunities for personal and professional development through training, coaching, and continuous learning.

  • A workplace with high ambitions, short decision-making processes, and the freedom to take responsibility.

  • Competitive salary and attractive employee benefits.

What We're Looking For

  • Previous experience in hospitality, customer service, or a guest-facing role is an advantage, but not essential.

  • You are friendly, approachable, and genuinely enjoy creating great guest experiences.

  • You work in a structured and reliable manner while taking responsibility for your tasks.

  • You communicate confidently and professionally in English; additional languages are an advantage.

  • You remain calm under pressure and can maintain a positive attitude during busy periods.

  • You are proactive, solution-oriented, and enjoy working as part of a team.

  • You have excellent attention to detail and take pride in maintaining high standards.

  • You are flexible and comfortable working evenings, weekends, and public holidays as required.

  • If the role includes valet parking, a valid driver's license is an advantage but not required for all candidates.

If you are passionate about luxury hospitality and take pride in creating unforgettable guest experiences, we would love to hear from you.

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application no later than 15 August 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Zeljka Stefanic Urbina at teamlead@hermank.dk. Please include "Portier" in the subject line of your email.

Part of Bühlmann Hotels

Bühlmann Hotels is home to a collection of unique hotels across Denmark, ranging from vibrant city hotels to iconic boutique properties. While each hotel has its own distinctive character, we are united by a shared commitment to exceptional hospitality and the values that define our culture: care, flexibility, presence, passion, and respect for people and the environment.

Learn more about our hotels at www.buhlmann.dk.

title: Instruktor/ Veespordijuhendaja (eFoil – elektriline lendav laud) suvehooajaks
description:
Oleme valmis värbama ka alaealisi. Hooajaline töö mere ääres — õpetad inimesi sõitma elektrilise surfiga, nautima elu ja tundma vabadust

Tööülesanded: Mida sa tegelikult teed?
Sa ei istu kontoris. Sa ei vasta e-kirjadele 8 tundi järjest. Hommikul tuled mere äärde. Päike tõuseb Tallinna lahel. Võtad vastu esimesed külalised — mõned erutunud, mõned natuke hirmul. Annad neile 15-20 minutit ohutusinstruktaaži. Selgitad. Naeratad. Tekitad usalduse. Lähed nendega vette või paadiga kõrval. Näed hetke, kui inimene esimest korda lendab üle vee. Nende nägu ütleb kõik. Filmid neid paadilt, kaldalt — sisu, mis läheb viraalseks. Hoolitsed varustuse eest nagu oma asja eest. Laed akud, puhastd tahvlid, hoiad kogu ala korras ja puhtana. Järgmine klient peab nägema täiuslikku — mitte seda, mis järele jäi. Õhtul — loojang mere kohal. Saun. Ice bath.Jacuzzi. Klientide tänulikud sõnad.

Omalt poolt pakume: Mida sa saad vastu?
→ Tasuta eFoil-sõit! Klientidele see maksab 200€ tunnis. Sinu jaoks — tasuta. → Töö maailma ühe coolima spordiga päikesetõusu ja -loojangu ajal → Tulemustasu + boonused → Sinu nägu on meie sotsiaalmeedia — ehitame koos brändi → Võimalus meiega kasvada — Euroopa, maailm on järgmised → Oled osa millestki, mida pole varem olnud — uue turu ehitamine

Muud nõuded: Keda me otsime?
→ Sa oled füüsiliselt aktiivne — see töö nõuab ikka jõudu, vastupidavust ja liikumist → Sa oskad hästi ujuda ja tunneksid end vabalt avatud vees → Suhtled inimestega loomulikult — see on su tugevus, mitte kohustus → Räägid eesti keelt + inglise ja boonuseks - vene keelt → Oled vastutustundlik ja rahulik ka siis, kui kõik ei lähe plaanipäraselt Me otsime inimest, kes näeb mis on vaja — ja teeb ära. Kes kliendi naeratuse nimel läheb sammu kaugemale ilma, et keegi paluks. Kes vee peal teeb kiireid otsuseid ise — rahulikult, kindlalt. Kes võtab vastutuse enda peale — mitte ei otsi, kelle peale näidata. Positiivsus ei ole siin soov. See on nõue. Energiat, initsiatiivi ja täielikku pühendumist — iga päev, mitte ainult headel päevadel. Suur boonus (aga mitte kohustuslik): → Kogemus surfimises, kite, wake, SUP või muus veespordis → Oled filminud videoid või tead, kuidas Instagram/TikTok toimib → Oled varem töötanud instruktori, giidi või teenindajana Pole kunagi eFoil'i sõitnud? Pole probleemi. Õpetame sind.

title: Electronics Production Technician
description:
Work tasks: The role
As an Electronics Production Technician, you will support the assembly, inspection, testing and rework of electronic components and printed circuit boards used in our products and development systems. You will work closely with our engineering team, following technical documentation and testing procedures, identifying faults and recording results accurately. Your work will help ensure that our electronic assemblies meet the required quality and performance standards. This role is suitable for someone with a vocational background or practical experience in electronics who enjoys precise, hands-on work and wants to develop their skills in an advanced engineering environment. Key responsibilities • Assemble electronic components, printed circuit boards and related systems • Inspect incoming PCB assemblies, components and solder joints visually and under a microscope • Perform soldering, cleaning, handling and rework of PCB assemblies • Carry out electrical measurements and functional testing using standard test equipment and dedicated test rigs • Identify faults, perform initial troubleshooting and escalate complex issues to engineers • Read and follow electronic schematics, datasheets, assembly instructions and testing procedures • Prepare cables, connectors and electronic connections • Record inspection, testing and rework results accurately • Maintain the traceability of components and completed work • Monitor electronic component and consumable inventory and communicate replenishment needs • Provide practical feedback and suggest improvements to assembly, testing and work procedures

We offer: What we offer
• A monthly gross salary of €2394–€3724 depending on your experience and skills • Hands-on work with advanced space and optical communication technology • Close cooperation with electronics, embedded software and mechanical engineers • The opportunity to help establish and improve assembly and testing processes as the company grows • Varied work across electronics assembly, inspection, testing, troubleshooting and production support • A small international team where your contribution has a visible impact on the final product Occasional remote work for suitable tasks may be agreed with the hiring manager. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager.

Other requirements: What we are looking for
Required experience • Vocational education in electronics or equivalent practical experience • Practical experience with electronics assembly and PCB handling • Ability to read electronic schematics, component datasheets and technical instructions • Soldering and PCB rework skills • Ability to use standard electronic test equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes and laboratory power supplies • Ability to identify electronic components and understand their markings and package information • Basic fault-finding and troubleshooting skills • A careful, methodical and quality-focused approach • Ability to follow procedures and document work accurately • English at B2 level or above • Willingness to learn new equipment, processes and techniques We welcome applications from both experienced technicians and strong junior candidates with relevant practical skills and a solid foundation in electronics. Nice to have • Experience with surface-mount and through-hole soldering • Experience using hot-air rework equipment • Experience with FBGA rework or reballing • Experience operating pick-and-place or reflow equipment • Experience testing PCB assemblies using dedicated test rigs • Familiarity with IPC workmanship standards or relevant IPC certification • Experience maintaining production, testing or traceability records • Experience with component inventory and production consumables • Previous experience in electronics production, prototyping or a laboratory environment

title: Myyntihenkinen työnjohtaja autokorjaamoon CarHelp Helsinki
description:
Työnjohtaja – mekaaninen puoli | CarHelp Helsinki

Etsimme **CarHelp Helsingin toimipisteeseen työnjohtajaa mekaaniselle puolelle**.

Tässä tehtävässä et ole vain työnjohtaja – olet tärkeä osa toimipisteen arkea, asiakaspalvelua ja kasvua. Vastaat siitä, että korjaamon päivittäinen toiminta pyörii sujuvasti, asiakkaat saavat hyvää palvelua ja mekaanisen puolen tekeminen kehittyy jatkuvasti.

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on **rohkea, aktiivinen ja myynnillinen ote**. Olet valmis tarttumaan puhelimeen, palvelemaan asiakkaita, tekemään tarjouksia ja hankkimaan uusia asiakkaita. Jos olet lisäksi aktiivinen sosiaalisessa mediassa ja innostut yrityksen näkyvyyden ja asiakaskunnan kasvattamisesta, se on iso plussa.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu:

- Mekaanisten töiden vastaanotto ja aikataulutus (huollot, korjaukset ja diagnostiikka)

- Mekaanikkojen päivittäinen työnjohto, tukeminen ja työnjako

- Aikataulujen, työn laadun ja tehokkuuden seuranta

- Aktiivinen asiakaspalvelu ja myyntityö

- **Tarjousten laskeminen ja tekeminen asiakkaille**

- **Uusien asiakkaiden hankinta ja asiakassuhteiden rakentaminen**

- Asiakkaiden kontaktointi ja yhteydenpito työn eri vaiheissa

- Sujuvan ja hyvän asiakaskokemuksen varmistaminen

- Yhteydenpito varaosatoimittajiin sekä kustannustehokkuuden seuranta

- Tarvittaessa osallistuminen tekniseen selvitykseen ja diagnostiikkaan

- Toimiminen linkkinä työntekijöiden, asiakkaiden ja yritysjohdon välillä

- Korjaamon toiminnan kehittäminen ja **uuden myynnin aktiivinen rakentaminen**

- **Sosiaalisen median hyödyntäminen asiakashankinnassa ja toimipisteen näkyvyyden kasvattamisessa** – aktiivisuus somessa katsotaan eduksi


Tässä tehtävässä onnistut, kun sinulla on:

- Kokemusta autokorjaamon työnjohdosta **tai vahva tausta mekaanisesta autokorjaamotyöstä**

- Rohkea, oma-aloitteinen ja myyntihenkinen ote asiakastyöhön

- Hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja johtamistaidot

- Kyky tehdä itsenäisiä päätöksiä ja ottaa vastuuta

- Hyvä kokonaisuuksien hallinta ja stressinsietokyky

- Halua kehittää toimintaa ja kasvattaa toimipistettä

- **Asiakashankintaan ja myyntiin motivoitunut asenne**

- Hyvä suomen kielen taito

- Reipas ja puhelias persoona – et pelkää tarttua puhelimeen tai ottaa yhteyttä asiakkaaseen

- **Sosiaalisen median tuntemus ja aktiivisuus katsotaan selkeäksi eduksi**


Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän kasvavassa yrityksessä

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa aidosti omaan työhösi ja **Helsingin toimipisteen kehittämiseen**

- Mahdollisuuden olla mukana rakentamassa ja kasvattamassa toimipistettä

- Kilpailukykyisen palkan osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan

- Hyvät työvälineet ja selkeät prosessit

- Tiimin ja johdon täyden tuen

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa rooliasi yrityksen kasvun mukana

- Pitkäaikaisen työmahdollisuuden oikealle henkilölle


**Jos olet henkilö, joka ei halua vain odottaa asiakkaita vaan haluaa itse tehdä, myydä, kehittää ja kasvattaa toimintaa, haluamme kuulla sinusta.**

title: Project Planner
description:
Join the team of bold professionals at Enersense! We are now hiring a Project Planner for a permanent position. The preferred work location would be Pori or Rauma but working from other Enersense offices or remotely is also possible.

The open position is within our Energy Transition business unit, where we help our customers improve the reliability of their production facilities and enhance maintenance operations. We deliver demanding project implementations for industrial projects. We develop digital solutions to improve productivity, manage the overall maintenance and reliability of our customers' production plants, and provide resource and contracting services as well as subcontracting chain management services for domestic and international industrial projects.

Job responsibilities:
* Create and manage detailed master construction schedules and project control procedures for live projects
* Prepare and present progress updates and performance reports to senior management
* Manage your assigned project, ensuring progress is on track while assisting other team members as needed
* Liaise with project stakeholders to review progress, identify risks, and proactively solve issues
* Develop schedules for the pre-construction, construction, and commissioning phases, ensuring progress reporting is consistently updated
* Establish resource requirements for project schedules and communicate tools for achieving project goals
* Provide performance updates and reports, identifying variances and taking corrective actions as needed

Requirements:
* Degree in Engineering, Construction Management or a related technical field
* At least 2 years of relevant planning experience in industrial projects
* Strong analytical and logical thinking skills, combined with excellent organizational skills
* Good IT skills, including proficiency in using project scheduling tools, mainly Primavera P6
* Ability to work independently with a strong sense of responsibility
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with project stakeholders
* Experience in managing challenging timelines and delivering results under pressure
* Fluent English is required, Finnish is considered as an advantage

The application period ends on 30.8.2026. However, please send your application as soon as possible, as we may begin interviews during the application period and fill the position once the right candidate is found.

For more information about the position, please contact: Jonna Katavisto, Talent Acquisition Partner, +358 44 360 6783, jonna.katavisto@enersense.com. Call times Fri 14.8. between 11-12 and Wed 24.8. between 14-15.

Odotamme sinulta vastuunottokykyä, joustavuutta ja yhteistyökykyä. Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja siihen sisältyy ilta- ja lauantaitöitä. Tehtävään palkattavan henkilön tulee olla 18 vuotta täyttänyt. Tehtävässä vaaditaan sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

Tehtävään valitun on toimitettava nähtäväksi lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen voimassa oleva rikosrekisteriote 30 päivän kuluessa valintapäätöksen tiedoksisaannista.
Työsuhde alkaa 1.9.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Tehtävässä on kuuden kuukauden koeaika.

Työajan määrittää uimahallin toiminnat ja aukioloajat maanantaista lauantaihin. Palkkaus määräytyy KVTES:n mukaisesti. Lisäksi maksamme rekrytointilisän.

Henkilön tulee haastattelun jälkeen antaa opetus- ja ohjausnäytöt sekä suorittaa hengenpelastajan testiuinti hyväksytysti läpi.

Samtliga klienter har en kontaktperson som bland annat ansvarar för planering av insatser, uppföljning och att ge information. Dokumentation är en viktig del av det dagliga arbetet.

title: Veneasentaja / -huoltaja (Tampere)
description:
Etsimme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen veneenasentajaa / venehuoltajaa Tampereelle!

Tässä tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten veneiden ja niiden tekniikan parissa. Toivomme sinulta aiempaa kokemusta veneistä ja niiden mekaniikasta, mutta ennen kaikkea innostunutta ja tekemiseen tarttuvaa asennetta.

Venealan aiempi kokemus on plussaa tähä tehtävään, mutta tärkeintä on oikea asenne ja kiinnostus tekniikkaan. Venealan kokemuksen lisäksi tehtävään sopii erinomaisesti esimerkiksi autonasentajan taustalla oleva tekijä tai henkilö, jolla on kokemusta erilaisten moottorikäyttöisten laitteiden huoltamisesta ja korjaamisesta. Jos moottorit, mekaniikka ja käsillä tekeminen ovat sinun juttusi, tässä voisi olla seuraava työpaikkasi.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

\- Kokemusta veneistä ja niiden mekaniikasta tai vahvaa mekaanista osaamista esimerkiksi autonasentajan tehtävistä

\- Kokemusta moottorikäyttöisten laitteiden huoltamisesta ja korjaamisesta

\- Oma-aloitteista ja reipasta työotetta

\- Joustavuutta ja halua oppia uutta

\- Kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä

Mitä tarjoamme?

\- Tarjoamme sinulle vakituinen työpaikan, jossa pääset osaksi tiivistä ja asiantuntevaa työporukkaa. Työaika on 37,5 h/vko.

\- Palkan kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan

\- Mahdollisuuden oppia venealasta lisää

Venealalla kevät ja kesä ovat kiireisintä sesonkia, jolloin tekemistä riittää vauhdilla. Syksyllä tahti hieman rauhoittuu, mutta hommaa ja tehtävää riittää ympäri vuoden. Talvikaudella työ painottuu muun muassa veneiden huoltoihin, korjauksiin, kunnostuksiin ja muihin hallin töihin.Työskentelet tiiviissä tiimissä, jossa ympärilläsi on todellisia venealan ammattilaisia. Tässä porukassa pääset kehittämään omaa osaamistasi ja kartuttamaan tietämystäsi veneistä, moottoreista ja niiden toiminnasta.

Osaavalle tekijälle on töitä tarjolla heti. Työsuhde alkaa Click Henkilöstöpalveluiden kautta, ja tavoitteena on vakituinen työsuhde.

title: Projektledare till projektet AI Boost Västra Nyland, deltid
description:
Vill du vara med och stärka företagens konkurrenskraft i framtidens digitala arbetsliv?

Projektet AI Boost Västra Nyland syftar till att stärka småföretags kompetens inom artificiell intelligens (AI) och digital transformation i Västra Nyland. Genom samarbete mellan Yrkeshögskolan Novia, företagarföreningar, kommuner, företag och studerande utvecklas företagens förmåga att använda AI i praktiken för att effektivisera verksamheten, utveckla nya arbetssätt och skapa hållbar tillväxt

Projektet genomförs i samarbete med Hangö Företagare rf, Företagarna i Raseborg och Hangö stad. Projektet omfattar bland annat behovskartläggningar, workshops, kunskaps- och resursverkstäder, nätverksbyggande, samarbete med studerande samt utveckling av en öppen digital plattform för kunskapsspridning. title: Data Center IT management Engineer
description:
**Responsibilities**

Team Insight: The DataCenter Service / Datacenter Cloud System (DCS) team sits within TikTok's global technology structure and supports the company's fast growth by building and operating hyper-scale datacenters, managing the life cycle of server fleet, providing cloud solutions, and developing various infrastructure services, making sure they are scalable and are reliable.

Role Insight: We are seeking an experienced Data Center Operations Engineers to apply technical expertise in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. This role requires strong knowledge of server hardware and a foundational understanding of mechanical and electrical infrastructure in large-scale data centers. You will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving server and infrastructure issues, collaborating with remote teams, and supporting the full server rack lifecycle, including buildout of compute and storage environments. In addition, you will lead and guide DC Technicians, ensuring high-quality execution of operational tasks and adherence to best practices. Candidates should have hands-on experience in at least one of the following areas: Networking, Scripting, or Hardware Repair. Success in this role requires strong communication skills, the ability to work independently and within a team, and adaptability in a rapidly changing environment.

Responsibilities:

\- Own day-to-day IT infrastructure operations across assigned data centre sites, ensuring uptime and SLA compliance for all break-fix activity.

\- Lead daily operations by guiding Data Center Technicians and overseeing task allocation, hardware troubleshooting, maintenance, and diagnostics.

\- Manage the full incident and change lifecycle, resolving incidents to SLA, executing changes under formal change control, and leading root cause analysis and corrective actions to closure.

\- Track and report IT operational performance metrics, including availability, MTTR, ticket ageing, first-time fix, break-fix volumes, and rack capacity utilisation, using trend analysis to drive continuous improvement.

\- Manage data centre IT on-site stability, identifying risk events and driving improvement initiatives to enhance stability and reduce operational errors.

\- Support data centre projects and operational improvements, including capacity expansions, retrofits, infrastructure upgrades, and implementation of new tools and processes; support new site builds and operational handover readiness.

\- Maintain and improve site documentation (SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, escalation matrices), build strong cross-functional relationships, act as an escalation point, and identify recurring issues to drive vendor escalation and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

Minimum Qualifications:

\- 5+ years of experience in data centre operations, IT infrastructure, hardware support, and structured cabling in a live data centre environment.

\- Strong hands-on knowledge of server, storage, and network hardware, including component-level diagnostics and replacement.

\- Capable of server disassembly, hardware replacement, rack deployment, and hardware fault diagnosis with component-level troubleshooting across server and rack systems.

\- Basic Linux OS administration and BMC/BIOS configuration skills.

\- Basic understanding of critical facility infrastructure (UPS, generators, PDUs, CRAC/CRAH, cooling topology) to work safely alongside facilities teams.

\- Competent with DCIM, ticketing, and monitoring platforms, with the ability to analyse ticket data to identify recurring faults and support IT infrastructure performance.

\- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to report to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications

\- Relevant certification such as CDCP, CDCS, ITIL Foundation, CompTIA Server+, or CCNA.

\- Experience in large-scale data centre environments. - Strong working knowledge of data centre power infrastructure and cooling systems, with proven competence in identifying server overheating risks and responding to power emergencies.

\- Hands-on experience operating and maintaining GPU servers and integrated rack systems, including hardware troubleshooting on GB300, B200, or comparable GPU platforms (e.g., GPU error analysis, NVLink fault diagnosis).

\-Experience coordinating vendors, outsourced technicians, or smart-hand resources on site.

\- Experience supporting projects, incident management, or small team leadership.

\- Willingness to participate in on-call rotation and travel to other sites as required.

description:
Me etsimme heimoomme innostunutta ja huippua tyyppiä, jolla hymy ei hyydy ja jonka tiimitaidot ovat huipussaan. Vapaus, heimous, nälkä ja sydän - nämä ovat arvoja, jotka ohjaavat meidän toimintaamme ja ovat yhteisen tekemisemme peruskallio.

Sä olet taatusti täydellinen tyyppi meidän heimoon, mikäli...

- ...sulla on kyky vastaanottaa "vapautta", tehdä ja toteuttaa. Me nimittäin pyritään jakamaan vapautta ja halutaankin, että sen voimin sä vaikutat, osallistut ja otat vastuuta arjesta ja osastostasi sekä sen toiminnasta.
- ...sulla on heimoutta eli oikeaa tiimipelaamisen taikaa. Meidän mielestä hyvän heimon voimatekijöitä ovat luottamus, kunnioitus, avoimuus ja menestymisen asenne. Hyvä heimo muodostaa toimivan tiimikulttuurin, mikä on edellytys huipputuloksiin pääsemiselle. Meidän heimon kulttuurissa vaaditaan, että asiat käsitellään keskustellen kasvokkain eikä selän takana juoruillen ja yhteistä tekemistä sabotoiden. Mikäli siis rakastat ihmisten välistä draamaa ja villejä käänteitä, ei tämä paikka ole sulle.
- ...sulla on nälkää tehdä hommia hyvällä draivilla ja haluat menestyä tiiminä. Haastat itseäsi menemään kohti uusia jännittäviä tilanteita, ja olet valmis oppimisen uhalla myös mokaamaan.
- ...sulla on sydäntä heittäytyä tekemiseen täysillä, antaa ja vastaanottaa palautetta sekä olla valmis kasvamaan ja kehittämään itseäsi ja ajatteluasi. Ymmärrät, että ainoa pysyvä asia on muutos, ja haluat olla siinä mukana.

Tää kaupan työ on hurjan monipuolista ja asioita tehdään ripeällä tahdilla! Meillä on huikeat asiakkaat, jotka pyritään aina kohtaamaan aidosti, lämpimällä ja rempseällä otteella. Ihanien asiakkaiden lisäksi meillä on huikea tiimi eli heimo, jolla duunia painaa! Tässä työssä sä työskentelet myyjänä molemmissa toimipisteissämme K-Market Kissanmaalla ja K-Market Ilmarinkadulla. Työajat painottuvat pitkälti arki-iltoihin sekä viikonlopun vuoroihin.

Odotamme sulta...

- Me odotetaan sulta tähän rooliin kokemusta päivittäistavarakaupasta ja sen monipuolisesta maailmasta. Me odotetaan, että sulla on oikea asenne, osaat tehdä virheitä ja oppia niistä, haluat kasvaa ja kehittyä tiimissä ja oot valmis heittäytymään uuteen ennakkoluulottomasti. Mikäli sä oot huikee tyyppi huikeella asenteella, tuut oppimaan miten meillä toimitaan.
- Psst! Vaaditaan sulta 18 vuoden ikää!

Tarjoamme sulle:

- Me tarjotaan sulle kaikki yllä mainittu eli ihana heimo, huikeat asiakkaat sekä kehittyvä ja ajan hermoilla taituroivat K-Marketit. Me tarjotaan sulle kuuntelevaa ja heimolaisiaan arvostavaa johtajuutta ja kulttuuria, jossa epäkohdat nostetaan matalalla kynnyksellä esille.
- Psst! Lisäksi tarjotaan sulle tottakai kattavat K-ryhmän henkilökuntaedut!

Työsuhde alkaa elo-syyskuun aikana.

Lähetä hakemuksesi osoitteeseen joona.pesonen@k-market.com / matilda.tistelgren@k-market.com. Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, kuitenkin viimeistään 23.8.2026

Me K-ryhmässä arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja uskomme, että erilaiset taustat ja näkökulmat ovat avain menestykseen. Pyrimme luomaan työympäristön, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä. title: Toyota ja Nissan -työnjohtaja
description:
Tule rakentamaan autoalan tulevaisuutta kanssamme!

Suomen Autohuolto Oy on voimakkaasti kasvava, henkilö- ja hyötyajoneuvojen merkkihuoltoon keskittynyt edelläkävijä ja yli 170 ammattilaisen työpaikka. Olemme valtuutettu merkkihuolto ja varaosajälleenmyyjä 14 huippumerkille: BMW, Citroën, Cupra, Ford, Hyundai, Mercedes-Benz, Nissan, Opel, Peugeot, Seat, Škoda, Toyota, Volkswagen ja Volvo. Palvelemme asiakkaitamme kuudessa toimipisteessä Oulussa, Tampereella ja Järvenpäässä, minkä lisäksi vauriokorjauksiin erikoistunut tytäryhtiömme Korimekaanikot Pirkanmaa Oy operoi kolmessa pisteessä Pirkanmaalla ja toimii Teslan valtuutettuna vauriokorjaamona. Huollamme ja korjaamme toimipisteissämme yli 50 000 ajoneuvoa vuosittain. Yhteensä 31 miljoonan euron liikevaihtomme ja tuloksentekokykymme takaa sinulle vakaan ja kehittyvän työympäristön – liity tiimiimme!

Haemme nyt työnjohtajaa/huoltoneuvojaa Ouluun Toyota ja Nissan -merkkihuollon toimipisteeseemme.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu muun muassa puhelimitse tai digitaalisia kanavia pitkin tulevien asiakaskontaktien käsittely, yleinen asiakaspalvelu, töiden vastaanottaminen/luovuttaminen, yhteydenpito Toyotan ja Nissanin maahantuojiin sekä mekaanikkojemme varauskalenterin hallinta. Meillä pääset työskentelemään osana Toyotan ja Nissanin maailmanlaajuista huoltoverkostoa.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

\- Vakituisen työn autoalan kasvuyrityksessä

\- Asiantuntevan tiimimme sekä Toyota ja Nissan maahantuojien ja valmistajatehtaiden tuen jatkuvalle kehittymisellesi autoalan ammattilaiseksi

\- Valmistajatehtaan/maahantuojan merkkikohtaisen koulutuspolun

\- Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen

Odotamme sinulta:

\- Hyvää ja reipasta asennetta työtä kohtaan

\- Vahvaa asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä sekä halua oppia jatkuvasti uutta

\- Aiempaa kokemusta asiakaspalvelutyöstä sekä autoalalta

Tavoitteenamme on tehdä työmme tehokkaasti ja olla asiakaspalvelussa alamme parhaimmistoa, joten odotamme että jaat nämä tavoitteet kanssamme. Kaikille uusille työntekijöillemme pidetään talon oma perehdytysjakso, mutta koulutus ja oppiminen ei lopu siihen. Tarjoamme tehtävään maahantuojan ja tehtaan koulutusputket. Ammattitaitoa ylläpidetään myös säännöllisin täydennys- ja päivityskoulutuksin.

Katsomme eduksesi aiemman kokemuksen Autofutur -järjestelmästä ja/tai merkkihuoltoympäristöstä, mutta tärkeimpinä ominaisuuksina pidämme oikeaa asennetta työntekoon sekä reipasta asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä.
