title: Sozialarbeiter_in / Sozialpädagog_in (m/w/d) für unsere Zentrale Anlaufstelle (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
description:
Der Caritasverband für Stuttgart e.V. (CVS) ist der Wohlfahrtsverband der Katholischen Kirche in Stuttgart. Die Zentrale Anlaufstelle (ZAS) ist eine Beratungsstelle für neuzugewanderte Unionsbürger_innen, die wohnungslos oder von Wohnungslosigkeit bedroht sind. Die Betroffenen sind in der Regel vom Zugang zum regulären Hilfesystem und Transferleistungen ausgeschlossen. Der Dienst wird in Kooperation mit der Evangelischen Gesellschaft geführt und ist Teil des Fachdienstes Offene Hilfen im Bereich Armut Wohnungslosigkeit und Schulden (CVS).

Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt für unsere Zentrale Anlaufstelle eine_n

Sozialarbeiter_in / Sozialpädagog_in (m/w/d)

Stellenumfang 50%, unbefristet

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Beratung und aufsuchende Arbeit von wohnungslosen Unionsbürger_innen: Alleinstehenden, Paaren und Familien
- Beratung bei existenziellen Notlagen, ggf. Zuweisung in Notübernachtungsplätze, sowie Anbindung an das Wohnungsnotfallhilfesystem
- Enge Zusammenarbeit und Kooperation mit Einrichtungen und Diensten des gesamten Hilfesystems in Stuttgart, Netzwerkarbeit

Wir bieten Ihnen:

- Eine interessante und sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem großen Sozialunternehmen
- Umfangreiche Angebote und Vergünstigungen im Bereich Fortbildungen, Gesundheitsförderung, Sport und Kultur, Job Rad
- Vergütung bei einer 39h-Woche und Erfüllung aller fachlichen Qualifikationen S12 AVR (3.967€ - 5.454€ entspr. Berufserfahrung) plus Jahressonderzahlung
- Mitarbeit in einem engagierten, qualifizierten Team; Supervision

Sie bringen mit:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium als Sozialarbeiter_in oder Sozialpädagoge_in
- Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität in der Beratung von Menschen in existenziellen Notlagen
- Ein besonderes Engagement für den Personenkreis
- Gute rechtliche Grundlagen im SGB II und SGB XII
- Selbständiges, strukturiertes und sorgfältiges Arbeiten
- Osteuropäische Sprachkompetenzen sind sehr erwünscht

Bunt ist schön. Bei uns ist jede und jeder willkommen – unabhängig von Alter, Behinderung, Religion, ethnischer Herkunft oder sexueller Identität.

Ihre Bewerbung senden Sie bitte bevorzugt online über unsere Bewerbermaske oder per E-Mail (max. 12 MB) bis 07.09.2026 an Bewerbung-AWS@caritas-stuttgart.de

Für Rückfragen steht Ihnen Frau Schiefelbein-Beck gerne telefonisch unter 0711 23879-65 zur Verfügung.

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Termelési Operátor (famegmunkáló) (Operator/in (EDV))
description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Jelenleg Debrecenben működő telephelyünkre keressük új kollégánkat Termelési Operátor (famegmunkáló) pozícióba.

Az Ön feladatai

- Fából és OSB lapokból készült ládák, rekeszek, speciális raklapok és speciális szerkezetek gyártása ipari termékek csomagolásához
- Csomagolási alapanyagként használt fólia hegesztése
- A fenti termékek gyártásához használt modern famegmunkáló gépek, berendezések, illetve kéziszerszámok rendeltetésszerű, magabiztos használata (lapszabász gép, fűrészgép, oszlopos fúrógép, gérvágó, szegbelövő, behajtó, kapcsozó)
- Az előkészített komponensekből a leírások alapján a késztermékek összeállítása
- A biztonságos munkavégzéshez kapcsolódó előírások betartása
- Belső működési szabványaink és folyamataink betartása
- A munkakörnyezet rendjének, tisztaságának fenntartása

Elvárások

- Fa és a faalapú anyagok feldolgozásával és kezelésével kapcsolatos tapasztalat
- Faipari eszközök, kézi szerszámok magbiztos és biztonságos használatának képessége
- Műszaki érzék/ismeret
- Jó térlátás
- Terhelhetőség
- Körültekintő munkavégzés, rugalmasság
- Kétműszakos beosztás vállalása (H-P 06:00-14:00, illetve 14:00-22:00 heti váltásban)
- Csapatjátékos hozzáállás
- Targoncavezetői vagy darukezelői jogosítvány előny, de nem feltétele a jelentkezésnek
- Előny faipari szakképzettség vagy több éves tapasztalat ipari termékek előállításában

Hogyan tudjuk inspirálni?

- Megbízható, stabil, folyamatosan fejlődő munkáltató
- Piacnak megfelelő alapbér
- Negyedéves bónusz
- Céges kedvezménykártya
- 2 műszakos munkarend, Mt. szerinti pótlékok
- Hosszú távú növekedési lehetőség egy piacvezető nemzetközi vállalatnál

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. . Handle warranty claims via phone and email.

. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.

. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.

. Professional development opportunities.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

title: Associate Development Director and Advisor
description:
About Contradictum Advisory ehf.

Contradictum Advisory ehf. is a startup dedicated to advising international intellectual property holders in the management and licensing their assets with the objective to steer part of that revenue stream into underfunded projects in Iceland.  Particular emphasis is placed on projects that both serve an immediate domestic need in Iceland and that would meet eligibility requirements under the European Union Green Bond Standard and qualify for the Nordic Swan ecolabel.
Associate Development Director and Advisor.

This is a client-facing position comprised of two primary areas of competence.  The first is in providing advisory and consulting services to intellectual property owners in the North American Market with respect to the use, management, and monetization of their IP portfolios.  The second is in facilitating the investment of IP derived revenue into Iceland-based projects.  Our customer base is comprised of individuals, privately held companies, and family offices who are open diversifying their holdings in EEA and EFTA jurisdictions.  Your role will be to effectively assist clients with maximizing IP derived revenue and presenting opportunities to invest that revenue into target projects in Iceland.  A solid understanding of intellectual property, contracts, procurement processes is essential.  

Main tasks and Responsibilities:
•    Provide strategic direction to clients with respect to intellectual property licensing within the relevant jurisdictional frameworks of each client portfolio.
•    Prepare and present pitch decks to potential investment partners.  
•    Develop investment-ready Iceland-based project proposals.
•    Manage and develop local network of interested counterpart stakeholder and professional service providers related to each project proposal.
•    Identify and liaise with potential new high-net-worth individual investors and small-midsized family office clients in North, Central, and South American markets.
•    Demonstrate extraordinary discretion in all interactions with clients, maintaining the utmost in confidentiality and candor.

Education and licensing:
•    Advanced university-level business or legal education required.  Doctorate of Jurisprudence or Masters of Business Administration with coursework in contracts or international transactions from a top university strongly preferred.
•    Educational coursework in environmental or natural resources usage from an Icelandic University preferred.
•    Admittance to practice before to any US Federal Court.
•    Membership in any North America-based First Nation or Tribal Bar Association strongly preferred.

Qualification Requirements:
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in intellectual property licensing.
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in real property development or prime-contractor representation is highly desirable
•    Minimum 3years of experience in international transactions is highly desirable.
•    Solid Understanding of USPTO and EUIPO standards and procedures.
•    Knowledge of securities and BizOp regulatory standards and requirements is highly desirable.
•    Ability to operate effectively in a multi-time-zone framework convenient to international client domestic work hours.

Language Skills:  Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation English skills are essential.  Additional languages are beneficial.
English [Required] Expert Level
Icelandic [Optional] Intermediate
Spanish [Optional] Intermediate

Compensation:
Compensation is chiefly commission based plus a minimum base salary of 500,000 ISK per month.

Work Hours:
Flexible working hours generally overlapping with the North American Market.  Schedule is expected to vary based on specific client/project needs.

title: Animal Care Manager
description:
The Beluga Operating Company ehf is seeking an animal care manager.

What you'll bring to the team
Lead the Future of Beluga Whale Conservation
Imagine waking up each day knowing your work is helping shape the future of one of the world's most unique marine conservation projects.

At the SEA LIFE TRUST Beluga Whale Sanctuary, you'll lead an experienced team dedicated to providing world-class care for Little Grey and Little White, our resident belugas, while also overseeing the welfare of rescued puffins and our aquarium collection.


This is far more than an animal care management role. It's an opportunity to combine exceptional leadership, animal welfare expertise and conservation passion at the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.

If you're an inspiring leader with extensive experience working with cetaceans or large marine mammals, we'd love to hear from you.


As our Animal Care Manager (Curator), you'll lead all aspects of animal care, welfare and husbandry across the sanctuary.

Working closely with the General Manager and the wider SEA LIFE TRUST and Merlin Entertainments teams, you'll ensure our animals receive exceptional care while supporting scientific research, conservation, education and unforgettable guest experiences.


You'll lead, coach and develop a passionate team of animal care professionals whilst ensuring the highest standards of welfare, safety and operational excellence.

What You'll Be Doing
Leading World-Class Animal Care
Lead the care, health and welfare of our resident beluga whales, puffins and aquarium animals.
Oversee animal husbandry, enrichment, operant conditioning and behavioural management.
Ensure excellent standards across all animal habitats and life support systems.
Drive continual improvements in animal welfare and husbandry practices.
Leading and Developing People
Inspire, coach and develop a highly skilled animal care team.
Create a culture of collaboration, continuous learning and professional development.
Provide leadership during day-to-day operations and emergency response situations.
Ensure clear performance expectations and high professional standards.
Conservation & Collaboration
Work alongside veterinarians, conservation partners, researchers and animal welfare specialists.
Provide expert advice to the SEA LIFE TRUST, Merlin Entertainments and external stakeholders on cetacean care.
Support ongoing conservation programmes and future sanctuary developments.
Operational Excellence
Manage departmental budgets, veterinary services and critical animal care resources.
Ensure compliance with animal welfare legislation, licensing requirements and health & safety standards.
Oversee record keeping, husbandry documentation and life support operations.
Participate in the animal care call-out rota.
Inspiring Others
Help bring conservation to life by engaging with guests, media and local communities.
Support educational programmes and public awareness initiatives.
Act as an ambassador for the SEA LIFE TRUST and our conservation mission.
Qualifications & Experience
We're looking for someone who combines exceptional technical expertise with outstanding leadership.

You'll ideally have:

Essential
At least 10 years' experience working within a cetacean, aquarium or zoological environment, including significant leadership experience.
Extensive knowledge of marine mammal behaviour, training and welfare.
Proven experience leading and developing professional animal care teams.
Strong understanding of operant conditioning, enrichment and husbandry.
Excellent communication and decision-making skills.
Strong swimming ability and confidence working in open water.
Ability to work from boats and in challenging marine environments.
Fluent English.
Ability to obtain the legal right to live and work in Iceland.
Desirable
Degree in Zoology, Biology or a related discipline.
Experience with Life Support Systems (LSS).
Drysuit or cold-water diving qualifications.
PADI Rescue Diver (or higher).
Veterinary technical experience.
Bird rehabilitation experience.
First Aid qualification.
Experience handling cetaceans in open-water environments.
Benefits
This isn't just another animal care leadership role.

You'll be joining one of the world's most recognised marine conservation charities and helping shape the future of marine mammal welfare.

You'll have the opportunity to:

Lead the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.
Work with internationally respected animal welfare experts.
Influence global conservation and welfare standards.
Develop and mentor an exceptional animal care team.
Make a genuine difference to the lives of marine animals every single day.
Live and work in the stunning natural surroundings of Iceland.
About the SEA LIFE TRUST
The SEA LIFE TRUST is a global marine conservation charity dedicated to protecting the world's oceans and marine wildlife through conservation, education and campaigning.

Our Beluga Whale Sanctuary in Iceland provides a safe, natural environment for formerly captive beluga whales while inspiring millions of people to care for our oceans.

Together, we're creating a future where marine life can thrive.

If you're an experienced animal care leader who shares our passion for conservation, welfare and exceptional animal care, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of marine conservation.

title: Join Iceland´s Acute Medicine Team - Consultant Physician
description:
Join Iceland's Acute Medicine Team - Consultant Physician

Help Shape the Future of Acute and Internal Medicine in Iceland

Are you an ambitious and enthusiastic Consultant Physician looking for an opportunity to make a lasting impact? Would you like to build a career with purpose in one of the world's most beautiful, and progressive countries?

Landspitali is undertaking one of the largest transformations of urgent and emergency care in its history. We are seeking Consultant Physicians in Internal Medicine and/or Acute Internal Medicine to join our multidisciplinary team as we design, develop and deliver the next generation of emergency services in Iceland working in a leading university hospital committed to innovation, education, and research.

Experience an outstanding work-life balance in Reykjavík, where a vibrant capital city meets spectacular nature. Physicians' standard daytime working hours are based on a 36-hour working week. Enjoy safe communities, short commutes, world-class outdoor adventures, excellent schools and healthcare, and easy access to Europe and North America.

Landspitali is developing a new integrated model of urgent and emergency care focused on:
•    Improving patient flow
•    Delivering safer, more efficient and person-centered care
•    Developing innovative pathways for acutely ill patients

Successful applicants will play a key role in developing several new clinical services, including:
•    Acute Medical Unit (AMU)
•    Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC)
•    Hospital at Home

Why join Landspitali we offer:
•    A rewarding consultant-level position
•    Opportunities to take on leadership roles in developing new services
•    Close collaboration with experienced multidisciplinary teams
•    An academic environment where clinical excellence, research, teaching and innovation go hand in hand
•    The opportunity to contribute to a transformation that will benefit thousands of patients every year
•    Excellent opportunities to achieve a healthy work life balance.
•    A supportive working environment that values staff wellbeing and professional development.
•    Structured Icelandic language training, including formal courses and digital learning resources.

The position is full-time (100%) or as otherwise agreed and is available immediately or by mutual agreement.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:
•    Clinical work across inpatient wards, the Acute Medical Assessment Unit (AMAU), and Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC) services
•    Participation in the General Internal Medicine inpatient admitting team
•    Participation in the General Internal Medicine on-call rota
•    Teaching and supervision of medical students and resident doctors in training
•    Opportunities to participate in research activities
•    Participation in quality improvement and patient safety initiative
•    Contributing to the ongoing development of Acute Medicine and General Internal Medicine services

QUALIFICATIONS:
•    Specialist registration (or equivalent) in General Internal Medicine, Acute Internal Medicine, or Family Medicine/General Practice with an emphasis on Acute Care
•    Broad clinical experience in Acute and/or General Internal Medicine
•    Excellent communication and the ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team
•    A commitment to quality improvement, innovation and the development of high-value healthcare services.

Salary according to the current collective agreement concluded by the Minister of Finance and the Economy and the Medical Association of Iceland. It also depends on factors such as additional education, professional experience, and years of service. Physicians who are fully dedicated to the position in Landspítali may also receive an additional 15% salary premium in accordance with the collective agreement.

description:

We are seeking an experienced and proactive Facilities Manager to oversee the delivery of hard and soft facilities services on site for a major account. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for managing day-to-day operations, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, and maintaining high standards of service delivery across multiple stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Operational Management Manage the day-to-day delivery of hard and soft facilities services across the contract. Lead, motivate, and develop the on-site service delivery team. Scope, manage, and verify minor works projects. Coordinate contractors and ensure works are completed safely, efficiently, and to specification. Manage permit-to-work and safe systems of work processes. Client & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary operational point of contact for the client and key stakeholders. Build and maintain strong working relationships through effective communication and service delivery. Attend client meetings and provide operational updates and performance reporting. Resolve issues promptly and professionally while maintaining a customer-focused approach. Health, Safety & Compliance Ensure compliance with all relevant health and safety legislation and company policies. Lead safety initiatives including toolbox talks, safety walks, and near-miss reporting. Monitor contractor compliance and site safety performance. Promote a strong culture of safety and continuous improvement across all service lines. Financial & Contract Management Monitor lifecycle expenditure and ensure spending remains within agreed budgets. Manage materials ordering and cost control processes. Support small works estimation and project delivery. Understand and interpret contractual requirements to ensure compliance and value delivery. Administration & Reporting Maintain accurate contract documentation, records, and compliance files. Produce operational, maintenance, and performance reports as required. Coordinate site inductions and onboarding activities. Manage payroll and timekeeping processes for site-based teams. Maintain lifecycle plans, budgets, and performance data. About You Essential Experience & Skills Previous Facilities Management experience in a management or supervisory capacity. Experience managing both hard and soft FM services. Strong people management and leadership skills. Experience working in a client-facing environment.

description: Sei un giovane Diplomato a cui piacerebbe lavorare in un contesto dinamico e attento alla formazione delle risorse? Questa è l'opportunità giusta per TE! GI Group SpA, in partnership con Rotolito SpA, storica azienda italiana che opera nel settore della carta stampata e leader nelle arti grafiche, cerca persone motivate a iniziare un nuovo percorso formativo-lavorativo (IFTS) progettato in collaborazione con l'Istituto Formazione Operatori Aziendali (IFOA) da inserire come ADDETTA/O MANUTENZIONE MACCHINE STAMPA Il ruolo ha lo scopo di prevenire e riparare i guasti dei macchinari tipografici o industriali. Garantisce il corretto funzionamento della linea produttiva, riducendo al minimo i tempi di fermo macchina e assicurando la qualità del prodotto stampato. Di cosa si tratta? Sarai assunto/a con un Contratto di Apprendistato di 1° Livello, che ti permetterà di acquisire competenze orientate all'innovazione tecnologica in ambito: - Tecnologie dei processi di produzione (Processi grafici, materie prime, macchine, attrezzature); - Controllo qualità del prodotto; - Certificazioni di processo; - Logistica industriale; che verranno certificate attraverso il rilascio di un titolo di studio (Certificato di Specializzazione Tecnica Superiore) subito spendibile nel mercato del lavoro italiano ed europeo. Quali sono i vantaggi di questo percorso? Formazione teorica e pratica fornita da esperti del settore; Opportunità di apprendere e lavorare in un ambiente stimolante e innovativo; Possibilità di assunzione stabile presso l'azienda al completamento del percorso formativo previa valutazione positiva del percorso; La ricerca è rivolta a Candidati/e di età compresa tra 18-24 anni, in possesso di Diploma di Istruzione Secondaria Superiore Superiore o del quarto anno di IeFP di tipo Tecnico. Si offre inserimento con contratto di Apprendistato di 1° Livello in somministrazione di circa 9 mesi, in partenza a novembre, finalizzato ad una stabilizzazione a lungo termine. QIBIT, divisione ICT di Gi Group, è specializzata nella selezione, formazione, inserimento e sviluppo professionale di giovani talenti dell'IT per il mercato italiano. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati nelle loro prime esperienze lavorative, quindi a trasformare il proprio potenziale in percorsi professionali appaganti ed al passo con le tecnologie di mercato. Per azienda cliente operante nel settore della fornitura di acqua potabile per la regione Toscana selezioniamo: System Administrator Di cosa ti dovrai occupare? Sarai coinvolto nelle attività di gestione, il monitoraggio ed evoluzione dell'infrastruttura informatica aziendale, assicurando elevati livelli di disponibilità, sicurezza e performance dei sistemi IT. Attività: Gestire e amministrare l'infrastruttura server fisica e virtuale aziendale. Configurare, monitorare e mantenere sistemi operativi Windows Server e/o Linux. Amministrare servizi di rete quali Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, File Server e sistemi di autenticazione. Gestire e monitorare gli ambienti di virtualizzazione Garantire l'esecuzione e il controllo delle procedure di backup e disaster recovery. Monitorare disponibilità, performance e sicurezza dei sistemi informatici Predisporre e aggiornare la documentazione tecnica relativa ai sistemi gestiti. Segnalare e proporre interventi migliorativi finalizzati all'incremento dell'affidabilità, sicurezza e continuità operativa dei servizi IT. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Buona conoscenza dei sistemi operativi Microsoft Windows Server. Conoscenza di ambienti Linux, e di Active Directory, DNS, DHCP e Group Policy. Conoscenza delle tecnologie di virtualizzazione e delle infrastrutture di rete LAN/WAN, VLAN, VPN e firewall. Familiarità con piattaforme cloud AWS, Google, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365. Capacità di utilizzare strumenti di monitoraggio e diagnostica dei sistemi. Vuoi essere un punto chiave nell'evoluzione tecnologica delle aziende? Candidati ora! Orario di lavoro: 38 ore settimanali dal Lunedì al Venerdì con flessibilità in entrata e uscita. title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Job Description: Account Executive Sede di lavoro: Tutto il territorio italiano; Settore: Brokeraggio Assicurativo Descrizione dell'Azienda Stiamo cercando, per conto di un nostro cliente, realtà di eccellenza nel panorama del brokeraggio assicurativo italiano e parte di un primario Gruppo internazionale, figure professionali da inserire nella propria struttura commerciale. L'azienda supporta imprese e professionisti nella gestione dei rischi con soluzioni assicurative su misura. Nell'ambito del potenziamento della propria rete commerciale, ricerca diversi/e: Account Executive Obiettivo del Ruolo L'Account Executive avrà la responsabilità di gestire, sviluppare e fidelizzare un portafoglio clienti, contribuendo attivamente alla crescita del business. Il ruolo richiede un forte orientamento commerciale, capacità consulenziale e attenzione alla qualità del servizio, nel rispetto degli standard aziendali e normativi. Gestione e Sviluppo Commerciale - Sviluppare nuove opportunità di business attraverso attività di prospecting e networking finalizzate all'acquisizione di nuovi clienti - Gestire in autonomia un portafoglio clienti (PMI e aziende corporate) - Analizzare le esigenze assicurative dei clienti e proporre soluzioni su misura - Identificare opportunità di cross-selling e up-selling sui diversi rami assicurativi - Raggiungere gli obiettivi di crescita assegnati in termini di ricavi e marginalità Relazioni con Clienti e Stakeholders - Costruire e mantenere relazioni solide, basate su fiducia e consulenza continuativa - Interfacciarsi con compagnie assicurative per la negoziazione e strutturazione delle coperture - Collaborare con le funzioni interne (tecnico, amministrativo, sinistri) per garantire un servizio efficiente e di qualità - Monitorare costantemente la soddisfazione del cliente Operatività e compliance - Garantire il rispetto delle normative di settore e delle policy aziendali - Supportare la corretta gestione amministrativa delle pratiche commerciali - Contribuire al miglioramento continuo dei processi e delle modalità di servizio Formazione ed Esperienza: - Esperienza di almeno 3-5 anni in ruoli commerciali nel settore assicurativo, brokeraggio, bancassicurazione o servizi finanziari; - Diploma di scuola secondaria superiore, eventuale laurea in Economia, Finanza, Giurisprudenza o discipline affini saranno considerate un plus Competenze: - Consolidata esperienza nello sviluppo commerciale e nella gestione di clienti business - Conoscenza dei principali prodotti assicurativi (rami danni, property, liability, ecc.) - Spiccate capacità relazionali, negoziali e consulenziali - Forte orientamento al risultato e capacità di lavorare per obiettivi - Ottime doti organizzative e autonomia nella gestione delle attività Cosa Offriamo - Contratto a tempo indeterminato con retribuzione commisurata all'esperienza, range retributivo: 38K-45K - Inserimento in una realtà solida e in forte espansione (il Gruppo è tra i Top 10 broker a livello mondiale) - Portafoglio clienti consolidato e concrete opportunità di sviluppo commerciale - Ambiente dinamico, orientato al risultato e alla valorizzazione delle persone - Percorsi di formazione e crescita professionale Il nostro cliente promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e rispettoso della diversità: la selezione è aperta a tutte le persone, senza distinzione di genere, età, origine, disabilità o orientamento. La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia (ibrido valutabile) Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio #LI-CP Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e portare a mercato l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture, ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia (ibrido valutabile) Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: Other clerical support workers
description: Hai una mente analitica e ti appassiona lavorare con i dati? Cerchi lavoro in ambito finanziario? Grafton Office è la specializzazione dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per prestigiosa azienda cliente selezioniamo: Financial Analyst - Personnel Cost Ricerchiamo candidato/a con consolidata esperienza nel controllo del costo del lavoro. Nello specifico la risorsa si occuperà di redazione del budget annuale e forecast mensili, con analisi puntuale degli headcount e degli scostamenti, creazione di report e dashboard per il monitoraggio dei principali HR analytics (turnover, assenze, straordinari, ferie, ecc.); eseguirà inoltre registrazioni contabili e attività di supporto amministrativo-contabile connesse al costo del personale, supporto ai processi di Payroll, con focus su tematiche e quadrature legate ai costi del personale e alla loro corretta rappresentazione. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Sulla base delle necessità produttive, utilizza le macchine rivettatrici, le presse, le calandre, le imboccolatrici, prestando attenzione alla corretta messa in sicurezza della macchina e al corretto settaggio prima dell'uso. Effettua la pulizia e la manutenzione delle macchine con l'aria compressa e appositi panni. Effettua il rabbocco dell'olio nei macchinari utilizzati. Gestisce l'inventario utilizzando il conto manuale e la bilancia di precisione contapezzi con cui si contano i componenti presenti in reparto. Si interfaccia con area UT per lo sviluppo di campioni e/o per l'effettuazione di test funzionali. Interagisce con Area CQ per risolvere possibili NC emerse durante il ciclo produttivo. Utilizza quotidianamente attrezzature e strumenti da banco (quali a titolo di esempio trapani, pinze, cacciaviti) per ottimizzare l'assemblaggio meccanico. title: Researcher bridging immunology, genomics and proteomics (academic-industry collaboration)
description:
About the position

Applicants are invited to apply for a two-year Researcher position (SKO 1109) in immuno-proteomics (hands-on biology). The position is based at the Department of Immunology, Division of Laboratory Medicine, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo.

The position is available from July 2026 with a flexible start date between July and September 2026. It is a full-time role physically based at GSK Vaccines S.r.l. in Siena, Italy, within the MS Structural Biology, Ab Discovery and Immunology unit. Scientific advising and guidance will be provided by Dr. Greiff (Lab for Computational and Systems Immunology, greifflab.org).

The researcher will develop and establish an Ig-seq platform bridging immunoglobulin profiling, B-cell receptor (BCR) repertoire sequencing and serology.


More about the position

The proposed project aims to investigate the polyclonal humoral immune response to a model viral antigen in human samples from pre-exposed individuals. This research integrates advanced techniques, including antigen-specific B-cell sorting, B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing, and LC-MS/MS-based identification of circulating antigen-specific antibodies. The goal is to link B-cell clonotypes to serum immunoglobulins and resolve functional proteoforms through an immunoproteogenomics approach. The project will involve developing de novo sequencing workflows for antigen-specific antibodies, building proteogenomic pipelines to assemble VH/VL sequences and identify clonotypes. Data will be integrated matching BCR repertoires of PBMCs, tonsil tissue, and matched sera from GSK human biological samples. Computational modeling and machine learning will be essential for antibody identification, epitope prioritization, and cross-cohort comparisons.

The project focuses on deconvoluting pathogen-specific humoral responses to a seasonal viral pathogen by combining paired BCR repertoire sequencing with antigen-resolved LC-MS/MS proteomics. The candidate's responsibilities will encompass the development and analysis of mass spectrometry methods for antibody isolation and characterization, as well as designing and validating multiparameter flow cytometry panels for antigen-specific B-cell and plasma cell identification and sorting. The role demands rigorous data stewardship, collaboration with immunology, proteomics, and bioinformatics teams, primarily at GSK Siena, and contributing to the dissemination of research findings.


Key Duties 
  • BCR library preparation and sequencing workflows,
  • Implementing bioinformatics pipelines for clonotyping, lineage tracing, and proteogenomic integration
  • Performing comparative analyses with published datasets.

 Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Appointment to the position of researcher in position code 1109 requires a doctoral degree in Proteomics
  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS method development for proteins/antibodies, including sample prep, instrument setup, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Python/R and scientific computing, and reproducible research practices (Git, containers/workflows).
  • Ability to build and run bioinformatic pipelines (de novo peptide sequencing, spectral annotation, FDR control).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Expertise in immune receptor immunology (BCR/TCR) and repertoire analytics (clonotyping, lineage tracing, SHM, germline inference).
  • Experience with BCR repertoire analysis (Bulk and/or single cell)
  • Experience with advanced Flow Cytometry and Cell Sorting.
  • Structural biology/protein informatics relevant to antibody-antigen interactions and developability assessment.
  • Experience with complementary fragmentation methods (HCD/ETD/EThcD), intact/middle-down workflows, and disulfide/glycoform mapping.
  • High-performance/parallel computing; familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and benchmarking.
  • Prior experience integrating proteomics and repertoire sequencing (immunoproteogenomics)
     

Personal skills
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and effective in an interdisciplinary, ambitious environment.
  • Independent, solution-oriented, and organised; strong scientific rigor and documentation practices
     

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

 

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A scientifically rich, interdisciplinary and international environment at GSK Siena with access to state-of-the-art proteomics and flow cytometry facilities.
  • Advising and mentorship by Prof. Victor Greiff; opportunities for collaboration across immunology, proteomics, and computational teams.
  • Professional development, training, and conference participation.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 640 000 to 760 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter.
  • CV.
  • A complete list of publications.
  • Project/research plan aligned with the position scope
  • Transcripts and certificates.
  • Contact information for 2-3 references.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to  Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

6.    Pedagoginių ir psichologinių žinių kursų išklausymo dokumento kopiją (jei asmuo neturi pedagogo kvalifikacijos).

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

description:

Luxembourg, LU, L-2449

Purpose of the Job

Quintet Private Bank is a leading private bank in the wealth management sector; we are committed to our clients and their families, and pride ourselves on our personalised service based on a deep understanding of what clients want to achieve.
We are a bank headquartered in Luxembourg, with branches in Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Netherlands and a subsidiary in the UK. We are supervised by the CSSF with an ambition to stay true to our purpose to be the most trusted fiduciary of family wealth.

We want our employees to feel proud of being part of a company that is committed to do the right thing. You will have the opportunity to grow your career while developing personally and professionally through various resources and programmes.

We are looking for a skilled IT Security Expert with strong hands-on network administration expertise to join our dynamic IT Security team.
The role combines IT Security Infrastructure management with deep operational knowledge of enterprise network infrastructures, ensuring that security controls are effectively implemented, and operated across on premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.
The successful candidate will work as part of the ITS Group Function – Network & Security Team in Quintet Luxembourg.

Key Accountabilities

• Operate the Bank Security Infrastructure (Run the Bank) including firewall policies, VPNs, IPS/IDS, and mail gateways.
• Penetration Testing Coordination: Coordinate and support penetration testing efforts, analysing findings, and working with teams to address identified security weaknesses.
• Vulnerabilities Process Follow-Up: Monitor and track the status of identified vulnerabilities, ensuring that remediation efforts are executed efficiently and effectively. Manage the process and provide reporting associated
• Patching Follow-Up: Manage and oversee the patch management process including EDR follow up, ensuring timely application of security updates and addressing vulnerabilities in a proactive manner.
• Security Dashboard Creation: Develop and maintain security dashboards to provide real-time visibility into security metrics, vulnerabilities, and incident response efforts for stakeholders
• Operate the day to day data leakage prevention (DLP) and data exfiltration monitoring activities, including detection, investigation, and remediation of potential data leaks across network, endpoint, cloud, and perimeter layers.
• Technical Risk Analysis Support: Assist in conducting technical risk assessments and analyses to identify potential security threats and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
• Access Validation: provide guidance for specific access request by following Access control policy principles
• Maintain and secure the group network infrastructure, including Lan, Wan, SD-WAN, VPN, Bank Wireless network and cloud networking.  
• Ensure secure connectivity between on-premises environments and cloud platforms
• Collaboration: Work closely with IT teams, including CISO, to integrate security into all aspects of the organization's IT landscape.    
    
Knowledge and Experience

• 5+ years of experience in IT Security, with strong hands-on experience in enterprise network administration.
• Strong knowledge of security frameworks and best practices (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001).
• Proven experience in network and security operations within complex environments.
• Experience with penetration testing methodologies and tools.
• Familiarity with security technologies, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, and SIEM solutions.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to diverse audiences.
• Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CEH, CISM, CCNP Security, etc) are highly desirable.  
• Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

Attributes and Qualities

• Adaptability & Learning Agility                        
• Time Management                                
• Communication (Verbal & Written)                    
• Client-Centric Mindset                            
• Collaborative Teamwork

Technical Skills

• Strong knowledge in Security Frameworks and Standards. Knowledge of security frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls) and Compliance regulations (GDPR, DORA, etc)
• Strong knowledge Firewall Next Generation (VPN, IPS, Anti-malware, Sandbox, URL Filtering, ...); Mail & Web gateways;
• Knowledge in VPN and Remote access solutions
• Knowledge in Endpoints Security (antivirus, antimalware)
• Knowledge in Threat Intelligence and Vulnerability Management - Ability to analyse threat intelligence and conduct vulnerability assessments. Familiarity with security tools (SIEM, vulnerability scanners).  

Languages Skills

• Excellent written and oral French and English skills are essential, any other language is an advantage

title: Change Management Specialist - Accounting and Corporate Services Transformation (m/f)
description:
Change Management Specialist - Accounting and Corporate Services Transformation

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Change Management Specialist to support the transformation of its Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

As Change Management Specialist, you will:
• Support the transformation core team in organising, monitoring and steering the overall transformation agenda.
• Contribute to the definition and implementation of change management plans across departments.
• Assess the impact of transformation initiatives on teams, roles, responsibilities, processes, behaviours and client service delivery.
• Work closely with sponsors, department representatives, managers and operational teams to ensure that change is understood, accepted and adopted.
• Identify adoption risks, resistance points, communication needs, training needs and operational readiness issues.
• Prepare stakeholder communications, internal updates, user engagement material and change adoption reporting.
• Support the preparation of change impact assessments, stakeholder maps, readiness assessments and adoption dashboards.
• Coordinate with the central IT Business Application team, project teams and other internal stakeholders to align implementation plans with business change needs.
• Promote a pragmatic and user-oriented approach to transformation, focused on operational adoption and sustainable change.

This position is for you if:

• You have 4 to 6 years of experience in change management, business transformation, organisational change, consulting, operational excellence or a similar field.
• You have contributed to transformation programmes involving several stakeholders, business teams or departments.
• Experience with accounting, corporate services, fund administration or professional services environments.
• You can translate strategic objectives into practical change actions.
• You are able to assess how change impacts people, processes, roles, responsibilities and ways of working.
• You are comfortable facilitating discussions, structuring feedback and turning complex situations into clear action plans.
• You have strong communication skills and can adapt your message to partners, managers and operational teams.
• You are structured, autonomous and pragmatic, with the ability to monitor progress without taking ownership of each individual project.
• You have a good understanding of digital transformation, business applications and the role technology can play in improving processes, collaboration and service delivery.
• You are familiar with the potential of AI in a business environment and have already used, tested or contributed to practical AI-related use cases.
• You are fluent in English and French.
…then this offer is probably made for you!

It would be an advantage if you also have:

• Exposure to software implementation or digital transformation programmes.
• Knowledge of change management methodologies such as Prosci, ADKAR, Kotter or similar approaches.
• Experience preparing change plans, communication plans, adoption material, training support or stakeholder engagement plans.
• Good command of Microsoft 365 tools, including PowerPoint, Excel, Teams and SharePoint. Experience with project or collaboration tools would be an asset.

What we offer

• A key role in a strategic transformation programme within one of BDO Luxembourg's core business practices.
• The opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders, business teams and technology specialists.
• A varied role combining change management, stakeholder engagement, communication and transformation monitoring.
• A collaborative, multicultural and entrepreneurial working environment.
• The opportunity to contribute to the future operating model of our Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.
• Ongoing learning and development opportunities in line with your strengths and career aspirations.

What´s in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

title: GBL Strategy Specialist, Global Medical Accommodations (m/f)
description:
GBL Strategy Specialist, Global Medical Accommodations

Description

The Medical Accommodations Global Relations & Strategy Specialist is a specialized individual contributor role within Global Medical Accommodations (GMA), created to align ROW stakeholders to our global strategy, ways of working, and technology direction - while ensuring their legitimate concerns are heard, addressed, or escalated decisively. A key objective of this role is to help GMA progress toward global parity between the US and all other regions, ensuring ROW associates and business partners receive a consistent, high-quality accommodations experience.

This role operates as a strategic stakeholder advocate and internal change agent - listening deeply to regional business concerns, evangelizing the global accommodations mission, having backbone when stakeholder requests conflict with global strategy, and bridging divides where local legal requirements demand differentiation. The specialist owns the overarching program direction and strategy for ROW stakeholder alignment, but executes through partnership with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader, SME/ACES teams, Technology, and others as required.

Key job responsibilities

Stakeholder Advocacy & Strategic Alignment

Serve as the primary point of alignment between ROW stakeholders and GAA's global strategy, building deep understanding of regional business concerns while driving adoption of global ways of working and technology direction.
Evangelize the global accommodations mission and technology strategy to ROW stakeholders, building understanding and buy-in for the direction even when it challenges local preferences or established practices.
Exercise backbone: where stakeholder concerns conflict with global strategy and are not legally required, push back respectfully, bring stakeholders on board with the rationale, or escalate with a clear recommendation.
Where stakeholder concerns are valid - aligned to global policy or driven by local legal requirements - identify gaps and partner with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader to ensure they are addressed through the Global Parity program or technology roadmap.
Identify and surface emerging stakeholder concerns proactively (e.g., self-service models driving unintended volume in EU markets, insufficient medical documentation friction creating compliance risk), working with relevant teams to close gaps before they escalate.
Treat stakeholders as customers: understand their needs, close the loop on their concerns, and drive accountability for resolution.
Propose and implement mechanisms to measure stakeholder satisfaction - addressing the current gap where manager and business partner experience with accommodation services is not systematically captured.
Provide structured, data-backed updates to stakeholders on initiatives and concerns they have raised - keeping them informed, engaged, building trust through transparency and follow-through.

Service Adoption & Awareness

Develop and drive a global strategy to increase adoption of GMA services across ROW countries.
Partner with country operations and HR teams to understand barriers to service utilization, and work with relevant teams to remove friction and increase awareness.
Track adoption metrics by country and region, surfacing gaps and recommending targeted interventions to close them.

Program Ownership & Cross-Functional Execution

Own the overarching ROW stakeholder alignment program and strategic direction, executing through partnership with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader, SME/ACES, Ops Center of Excellence, business policy/standard work teams, Technology, Legal, and Expansions.
Partner with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader to ensure ROW stakeholder needs inform parity priorities. Validate that parity deliverables address field concerns and drive stakeholder adoption of implemented solutions. This role does not own the Global Parity program - it serves as the voice of ROW stakeholders into that program.
Identify ROW-specific technology needs and partner with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader to ensure these are reflected in the technology roadmap and product requirements.
Facilitate cross-functional working groups and governance forums, establishing clear decision rights, escalation pathways, and accountability mechanisms across all stakeholder teams.

Process Improvement and Standardization

Conduct structured current-state analyses and future-state mapping, engaging cross-functional teams to validate findings and build alignment on solutions before scaling.
Facilitate process improvement initiatives across ROW regions, identifying fragmentation and inconsistency in accommodation workflows and partnering with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader and operational teams to drive resolution.
Monitor regional performance against defined GMA expectations and metrics that are important to the business - including new metrics where existing measures do not capture stakeholder or operational reality.

Senior Leadership Engagement & Escalation Management

Build and maintain productive relationships with senior leaders across Operations, PXT, Legal, and WHS - ensuring they are informed, engaged, and aligned on accommodation strategy for their regions.

Draft and deliver structured communications, leadership briefings, and status updates that are concise, data-backed, and appropriate for executive audiences, including contributions to the business's Weekly Business Review (WBR) and Monthly Business Review (MBR) mechanisms as required.

Proactively surface cross-regional risks with proposed mitigation plans.
Exercise sound judgment in identifying when complex issues require escalation, preparing clear, data-driven problem statements, root cause analyses, and recommended actions that enable leaders to make informed decisions quickly.

Data Analysis and Insights

Analyze case data, audit findings, stakeholder feedback, and operational metrics across ROW regions to identify trends, bottlenecks, and emerging issues before they escalate into systemic problems.
Build and maintain tracking mechanisms that provide visibility into case volumes, turnaround times, adjustment types, stakeholder satisfaction, service adoption rates, and compliance adherence across the ROW network.
Use data to prioritize program initiatives, measure the impact of implemented solutions, and communicate progress to stakeholders and leadership.

Quantify the impact of stakeholder-raised concerns (e.g., volume increases attributable to self-service rollout) to inform strategic decisions on technology deployment pace and sequencing.

Regional Expansion and Change Management

Partner with the Expansions team during active country launches, focusing on post-launch adoption and ongoing stakeholder alignment rather than launch execution.
Lead change management for stakeholder adoption of GMA services and strategic initiatives this role drives, including stakeholder communications, training development, and feedback loop mechanisms that ensure adoption and continuous refinement.
Document learnings from ROW implementations and contribute to a central knowledge base that enables teams to benefit from cross-regional experience and avoid duplicating effort.
