  • How do expanding road infrastructures interact with Indigenous and local land use, seasonal mobilities, and relational understandings of landscape? 
  • How are access, mobility, and territorial authority negotiated between different actors, including local communities, Sámi reindeer herders, planners, governmental agencies, and extractive industries?
  • How do roads simultaneously enable, constrain, and transform relationships between people and northern landscapes?

The PhD candidate will have the opportunity to shape the detailed direction of the dissertation within the broader aims of the project. 

Research methods

The project combines: 

  • Archival research
  • GIS and spatial analysis
  • Participatory and critical mapping
  • Ethnographic fieldwork
  • Walking interviews
  • Policy analysis
  • Visual and spatial storytelling 

GIS analysis forms an important component of the project, but it is integrated with qualitative, participatory, and community-engaged approaches. The project therefore welcomes applicants interested in combining spatial analysis with ethnographic and critical social science methods. Fieldwork will involve collaboration with local residents, Sámi communities, municipal planners, land users, and other stakeholders across Northern Fennoscandia.

Applicants are required to submit a project description (3–5 pages, literature references included) outlining how they would approach the proposed doctoral research within Work Package 2 of ROADS. The project description should demonstrate the applicant's understanding of the aims of ROADS and discuss how they would investigate questions related to infrastructure, mobility, landscape, territorial governance, and Indigenous and local land use in Northern Fennoscandia.

While the dissertation is situated within Work Package 2, applicants are encouraged to develop their own research focus within the overall objectives of the project. The final project description will be developed in cooperation with the supervisor. 

The description should reflect on relevant theoretical perspectives and methodological approaches appropriate for doctoral research. Applicants are encouraged to discuss how methods such as GIS and spatial analysis, participatory and critical mapping, ethnographic fieldwork, archival and policy analysis, visual methods, and interdisciplinary collaboration could contribute to their proposed research. The proposal does not need to include all of these approaches but should demonstrate thoughtful consideration of the methods most appropriate for the applicant's intended doctoral project. Applicants should also indicate how their academic background, research interests, and methodological competencies would contribute to the interdisciplinary research environment of ROADS while supporting the development of an original doctoral dissertation. 


Contact

For further information about the position and the ROADS project, please contact: 

Dr. Tarja Salmela, Principal Investigator, ROADS
School of Business and Economics, BFE UiT The Arctic University of Norway

Email: tarja.t.salmela@uit.no 


Qualifications

Required qualifications: 

  • Applicants must hold a Master's degree equivalent to a Norwegian Master's degree in geography, human geography, Indigenous studies, environmental humanities, archaeology, anthropology, planning, GIScience, landscape studies, political ecology, heritage studies, environmental studies, digital humanities, or another relevant discipline. Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. You may still apply if you are in the final stages of the master’s degree, but the master’s thesis must be submitted for evaluation within the application deadline. You must submit the thesis and transcripts of grades for the master's degree with your application. 
  • Strong academic performance and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English. Nordic applicants can document their English capabilities by attaching their high school diploma. 
  • Demonstrated interest in Arctic, Indigenous, environmental, mobility, infrastructure, or landscape research. 
  • Ability to work independently while contributing actively to collaborative research.

Desired qualifications: 

  • Archival or historical research.
  • GIS and spatial analysis. 
  • Critical GIS, participatory mapping, or countermapping. 
  • Qualitative or ethnographic research. • Indigenous methodologies and community-based research. 
  • Political ecology, infrastructure studies, environmental humanities, or mobility studies. 
  • Visual methods, digital storytelling, or creative and arts-based research.
  • Skills in Norwegian, Swedish, Finnish, or a Sámi language

We also value applicants who are motivated to develop language skills relevant to the project's geographical and cultural contexts. Applicants with backgrounds in geography, archaeology, digital heritage, landscape studies, environmental humanities, Indigenous studies, anthropology, planning, and related disciplines are particularly encouraged to apply. ROADS is grounded in long-term collaboration with local and Sámi communities and engages critically with Indigenous knowledge systems and questions of self-determination and cultural heritage. We encourage applications from researchers whose experiences and perspectives can contribute to the project's commitment to plurality, community engagement, and inclusive knowledge production.

In the assessment, the emphasis is on the applicant's potential to complete a research education based on the master's thesis or equivalent, and any other scientific work. The project description will also be considered. In addition, professional experience and other experience of significance for the completion of the doctoral programme will be taken into consideration.

We will also emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position. We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have good collaboration skills
  • Have good communication and interaction with colleagues and students
  • Wants to contribute to a good working environment

As many people as possible should have the opportunity to undertake organized research training. If you already hold a PhD or have equivalent competence, we will not appoint you to this position.


Admission to the PhD programme 

For employment in the PhD position, you must be qualified for admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics and participate in organized doctoral studies within the employment period.

Admission normally requires:  

  • A bachelor's degree of 180 ECTS and a master's degree of 120 ECTS, or an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 30 ECTS for a master's degree of 120 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 20 ECTS for an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 

Grade requirements applies both to the master thesis as well as courses part of the master’s degree. The minimum requirements are grade B or better on the master’s degree, and an average grade of B or better on courses that are part of the master’s degree. For integrated master's degrees, applicants are required to have achieved a grade of B or higher on their master's thesis and an overall average grade of C or higher across all courses comprising the integrated degree programme. A more detailed description of admission requirements can be found here.  

If you are employed in the position, you will be provisionally admitted to the PhD programme. Application for final admission must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position. 

Applicants with a foreign education will be subjected to an evaluation of whether the educational background is equal to Norwegian higher education, following national guidelines from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills. Depending on which country the education is from, one or two additional years of university education may be required to fulfil admission requirements, e.g. a 4-year bachelor's degree and a 2-year master's degree. UiT normally accepts higher education from countries that are part of the Lisbon Recognition Convention.


Inclusion and diversity

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity are a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite at least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics.


We offer

The successful candidate will join an internationally connected and intellectually vibrant research environment at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, Handelshøgskolen, and the thematic network of Environmental Humanities at UiT. The successful candidate will become part of an innovative research project addressing pressing questions concerning infrastructure, mobility, cultural heritage, and environmental change in the Arctic.

  • The opportunity to contribute to a research project with strong academic and societal relevance
  • Close collaboration with researchers working across Arctic studies, mobility studies, infrastructure studies, environmental humanities, Indigenous studies, heritage research, and critical geography
  • Opportunities for international collaboration, conference participation, publication, and career development
  • Access to GIS and research infrastructure through UiT
  • Good career opportunities 
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • The remuneration for the position is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017 with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 580 000 to 600 000 (in a 100% position), with a 3% yearly increase

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information about working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility


Application 

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include: 

  • Cover letter explaining your motivation and research interests
  • Academic CV
  • Official diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language 
  • Official transcripts of grades/academic record for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language
  • Official translation of diplomas and transcripts of records (ToR) to English or a Scandinavian language, if applicable
  • Explanation of the grading system for foreign education (Diploma Supplement if available)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Documentation of proficiency in Norwegian (or a Scandinavian language) (if available)
  • References with contact information
  • Master’s thesis, and any other academic works
  • Publication list (if available)
  • Project description (3-5 pages)

Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. You may still apply if you are in the final stages of the master’s degree, but the master’s thesis must be submitted for evaluation within the application deadline. You must submit the thesis and transcript of grades for the master’s degree with your application.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 


Assessment 

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. 


General information 

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

Remuneration for the position of PhD Fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension: You may be entitled to financial support if you become ill or disabled, your family may be entitled to financial support when you die, you become insured against occupational injury or occupational disease, and you can get good terms on a mortgage. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

A shorter period of appointment may be decided when the PhD Fellow has already completed parts of their research training programme or when the appointment is based on a previous qualifying position PhD Fellow, research assistant, or the like in such a way that the total time used for research training amounts to three years. 

We process personal data given in an application or CV in accordance with the Personal Data Act (Offentleglova). According to the Personal Data Act information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. You will receive advance notification in the event of such publication, if you have requested non-disclosure. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics.The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

title: Project & Business Coordinator
employer: AVINCIS AVIATION NORWAY AS BASE TROMSØ
description:
Avincis is looking for a Project & Business Coordinator to join our Nordic organisation. This is a broad and highly collaborative role where you will work closely with our Nordic management team and colleagues across Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark. 

You will be at the centre of projects, business improvement initiatives and management activities that span functions and countries. From coordinating strategic projects and Management of Change processes to supporting business cases, contracts and performance reporting, you will help ensure that priorities move forward and that decisions are translated into action. 

For the right person, this is an excellent opportunity to gain broad exposure to a complex, international aviation business and work closely with senior management.

Location: Stockholm, Tromsø or Esbjerg

Reports to: Managing Director Nordics



The role

As our Project & Business Coordinator, you will support and coordinate strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects across the Nordic organisation. 

You will bring structure, follow-up and momentum to projects and business activities, while also supporting the Nordic management team with analysis, reporting, contracts and decision-making material. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Coordinating cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the Nordics 
  • Developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, budgets, risk registers and progress reporting 
  • Coordinating Management of Change (MOC) processes and ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up 
  • Supporting the preparation of business cases, investment proposals and cost-saving initiatives 
  • Facilitating project meetings, workshops and steering group meetings and following up agreed actions 
  • Supporting contract administration, negotiations, renewals and amendments 
  • Supporting commercial activities and tender processes 
  • Preparing management reports, presentations and decision-making material 
  • Analysing operational and financial performance and supporting KPI and dashboard reporting 
  • Identifying opportunities to improve, simplify and standardise processes across the Nordic organisation 
  • Supporting strategic planning, organisational development and change initiatives 
  • Acting as a connecting point between management, operational teams and support functions across countries 
Who are we looking for?

We believe you are a structured and proactive person who enjoys working in an environment where priorities can change and where collaboration is essential. 

You are comfortable coordinating several activities at the same time and know how to create clarity and progress without losing sight of the bigger picture. You enjoy working with people across different functions and levels of an organisation and are confident interacting with senior stakeholders. 

You probably have experience from project coordination, project management, business support, business development or a similar role. 

We would also like you to have: 

  • Strong organisational and project management or coordination skills 
  • An understanding of financial analysis and business cases 
  • Good analytical and problem-solving capabilities 
  • Experience or understanding of contract administration and commercial processes 
  • An understanding of risk management and governance 
  • Strong communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language 
  • Experience supporting management teams and senior stakeholders 
  • Experience from aviation or another regulated industry, tender or procurement processes, Management of Change and/or SAP is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What will make you successful? 

You are someone who takes ownership and makes things happen. You enjoy creating structure where there are many moving parts, following up on actions and ensuring that projects continue to move forward. 

At the same time, you are curious about the business behind the projects. You want to understand why we are doing something, not just what needs to be done. 

You are collaborative, pragmatic and comfortable working across different countries, functions and cultures. 

Why join Avincis?

At Avincis, our work has a clear purpose. We provide critical aviation services across Europe, supporting missions where aviation makes a real difference. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across our Nordic organisation and gain insight into many different parts of the business. You will work closely with Nordic management while collaborating with colleagues in operations, finance, safety, HR, procurement and other functions. 

It is a role with broad exposure, significant variety and the opportunity to influence how we work across the Nordics. 

If you are looking for a role where you can combine projects, business, analysis and collaboration – and where no two days are quite the same – we would love to hear from you. 

Ready to take the next step? Apply and become part of Avincis Nordics.

Kristine Lysö Mikkelsen, HR Business Partner, kristinelyso.mikkelsen@avincis.com

You will also be responsible for:

This job can be highly rewarding and at the same time very busy. The right candidate should be service-minded, structured, and able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment. You should be confident working independently while also supporting the operational team when needed.

We offer several onboarding timelines throughout the season. While the first start date is 04/05, it is possible to begin later depending on availability and operational needs. Please indicate your preferred start period in your application.

  • Explaining rental terms and vehicle functions

  • Handling payments, deposits, and rental documentation

  • Answering phone calls and customer inquiries

  • Coordinating vehicle pickups and returns

  • Organizing airport pickups when required

  • Keeping the front office clean, tidy, and organized

We Are Looking For Someone Who:

  • Is service-minded and positive

About the Position -- Field Agent

As a Field Agent, you will be responsible for preparing rental vehicles (camper vans and RVs) for customer use and ensuring they meet company standards and are road-safe at all times.

This includes carrying out thorough inspections, completing vehicle check-outs upon return, and handling the necessary administrative follow-up.

You will also be responsible for:

  • Performing minor repairs and general maintenance tasks

  • Ensuring the fleet remains in good working condition

  • Identifying and reporting technical or safety issues

  • Taking appropriate action within your scope of responsibility

Typical technical tasks may include tyre changes, brake pad replacement, and simple bodywork repairs.

This job can be highly rewarding and at the same time physically demanding and busy. The right candidate should be structured, hands-on, and able to work efficiently in a fast-paced operational environment. You should be comfortable working independently while also collaborating closely with the operations and front desk team.

We offer several onboarding timelines throughout the season. While the first start date is 20/04, it is possible to begin later depending on availability and operational needs. Please indicate your preferred start period in your application.

The working language of the company is English. Norwegian is not compulsory.

Your Tasks as a Field Agent

  • Inspecting vehicles before and after rental

  • Completing vehicle check-outs and documenting condition

  • Reporting damages or technical issues according to company procedures

  • Performing general maintenance and minor repairs

  • Ensuring vehicles are road-safe and meet company standards

  • Supporting fleet logistics and vehicle movements

  • Supporting operational tasks when needed (cleaning vehicles or assisting with customer handovers)

We Are Looking For Someone Who:

  • Is practical and solution-oriented

  • Has basic mechanical understanding or technical experience

  • Is structured and detail-oriented

  • Works well independently and in a team

  • Handles busy periods with efficiency and a positive attitude

  • Is punctual and reliable

  • Holds a Driver Licence B (required)

What We Offer

  • Work with a fun and interactive team

  • Great opportunities to grow and develop with the team

  • Award wage payment (Norwegian "tarif" payment)

  • Work wear provided


    If this sounds interesting to you and you would like to speak with us more about this position please send an email to work@arcticcampers.no with your current CV and cover letter as well as contact information.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Arctic Campers is Norway's largest camper van rental company, offering 200 camper vans across two locations: Oslo and Tromsø. With over 10 years of experience, we specialize in helping tourists explore and enjoy the stunning Norwegian nature. Our goal is to provide unforgettable adventures, giving you the freedom to discover Norway at your own pace.

title: Miljøarbeider asylmottak 50% - Skap lek, trygghet og tilhørighet - Borkenes
description:
Stillingen innebærer arbeid med barn og ungdom, og du vil være en viktig voksenperson i deres hverdag. Som miljøarbeider skal du bidra til trygghet, aktivitet, inkludering og gode relasjoner. Arbeidet vil være variert og innebære både planlagte aktiviteter og oppfølging av beboerne i det daglige.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi legger stor vekt på personlig egnethet. Vi ønsker oss en medarbeider som:

  • møter barn og unge med varme, respekt og tydelighet

  • er stabil og ansvarsbevisst

  • ser den enkelte og er opptatt av barnas beste

  • har godt humør og evne til å skape aktivitet og engasjement

  • håndterer uforutsette situasjoner på en rolig måte

  • kan arbeide selvstendig, men også godt i team

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Følge opp barn og unge i mottaket

  • Være en trygg og tilgjengelig voksenperson

  • Bidra til lek, fritidsaktiviteter, idrett og andre sosiale tiltak

  • Legge til rette for mestring, inkludering og sosial tilhørighet

  • Bidra til gode rutiner og struktur i barnas og ungdommenes hverdag

  • Observere og følge opp behov hos barn og unge

  • Ha dialog og samarbeid med foreldre/foresatte og øvrige ansatte

  • Bidra til et trygt og godt bomiljø på mottaket

  • Dokumentere og rapportere i henhold til mottakets rutiner

  • Delta i praktiske oppgaver knyttet til miljøarbeidet

Arbeidsoppgavene kan endres etter behov og i takt med mottakets drift.

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Har et genuint engasjement for barn og ungdom

  • Er trygg, tålmodig og tydelig i møte med mennesker

  • Er god til å bygge relasjoner og skape tillit

  • Har gode samarbeidsevner

  • Evner å sette grenser på en trygg og respektfull måte

  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorientert

  • Trives med en variert arbeidshverdag

  • Har respekt for mennesker med ulik kulturell og språklig bakgrunn

  • Har gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter på norsk

Vi tilbyr

  • 50 % fast stilling

  • En meningsfull og samfunnsviktig jobb

  • Mulighet til å gjøre en positiv forskjell for barn og unge

  • Et inkluderende og tverrfaglig arbeidsmiljø

  • Varierte og spennende arbeidsoppgaver

  • Opplæring og støtte i arbeidet

  • Lønn, pensjon- og arbeidsvilkår etter tariff

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kompella AS er et heleid kommunalt eiendomsselskap. P.t. er det 20 fast ansatte i selskapet. Vi forvalter, drifter og vedlikeholder en variert bygningsmasse i tillegg til drift av asylmottak.

Kvæfjord mottak

Kvæfjord mottak skal bidra til å gjøre en ny fremtid mulig for mennesker på flukt. Vi har over 25 års erfaring med drift av mottak, asylsøkere og flyktninger. Kvæfjord mottak har i dag 200 ordinære plasser, et flerkulturelt, mangfoldig og godt arbeidsmiljø og er en av de større driftsoperatørene i regionen. På vår arbeidsplass utfører våre kolleger viktige samfunnsoppgaver. Mange av de menneskene vi møter i vårt arbeid er i en sårbar livssituasjon, noe som stiller store krav til vår kompetanse, våre holdninger og vår profesjonalitet

Oppdraget løses på vegne av Utlendingsdirektoratet (Udi). Mottaket har i dag 14 ansatte og er bemannet 365 dager i året. Gjennom utstrakt miljøarbeid bidrar vi til å gi beboerne nødvendig omsorg og trygghet.

title: Camper Rental Station Manager - Oslo (Near Gardermoen Airport)
description:
Station Manager -- Oslo (Near Gardermoen Airport)

Arctic Campers AS is looking for an experienced, motivated, and hands-on Station Manager to take responsibility for the daily operation of our Oslo station, located close to Gardermoen Airport.

As Station Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring that customers receive an outstanding experience, employees have the support they need to succeed, and our fleet of camper vans is always prepared to the highest standard.

This is a leadership position for someone who enjoys taking responsibility, leading people by example, and being actively involved in the daily operation rather than managing only from an office.

The position is full-time and starts at the beginning of January.

Training

Before taking over responsibility for the Oslo station, you will complete a mandatory 2.5 month training program at our headquarters in Tromsø.

During this period you will learn every aspect of our operation, including:

  • Customer service and camper van handovers

  • Fleet preparation and quality control

  • Vehicle logistics

  • Camper van equipment and technical systems

  • Daily station management

  • Company procedures and operational standards

Accommodation during the training period in Tromsø will be provided by Arctic Campers.

Our working language is English, and you will become part of an international team consisting of colleagues from many different countries.

Educational and Skill Requirements

  • Previous leadership or management experience is an advantage

  • A minimum of 10 years of work experience in any profession is considered a strong advantage

  • Experience from tourism, vehicle rental, hospitality, logistics, automotive, or a similar industry is preferred

  • Experience leading and developing employees is an advantage

  • Interest in camper vans, tourism, and customer service

  • Basic technical understanding of vehicles or camper vans is an advantage

  • Valid Category B driver's licence (BE licence is an advantage)

  • Excellent English language skills (additional languages are an advantage)

  • Strong organizational and communication skills

  • Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style

  • Positive attitude, honesty, reliability, and willingness to take responsibility

Main Responsibilities

  • Managing the daily operation of the Oslo station

  • Leading, motivating, and supporting the station team

  • Onboarding, training, and supervising permanent and seasonal employees

  • Participating in the daily operation alongside your team whenever required

  • Ensuring professional customer service and high-quality camper van handovers

  • Planning and coordinating daily staffing and operational activities

  • Maintaining an overview of the camper van fleet together with the Head of Operations and Fleet Manager

  • Coordinating vehicle movements between stations and workshops

  • Ensuring all camper vans meet Arctic Campers' quality standards before every rental

  • Monitoring and maintaining the station's technical equipment, tools, and facilities

  • Supporting troubleshooting of camper van equipment and coordinating repairs when necessary

  • Ensuring company procedures, safety standards, and operational routines are followed

  • Reporting operational performance, challenges, and improvement opportunities to management

  • Continuously improving station efficiency and customer satisfaction

  • Performing other operational and administrative tasks as required

Working Hours

This is a full-time permanent position.

Working hours are scheduled according to operational requirements and will include weekends and public holidays during the rental season.

Working Permit

Arctic Campers AS welcomes applications from both Norwegian residents and international candidates.

  • Norwegian citizens: No work permit is required.

  • EU/EEA citizens: We will assist with the necessary paperwork required to register and work legally in Norway.

  • Non-EU/EEA citizens: We do not sponsor work visas or residence permits. Applicants who require visa sponsorship are unfortunately not eligible for this position and should not apply.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Arctic Campers AS is one of Norway's largest camper van rental companies, with stations in Tromsø and Oslo. Every year we welcome thousands of travellers from all over the world who choose our custom-built camper vans to explore Norway's spectacular landscapes.

We are a young, international company where teamwork, responsibility, and continuous improvement are highly valued. We believe that great customer experiences begin with great employees, and we are looking for a Station Manager who shares that mindset.

If you are looking for a challenging leadership position where no two days are the same, enjoy working with people, and want to be part of an ambitious and growing company, we would love to hear from you.

title: Projektipäällikkö, kansainväliset projektit
description:
Jalo & Jalo on vuonna 1972 Turussa perustettu perheyritys, joka on erikoistunut henkilönostamiseen. Viime vuosien vahvan kasvun ja yrityskauppojen ansiosta olemme tänä päivänä Pohjoismaiden suurin nostolava-autoja vuokraava yritys.

Toimimme Suomessa valtakunnallisesti kahdeksasta toimipisteestä käsin. Lisäksi meillä on Ruotsissa tytäryhtiö Svenska Höjdliftar, joka toimii Tukholmasta käsin. Yrityksemme palveluksessa on yli 100 henkilönostamisen ammattilaista ja kalustossamme on 175 erilaista henkilönostinta pienistä saksilavoista suuriin nostolava-autoihin.

**Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa ja kehittämässä kasvavaa kansainvälistä liiketoimintaa Pohjoismaissa?**

Etsimme kansainvälisiin toimintoihimme oma-aloitteista, järjestelmällistä ja tavoitteellista **projektipäällikköä** vastaamaan projektien johtamisesta, asiakassuhteiden kehittämisestä sekä liiketoiminnan kasvattamisesta erityisesti Ruotsin ja Norjan markkinoilla sekä tarvittaessa Baltian alueella.

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden päästä mukaan kehittämään kansainvälistä liiketoimintaa yrityksessä, jolla on jo vahva perusta, olemassa oleva asiakaskunta ja toimivat prosessit. Et aloita työtä tyhjältä pöydältä, vaan pääset rakentamaan tulevaisuutta olemassa olevan pohjan päälle yhdessä kokeneen ja sitoutuneen tiimin kanssa.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, viranomaisten, yhteistyökumppaneiden sekä oman organisaatiomme operatiivisten toimintojen kanssa. Tehtävä edellyttää aktiivista otetta, kykyä hallita laajoja kokonaisuuksia sekä halua matkustaa Pohjoismaissa.

**Tehtävänkuva**

Projektipäällikkönä vastaat muun muassa:

- projektien myynnistä ja asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä

- projektien suunnittelusta, käynnistämisestä ja johtamisesta

- tarjouslaskennan ja sopimusneuvotteluiden tukemisesta

- kansainvälisten projektien lupa- ja viranomaisasioiden koordinoinnista

- resurssien suunnittelusta yhteistyössä toimipisteiden ajojärjestelyn kanssa

- projektien aikataulujen, kustannusten ja laadun seurannasta

- yhteistyöstä asiakkaiden, viranomaisten, alihankkijoiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa

- uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta ja kehittämisestä


**Odotamme sinulta**

- tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta ja/tai työkokemuksen kautta hankittua osaamista

- kokemusta projektijohtamisesta tai esihenkilötehtävistä ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä

- kykyä johtaa useita samanaikaisia projekteja tavoitteellisesti ja järjestelmällisesti

- vahvoja organisointi-, yhteistyö- ja neuvottelutaitoja

- sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

- valmiutta matkustaa Pohjoismaissa ja tarvittaessa Baltian alueella

- kykyä toimia itsenäisesti, ottaa vastuuta ja tehdä päätöksiä muuttuvissa tilanteissa

- hyviä tietoteknisiä valmiuksia sekä kykyä omaksua uusia järjestelmiä ja toimintamalleja

- halua kehittää sekä omaa osaamistasi että yrityksen toimintaa pitkäjänteisesti


**Arvostamme erityisesti**

- ruotsin kielen taitoa, joka katsotaan eduksi

- kokemusta kansainvälisestä liiketoiminnasta tai projektitoiminnasta

- Pohjoismaisten markkinoiden, toimintatapojen ja viranomaisvaatimusten tuntemusta

- kokemusta teollisuuden, energiateollisuuden, infrastruktuurin tai rakennusalan projekteista

- näyttöjä asiakassuhteiden rakentamisesta ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta

- yrittäjähenkistä, ratkaisukeskeistä ja tavoitteellista työotetta


**Henkilönä olet**

- itseohjautuva ja aloitteellinen

- luotettava ja vastuuntuntoinen

- tuloshakuinen, mutta pitkäjänteinen

- rohkea tarttumaan uusiin mahdollisuuksiin

- hyvä tiimipelaaja, joka osaa toimia eri sidosryhmien kanssa kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä


**Tarjoamme**

- vastuullisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän kasvavassa yrityksessä

- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa kansainvälisen liiketoiminnan kehittämiseen

- mielenkiintoisia projekteja Pohjoismaissa ja Baltian alueella

- osaavan organisaation tuen ja matalan hierarkian työyhteisön

- mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä kansainvälisen liiketoiminnan avainroolissa


**Hae mukaan rakentamaan kanssamme tulevaisuuden kansainvälistä liiketoimintaa!**

Hae tehtävää täyttämällä hakemus. Liitä hakemukseesi CV:si sekä palkkatoiveesi. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana, ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Her har vi samla eit mangfald av kompetansebedrifter innan eit breitt spekter av fagområde, alt frå gründerbedrifter som produserer alger til Hydro sitt senter for forsking- og teknologiutvikling innan aluminiumsproduksjon.

description:

Location: Oslo, Norway (forward-deployed with customers, regular international travel)

Type: Full-time

Compensation: Competitive salary + equity

Stage: YC-backed, 55M NOK seed, building our core team out of Oslo

Define how the world's largest advisory firms adopt AI

Crunched is building the world's most powerful AI analyst for strategy and corporate finance workflows -- autonomous, agent-based AI that works directly inside Excel, where half of the world's business decisions are made. We're backed by Y Combinator, raised 55M NOK in seed funding, and our product is already trusted by professionals at firms like BCG, BDO, CBRE, Dentsu, Pareto, PwC, INSEAD and Harvard.

Why Crunched can win

Large AI platforms like Anthropic are serious competitors. Crunched is different because we build deeply for the top 1--2% of Excel power users and their highly specific workflows. In every direct customer evaluation against competing products so far, Crunched has won on quality. First Round heard pitches from 75 AI-for-Excel startups over the past year---and chose to invest in Crunched.

We're growing extremely quickly inside large international accounts. The Growth Manager is our most important hire right now -- the first dedicated go-to-market and customer success role at the company. You'll be embedded with our biggest customers across countries: developing the accounts, driving adoption, and building custom workflows alongside the people who use Crunched every day.

This is a core position. Being forward-deployed with customers is at the heart of how we build.

What you'll do

  • Own and grow our most strategic enterprise accounts from day one

  • Onboard new customers, teams and offices, and drive real adoption and ROI

  • Expand usage inside large advisory firms -- new offices, new teams, new use cases (for example, rolling Crunched out across new PwC offices)

  • Work closely with our tech team, turning what you learn in the field into bespoke solutions and product improvements

Best fit

A background in MBB-style management consulting , or several years in customer success at a high standard. Prior growth or customer success experience is preferred, but a strong consulting or finance background is a major asset -- it gives you credibility and a deep understanding of how our customers actually work. Experience from a customer-type firm (e.g. BDO, CBRE, Dentsu, Pareto, PwC) is a strong plus.


What you get

  • Ownership of our most important accounts from day one

  • A mandate to define how the world's largest advisory firms adopt AI

  • The opportunity to build the function and team as we scale

  • A hands-on product that delivers real productivity and ROI -- with genuine differentiators like EU data residency and best-in-class PowerPoint generation

  • Very competitive compensation: salary + equity from day one, with additional upside tied to our largest accounts open for discussion

  • Regular travel to customers across borders

Working model

Based in our Oslo office, forward-deployed with customers and traveling regularly across Norway and Europe. If you want to be close to customers and the core team while building something at high speed, this is for you.

Kongsberg Maritime is looking for a Project Controller to join our Energy & Control, Finance team. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring strong financial control and support throughout the lifecycle of our projects.

As Project Controller, you will work closely with Project Managers and colleagues across Finance, Sales, Delivery and Product management. You will contribute to delivering high-quality financial insights, maintaining project profitability, and supporting successful project execution.


What you will be doing
• Be an active member of the Project Controller team
• Establish projects in ERP systems and maintain project budgets
• Perform invoicing and crediting activities
• Support month-end closing activities, including revenue and cost recognition
• Prepare monthly project reporting and participate in project reviews
• Identify and evaluate financial risks and opportunities
• Provide financial support and analysis to project teams and stakeholders
• Contribute to continuous improvement and other ad hoc tasks within the Finance team

We're looking for someone who's service-minded, flexible, and eager for new challenges. If, you are someone who loves being given responsibility and can communicate clearly, we would like to hear from you!

We are continuously reviewing applications, apply today!


We think you should have

At Kongsberg Maritime, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for!


You are able to
• act on own initiative, make things happen and accept responsibility for the results.
• focus on bottom-line results, identify potential risks and monitor the financial impact of own activities.
• comply with company rules and procedures and execute plans with commitment and determination.
• use a methodical and systematic approach, plan ahead, define clear priorities and allocate resources effectively.
• communicate in a clear, precise and structured way.
• co-operate well with others, share knowledge, experience, information and support others in the pursuit of team goals.
If you're ready to take on this exciting challenge, apply now and become a part of our team!

This employment may require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.

With us, you will be offered a competitive salary and benefits package, along with development opportunities in an international environment. You will have the opportunity to work with sustainable and forward-looking solutions in the maritime industry.

Point of contact
Liv Frøvold, Manager Project Controlling, +47 909 92 865. liv.frovold@km.kongsberg.com.


Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology. Technologies for sustainable oceans

From single products to fully integrated systems, we help customers improve efficiency, reliability and sustainability, enabling the maritime energy transition. Our global teams operate end-to-end, from sales through product development and engineering to project execution - making us a trusted partner for yards, ship owners and operators across segments.

title: Associate Professor in Geomechanics and Geohazards
description:
About the Department and what they are looking for in this position

We invite applications for a full time position as Associate Professor in Geomechanics & Geohazards is available at the Department of Geosciences.

The Department of Geosciences (GEO) at the University of Oslo is part of the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Science and is a leading research unit in Europe. The Department covers a wide breadth of topics, from mantle and lithosphere dynamics on Earth and other planets, via surface processes in the boundary layers between Earth’s surface and atmosphere, to the dynamics and interactions in the Earth's crust, soils, hydrosphere, atmosphere, and biosphere.

The Department of Geosciences has defined a strategy focusing on four main themes that cut across the Department:

1.    Dynamics of the solid Earth and planets
2.    Climate change and the coupled Earth system
3.    Environmental geosciences
4.    Geoscience in the Arctic

The Department aims to contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and hosts important contributors to the IPCC (UN Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change).

The staff consists of approximately 40 professors and associate professors, in addition to postdoctoral fellows, PhD candidates, researchers, and technical and administrative staff. In total, the Department currently has around 200 employees, one Centre of Excellence and, at present, seven grants from the European Research Council (ERC), along with numerous other grants from public and private institutions. The Department is organized in six sections:

  • Basin Studies
  • Crustal Processes
  • Centre for Planetary Habitability [PHAB, Centre of Excellence]
  • Environmental Geoscience
  • Physical Geography and Hydrology
  • Meteorology and Oceanography

and a group in geoscience didactics. The Department offers two bachelor study programmes “Geology and Geography” and “Geophysics and Climate” and one MSc-programme in “Geosciences”. 

This position is primarily associated with the Crustal Processes section that mostly works with geological processes related to rock deformation (fracture, friction, creep), fluid flow in crustal rocks (water, gas, magma), and fluid-rock interactions. Researchers develop studies from the atomic scale to the lithospheric scale, with applications in the domains of Solid Earth geohazards, porous media, critical raw materials, and large-scale tectonics. Research in the section uses field work, analytical and imaging techniques, modelling, data science, and experiments, and aims to unravel the processes that shape the evolution of the Earth’s crust, and their effects on the environment. The section consists of 40 people, and at present is organised under a Faculty centre between Geoscience and Physics (Njord Centre).


General information about the position

Applicants must document academic qualifications in their field at a level equivalent to an Associate Professor. The position will be based at the University of Oslo. The successful candidate must be able to teach at all levels and supervise Master’s and PhD students. The successful candidate may also be required to take on other teaching duties and administrative tasks when requested by the Department or the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. The working time in the position is divided approximately as follows: 45% research, 45% education, and 10% administrative tasks.

The position is closely linked to the Department’s strategy by contributing to “research-based knowledge with societal relevance linked to climate, environment, energy, natural hazards, and sustainable use of resources”. The duties therefore include research, teaching, supervision, and dissemination/communication within both geomechanics and geohazards. The position will serve as a link between the Department’s expertise in various research fields relevant to geohazards (including geophysics, geomechanics, geomorphology, hydrology, hydrogeology and environmental geology). One of our aims is to advance the understanding of slow and rapid rock mass and granular material movements by developing and applying advanced methods and models that contribute to solving fundamental scientific and societal challenges related to geohazards.


Your main tasks will be

Your main research-related tasks will be:

  • Conduct cutting-edge fundamental research with broad international impact in geomechanics with applications to geohazards (earthquakes, landslides, and other gravitational instabilities).
  • Develop advanced numerical models for improving the simulation, the analysis, and the prediction of geohazards, as well as the application of tools and concepts from other disciplines (e.g. physics, data science) to geomechanics.
  • Attract substantial external research funding (e.g., from EU Horizon programmes, the Research Council of Norway, the Norwegian Directorate for Water Resources and Energy, and related funding bodies).
  • Promote collaboration with external partners such as the Norwegian Geotechnical Institute (NGI), the Norwegian Seismic Array (NORSAR), and other relevant institutions.
     

Your main teaching-related tasks will be to actively contribute to teaching at both bachelor’s and master’s level in topics related to geomechanics and geohazards, including landslides in granular materials and water/rock interactions. At present, the following 10 ECTS courses are offered at the Department of Geosciences: 

  • GEO3034 (Geohazards)
  • GEO4131 (Geomechanics) 
  • GEO4151 (Earthquakes and Volcanoes)
  • GEO4171 (Floods, Avalanches, Landslides) 

The candidate is expected to take primary responsibility for up to two courses and supervise master’s theses in these subject areas. Course responsibility does not imply giving all lectures, but to organise lectures and lab-exercises in the course. Experience and/or interest in fieldwork is also desirable.

We expect mainly physical attendance at the University of Oslo.


More information about the position

Applicants must document academic qualifications in their field, equivalent to an Associate professor position. The successful applicant must be able to teach at all levels and to supervise Master and PhD students. 

The successful applicant may furthermore be required to take on other teaching duties and administrative tasks, by request from the Department or the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. 


What skills are important in this role?

Assessment of candidates will be based on scientific and educational excellence, as for example reflected in the quality of peer-reviewed publications, scientific relevance, ability to attract external funding, and other evidence of impact. The main emphasis will be on the candidate’s performance during the last five years. We expect the candidate having a scientific track record at a high international level that demonstrates the ability to fund and lead research projects.

Required qualifications:

  • The successful applicant must have completed a PhD in geology, geomechanics, or geophysics or related fields, with a focus on e.g., geomechanics, structural geology, civil engineering or geomorphology. 
  • Documented post-doctoral or equivalent experience and a strong scientific track record within areas of the mechanics of geomaterials (solid rocks and/or granular materials), computational methods in mechanics or geophysics, and solid earth geohazards including earthquakes, landslides and other gravitational instabilities.
  • Ability to collaborate across scientific disciplines.
  • Documented potential for acquisition of external research funding.
  • Pedagogical qualifications and teaching and supervision experience at all levels will be an important factor in the evaluation process and should be well documented in a teaching portfolio. The applicant should describe her/his qualifications in view of the Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SoTL) framework which includes:
    • Focus on student learning
    • A clear development over time
    • A researching approach
    • A collegial attitude and practice
  • The successful candidate who at the time of appointment cannot document sufficient teaching qualifications (minimum formal requirement is a 200 hours pedagogical programme) will be required to obtain such qualifications within a two-year period.
  • The successful candidate must demonstrate mastery of both English and one of the Scandinavian languages as working languages, in order to be able to teach and otherwise be able to participate in all functions the position may involve. If the successful candidate does not have sufficient mastery of a Scandinavian language, B2 level, the candidate will be required to learn sufficient Norwegian within  three years of employment.

Desired qualifications:

  • Candidates should be able to establish, lead and conduct research projects, also as a collaborator. 
  • An international network, experience with outreach activities, collegiality, and the ability to contribute to a good working environment.
  • Experience in scientific and administrative management, as the person appointed will be expected to take on some administrative duties.
  • Additional competences in experimental and applied and/or field studies will be considered an advantage.

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to create and contribute to a well-functioning, inclusive and productive research environment
  • Strong networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
  • Ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff

The successful candidate should have an international profile with respect to the above criteria. The candidate for this position will be selected based on excellence and fit with the section’s research profile.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Associate Professor (position code 1011) in salary range NOK from 850 000 - to 950 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, two % is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

Inclusive work life and diversity at UiO

UiO is an open and internationally-oriented university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at UiO's policy for diversity, equality and inclusion - University of Oslo.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one? We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures. 

We especially encourage women to apply.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. 

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Application letter
  • A research position paper (max. 5 pages) describing the applicant’s vision and scientific ambitions for the nearest future
  • A detailed CV, including a complete list of education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative management, project acquisition and coordination experience, and other qualifying activities.
  • Copies of educational certificates, PhD diploma, transcript of records and letters of recommendation
  • A complete list of publications and academic merits and awards (if not included in the CV)
  • Full text of up to 10 selected scientific publications the applicant wishes to include in the evaluation
  • A document discussing the importance, interrelation, and relevance of the selected papers for this position
  • Educational portfolio of 3–6 pages documenting educational competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own teaching practice and view of learning is anchored in the SoTL framework (focus on student learning, development over time, a researching approach and a collegial attitude and practice) 
  • List of reference persons: 2–3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

As a general rule an interview will be used in the appointment process, usually supplemented with a trial teaching session. The basis for assessment will be the scientific production of the applicant, the teaching portfolio, pedagogical and educational qualifications, the applicant’s qualifications within leadership and administration, other qualifications as well as general personal suitability for the position. In ranking the competent applicants, the full range of qualifications will be considered and explicitly assessed.

Rules for appointments to associate professorships. 
https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/rules-appointment-professor.html

Rules for the assessment and weighting of pedagogical competence for appointments to permanent academic posts which include teaching duties: 
https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/rules-basic-pedagogical-competence.html

Guide for applicants for Professor and Associate professor positions - University of Oslo https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/guide-applicants.html

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova), information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results, see: http://www.uio.no/english/for-employees/employment/work-results/


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The geosciences are the studies of the planet Earth and its comparative planetology; the atmosphere, the hydrosphere and cryosphere, the Earth's surface and its interior. The Department of Geosciences conducts research and teaching in most of the domains of geoscience; geology, geophysics, physical geography, geomatics, hydrology, meteorology and oceanography. The Department is the broadest geoscience research and education environment in Norway. We perform research at a high international standard and have five ERC (European Research Council) research projects ongoing.

The Department encompasses six scientific sections; Meteorology and Oceanography, Geography and Hydrology, Study of sedimentary basins, Environmental geosciences. and Crustal Processes. We host now a third in the line of three Centre of Excellences:  PHAB – Centre for Planetary Habitability, and have a Norwegian Research School for PhD students (Research School for Dynamics and Evolution of Earth and Planets, DEEP).

The Department aims to contribute to the new and important UN Sustainability Development Goals, and are important contributors to IPCC (UN’s Inter-governmental Panel on Climate Change). The staff consists of 40 professors and associate professors, in addition to postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, researchers, technical- and administrative staff. The Department has around 200 employees.

Crunched is building an autonomous AI analyst that works directly inside Excel. Backed by Y Combinator and 55M NOK in seed funding, we are building our core team in Oslo and looking for a hands-on Marketing Lead who can turn a strong product into content and campaigns people notice.

Why we believe Crunched can win

title: Er du samfunnsanalytikeren som vil gjøre utdanning mulig?
description:
Lånekassen er en stor og viktig aktør i den norske velferdsstaten. Vi har 1,2 millioner kunder, og i fjor delte vi ut 47 milliarder kroner i lån og stipend til elever og studenter. Samfunnsoppdraget vårt er å gjøre utdanning mulig. 

For å få til det, er vi nødt til å vite hvordan utdanningsstøtteordningene våre fungerer – og formidle kunnskapen vår videre.  

Er du en analytiker som er nysgjerrig og ser muligheter i store mengder data, følger samfunnsdebatten, trives med å formidle og vil være med på å utvikle analysemiljøet vårt? Da synes vi du skal lese litt videre! 

Hvem er vi?Vi i analyseseksjonen er en tørrvittig gjeng på fjorten folk, med hjerter for å gjøre utdanning mulig. Vi er mellom 32 og 60 år, har studert alt fra samfunnsøkonomi til sosiologi og informatikk, og kommer fra Bergen, Trondheim og her og der på Østlandet. 

Seksjonen vår tilhører utdanningsstøtteavdelingen. Sammen med resten av avdelingen har vi ansvar for utviklingen i Lånekassen – fra ideer, analyser og utredninger av nye muligheter, til å sette i gang ulike tiltak for å utvikle og forbedre tjenestene våre. 

Vi har tilgang på mye data i Lånekassen, og jobber for at tall og analyser skal ligge til grunn for hvilke problemer vi skal løse og hvordan vi utformer ordningene og tjenestene våre.  

Samtidig ønsker vi å samarbeide tettere med andre aktører, for å få en bredere forståelse av hvordan ordningene våre virker. Arbeidsoppgavene dine

I denne rollen vil du 

  • vurdere og videreutvikle kunnskapsgrunnlaget i Lånekassen 
  • planlegge og gjennomføre analyser og utredninger, hovedsakelig kvantitative 
  • tilrettelegge og analysere store datamengder, og utnytte Lånekassens data og informasjonskilder 
  • skrive rapporter og notater 
  • formidle analyser internt og eksternt  
  • samarbeide faglig med andre, både internt og eksternt, i og utenfor kunnskapssektoren 
Hvem er du?

Du er nysgjerrig på om utdanningsstøtteordningene fungerer etter hensikten. Her ser du analysemuligheter, og ønsker å være med å videreutvikle kunnskapsgrunnlaget i Lånekassen.  

Det å være strukturert og analytisk er en selvfølge for deg. Du liker og er vant til å jobbe selvstendig, og så har du en sterk gjennomføringsevne. I tillegg har du høy faglig integritet og er interessert i andre perspektiver.  

Du er god på å utarbeide og levere innsikt, og du forstår hvor viktig det er å formidle denne kunnskapen videre. Det er først da vi kan være med på å utvikle utdanningsstøtteordningene og bidra i samfunnsdebatten.  

Du vil være en faglig pådriver for analyser og vil være viktig for å utvikle analysemiljøet i Lånekassen. 

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt. 

 

Dette gjør deg kvalifisert for stillingen

Du må ha: 

  • høyere utdanning, mastergrad eller høyere, fortrinnsvis innen samfunnsøkonomi eller statsvitenskap. Relevant erfaring kan veie opp hvis du mangler formelle kvalifikasjoner. 
  • dokumentert erfaring med å lede større utredninger, forskning eller analyseoppdrag, for eksempel fra forskningsinstitutt, analyseavdelinger i departement eller direktorat eller akademia 
  • dokumentert erfaring med kvantitative analyser 
  • svært god samfunnsforståelse 
  • gode akademiske resultater 
  • god skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk 

Det er en fordel om du også har  

  • erfaring med R eller tilsvarende analyseverktøy 
  • erfaring med analyser av registerdata 
  • erfaring fra arbeid med spørreundersøkelser og forsøksordninger 
  • kjennskap til kunnskapssektoren 
Hvorfor skal du jobbe hos oss, da?

Utdanningsstøtteordningene er et samfunnsområde med politisk interesse, og er viktig for den enkelte elev og student. Kunnskapsgrunnlaget rundt ordningene er begrenset, men vi har mye data og etterspørselen etter mer innsikt er stor. Her får du muligheten til å finne ny innsikt som kan være med å påvirke politikkutviklingen framover.  

Seksjonen vår er opptatt av å ha det hyggelig og sosialt sammen på jobben, og vi feirer både små og store prestasjoner og resultater sammen. Som nyansatt får du en fadder som passer på at du finner deg godt til rette i arbeidsmiljøet. 

Vi vet at en god balanse mellom arbeid og fritid er viktig for at du skal trives og yte ditt beste. Livet har ulike faser, og vi legger til rette for at du skal ha en fleksibel arbeidshverdag. Hos oss jobber vi minst tre dager på kontoret, og du kan jobbe to dager hjemmefra. Vi har også fleksibel arbeidstid og sommertid med 7-timersdager i perioden 15.05.–14.09. 

I tillegg får du 

  • nye kontorlokaler på Helsfyr med flott utsikt over byen 
  • sykkelparkering og treningsrom med mulighet for trening i arbeidstiden 
  • svært god kantineordning 
  • det trekkes to prosent av lønnen, som gir medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse med gode forsikrings-, låne- og pensjonsordninger 

Du vil bli ansatt som 1364 Seniorrådgiver med lønnsspenn fra 730 000 kroner til 900 000 kroner, avhengig av utdanning og erfaring. For særskilt kvalifiserte søkere kan høyere lønn vurderes. 


Mangfoldig og inkluderende arbeidsliv 
I Lånekassen skal alle ha det godt på jobb, og vi ønsker oss kollegaer med ulike perspektiver og erfaringer. Hos oss er vi opptatt av at vi møter hverandre med vennlighet og gjensidig respekt. 

Vi har som mål å ansette flere personer fra underrepresenterte grupper. Har du innvandrerbakgrunn, nedsatt funksjonsevne eller hull i CV-en, oppfordrer vi deg til å søke. Du kan krysse av for dette i jobbsøkerportalen. Vi legger til rette for medarbeidere som har behov for det. 

Praktiske opplysninger  
For å sikre at du blir tatt i betraktning ber vi deg skrive søknad og CV på norsk, og legge ved vitnemål og attester elektronisk i søknaden. Ta med originaler/bekreftede kopier til intervju dersom dette ikke er lastet opp i søknaden. 

Du trenger ikke å sende en lang søknadstekst, men vi vil gjerne at du skriver noen ord om hvorfor du vil jobbe hos oss og hvordan dine erfaringer passer inn hos oss, og legger ved en utfyllende CV.  

Når du søker jobb hos oss, vil navnet ditt stå på en offentlig søkerliste. Du kan be om å bli unntatt søkerlisten ved å sende en begrunnelse i søknadsskjemaet. Vi vil ta stilling til om vi kan innvilge ønsket ditt, og gir deg beskjed hvis ikke.

title: Ski Lift Operators
description:
About Us:
Rauland Skisenter AS is one of Telemark's largest tourism companies and among the larger ski resorts in Norway. We are dedicated to creating great skiing experiences for the whole family in a snow-reliable mountain destination.

Rauland is located in the municipality of Vinje, an area with a long tradition of tourism and hospitality. Rauland town center offers a wide range of shops, restaurants, and services. Our operations are based at Vierli, Tiur, and Holtardalen.

Our employees are our most valuable resource. During the high season, we employ nearly 100 staff members of all ages and from many different countries. We operate year-round, with business activities including skiing, accommodation, housekeeping, and food service. Rauland Skisenter is also certified as an Miljøfyrtårn company, demonstrating our commitment to environmental sustainability.

Learn more about us at raulandskisenter.no.

About the Position:
We are looking for Lift Operators for the 2026/2027 winter season. We are recruiting full-time employees.

Throughout the winter, we welcome thousands of enthusiastic skiers to our resort and work hard to ensure they have a great experience. We operate 12 different ski lifts that transport our guests throughout the resort.

As a Lift Operator, you will assist guests in boarding and disembarking from our lifts safely and efficiently. The role includes daily lift inspections, basic maintenance tasks, snow clearing, and the installation and maintenance of safety fencing and signage.

Lift Operators are part of the ski resort's rescue and emergency response team. Applicants should therefore be in good physical condition and comfortable working at heights. Previous experience from other ski resorts is an advantage but not required, as full training will be provided. You should be able to work independently while also being a reliable team player.

Key Responsibilities:
- Daily inspection of ski lifts
- Daily maintenance and reporting
- Assisting guests with boarding and disembarking lifts
- Providing guests with the highest level of service

Qualifications:
- Proficiency in at least one Scandinavian language
- Must be at least 18 years old and hold a valid Category B driving licence
- As Lift Operators are part of the ski resort's rescue and emergency response team, applicants should be physically fit and comfortable working at heights
- Strong customer service skills
- Willing and eager to learn

What We Offer:
- Competitive salary, free season pass, and attractive staff discounts
- Assistance with accommodation
- Close access to mountain activities and outdoor recreation
- A varied and sometimes fast-paced working environment
- An exciting workplace that is continuously developing
- A great team spirit and fantastic colleagues

Contact Information:
For questions or further information, please contact:
Operations Manager: Håvard Bjørke
Phone: +47 970 95 162
Email: hb@raulandskisenter.no

Skills:
- Proficiency in at least one Scandinavian language

- As Lift Operators are part of the ski resort's rescue and emergency response team, applicants should be physically fit and comfortable working at heights
- Able to provide excellent customer service
- Willing and eager to learn

Om stillingene og arbeidsted 

Ved Haugmotun omsorgssenter har vi en korttidsavdeling med 24 plasser inkludert 2 KAD plasser, med høy aktivitet og varierte pasientforløp. Her får du brukt bredden i din kompetanse og være en del av et tverrfaglig miljø hvor vi jobber for god pasientbehandling og trygg utskriving. 

Haugmotun Omsorgssenter er Notoddens største arbeidsplass med 350 engasjerte medarbeidere! Vi har 6 avdelinger,  korttidsavdeling, langtids somatisk og skjermet avdelinger samt heltidsomsorgsboliger. I tillegg har vi et eget kjøkken, vaskeri og to dagsenter. Notodden ligger idyllisk til ved Heddalsvannet. Vi er Europas blueshovedstad og er på UNESCO's verdensarvliste med bakgrunn i vår unike industrihistorie. title: Jordmor
description:
Jordmor med hjerte for tidlig innsats? Vi vil ha deg på laget!  

Vi har på grunn av sykdom ledig et 60 % vikariat ut året, med mulighet for forlengelse og fast stilling. Er du jordmor og ønsker å bli en del av et sterkt fagmiljø der samarbeid, kvalitet og utvikling står i sentrum? Da er dette er stillingen for deg!  Det er ønskelig med oppstart så snart som mulig.

Om oss  
I Orkland kommune satser vi på å være en god oppvekstkommune – et sted der barn, unge og familier skal oppleve trygghet, trivsel og mestring. Som jordmor hos oss er du en viktig del av barne- og familietjenesten, der vi møter familiene tidlig og følger dem tett gjennom svangerskap og småbarnstid.   

Orkland helsestasjon og skolehelsetjeneste består av lokasjonene Orkanger helsestasjon, Meldal helsestasjon, Lensvik helsestasjon og Krokstadøra helsestasjon. Vi har nye, moderne og velutstyrte lokaler som gir gode rammer for både ansatte og brukere. Arbeidet vårt bygger på godt samarbeid mellom helsestasjon, leger og andre fagpersoner som er viktige for barn og foreldre. Vi har 15 faste ansatte helsesykepleiere i 15 årsverk, to jordmødre i to årsverk og to sekretærer i 1 årsverk til sammen. 
Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Svangerskap- og barselomsorg  
  • Helsestasjon for ungdom (adm. av LARC)  
  • Fødselskurs  
  • Oppfølging innen kvinnehelse i rolige perioder  
  • Aktiv deltakelse i utvikling av gode rutiner og tjenester  
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Autorisert jordmor med forskrivningsrett  
  • Gode muntlige og skriftlige kommunikasjonsevner  
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Det er flott med erfaring fra kommunehelsetjenesten  
Personlige egenskaperVi ønsker oss en jordmor som bidrar til et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø, med et genuint engasjement for kvinnehelse og familieoppfølging. Hos oss er samarbeid en naturlig del av hverdagen, og du får være med å utvikle tjenestene i takt med familienes behov.  

Vil du være med å gjøre en forskjell – for enkeltmennesker, familier og hele kommunen? Da håper vi du søker på stillingen som jordmor hos oss!  Vi tilbyr
  • 60 % vikariat som er ledig omgående. Det kan bli mulighet for fast stilling 
  • En stilling i et solid fagmiljø der vi deler kunnskap og støtter hverandre i hverdagen  
  • Veiledning og mulighet for faglig utvikling, både individuelt og sammen med kolleger  
  • Kolleger som samarbeider tett på tvers av helsestasjon og andre tjenester – alltid med barn og foreldre i sentrum   
  • Muligheten til å være med å forme en kommune som satser stort på barn, unge og familier  
  • Kommunal bilordning og gratis parkering 
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger - Offentlig tjenestepensjon kort fortalt

For stillingen kreves politiattest (jf. Lov om helsepersonell paragraf 20a), som må framvises ved eventuell tilsetting. 

Orkland kommune er en inkluderende arbeidslivsbedrift som ønsker mangfold og oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uansett alder, kjønn, etnisitet og funksjonsnedsettelser.   

Nysgjerrig på Orkland? På InOrkland finner du alt du trenger å vite om å bo, jobbe og leve her.
