title: PhD Fellow in Arctic Mobility, Landscape and Spatial Justice
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
description:
The position

At The School of Business and Economics at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, ROADS is seeking a highly motivated doctoral researcher interested in questions of mobility, infrastructure, northern landscapes, environmental change, and spatial justice in the Arctic. The successful applicant will become part of an interdisciplinary research team combining geography, environmental humanities, Indigenous studies, critical infrastructure studies, heritage research, and spatial analysis. The PhD position is funded for three years, starting 1 March 2027 and ending 28 February 2030, and is embedded within an international and collaborative research environment.

The objective of the position is to complete research training to the level of a doctoral degree. Admission to the PhD programme is a prerequisite for employment, and the programme period starts on commencement of the position.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.

Working and living in Tromsø 

Tromsø/Romssa serves as an important hub for research, culture, governance, and mobility in the region of Northern Norway and Sápmi. Its position as a regional gateway between coastal, inland, and cross-border northern landscapes makes it a particularly meaningful base for ROADS. The School of Business and Economics at UiT hosts a growing community of scholars working on sustainability, governance, mobilities, Arctic transformations, and societal change. The successful candidate will become part of a dynamic interdisciplinary environment, including UiT’s Environmental Humanities thematic network that ROADS is closely connected to. 


The project

ROADS offers the first systematic study of residual road infrastructures in Northern Fennoscandia—roads and pathways that have fallen out of official purpose but continue to shape landscapes, memories, and mobility practices across the region. These include bypassed roads, abandoned transport corridors, former military and extractive infrastructures, and old roads and seasonal pathways embedded within local and Sámi land-use traditions.

While many remain visible in the landscape, their histories increasingly persist through local knowledge systems that risk disappearing as generations pass. Rather than approaching such infrastructures as obsolete remnants, ROADS conceptualizes them as living archives: material traces through which memory, power, mobility, resistance, and future possibilities continue to unfold.

Drawing on feminist and decolonial Science and Technology Studies, critical infrastructure studies, political ecology, environmental humanities and Indigenous ontologies, ROADS seeks to broaden conventional understandings of infrastructure by integrating relational, seasonal, and more-than human mobility systems into analyses of northern landscapes.

The project combines GIS-based spatial analysis, archival research, ethnography, repeat photography and artistic methods, and collaborative countermapping. It is grounded in close collaboration with local and Sámi communities and culminates in community-responsive public outputs, including a multilingual digital storymap and participatory mapping platform.

While GIS and spatial analysis provide important analytical foundations, ROADS combines these approaches with ethnographic, archival, visual, and artistic methods. The project therefore welcomes applicants interested in methodological experimentation and interdisciplinary research across the social sciences, humanities, environmental sciences, and arts. 


The PhD project, responsibilities and research methods

The PhD project and responsibilities

The successful candidate will undertake doctoral research mainly within Work Package 2: Mapping Conflict and Relational Mobility in the North. The PhD candidate will take a leading role in the WP and receive close supervision from the Principal Investigator while collaborating with the project's postdoctoral researcher and the project network.

The PhD project explores how contemporary road development in Northern Fennoscandia—including infrastructure connected to resource extraction, military activities, and regional development—interacts with older roads, seasonal pathways, and Indigenous and local mobility systems. Rather than treating infrastructure as fixed physical objects, the PhD project investigates roads as dynamic political, cultural, and material assemblages that shape relationships between people, landscapes, governance, and more-than-human worlds. 

Particular attention is given to questions such as: 

  • How do expanding road infrastructures interact with Indigenous and local land use, seasonal mobilities, and relational understandings of landscape? 
  • How are access, mobility, and territorial authority negotiated between different actors, including local communities, Sámi reindeer herders, planners, governmental agencies, and extractive industries?
  • How do roads simultaneously enable, constrain, and transform relationships between people and northern landscapes?

The PhD candidate will have the opportunity to shape the detailed direction of the dissertation within the broader aims of the project. 

Research methods

The project combines: 

  • Archival research
  • GIS and spatial analysis
  • Participatory and critical mapping
  • Ethnographic fieldwork
  • Walking interviews
  • Policy analysis
  • Visual and spatial storytelling 

GIS analysis forms an important component of the project, but it is integrated with qualitative, participatory, and community-engaged approaches. The project therefore welcomes applicants interested in combining spatial analysis with ethnographic and critical social science methods. Fieldwork will involve collaboration with local residents, Sámi communities, municipal planners, land users, and other stakeholders across Northern Fennoscandia.

Applicants are required to submit a project description (3–5 pages, literature references included) outlining how they would approach the proposed doctoral research within Work Package 2 of ROADS. The project description should demonstrate the applicant's understanding of the aims of ROADS and discuss how they would investigate questions related to infrastructure, mobility, landscape, territorial governance, and Indigenous and local land use in Northern Fennoscandia.

While the dissertation is situated within Work Package 2, applicants are encouraged to develop their own research focus within the overall objectives of the project. The final project description will be developed in cooperation with the supervisor. 

The description should reflect on relevant theoretical perspectives and methodological approaches appropriate for doctoral research. Applicants are encouraged to discuss how methods such as GIS and spatial analysis, participatory and critical mapping, ethnographic fieldwork, archival and policy analysis, visual methods, and interdisciplinary collaboration could contribute to their proposed research. The proposal does not need to include all of these approaches but should demonstrate thoughtful consideration of the methods most appropriate for the applicant's intended doctoral project. Applicants should also indicate how their academic background, research interests, and methodological competencies would contribute to the interdisciplinary research environment of ROADS while supporting the development of an original doctoral dissertation. 


Contact

For further information about the position and the ROADS project, please contact: 

Dr. Tarja Salmela, Principal Investigator, ROADS
School of Business and Economics, BFE UiT The Arctic University of Norway

Email: tarja.t.salmela@uit.no 


Qualifications

Required qualifications: 

  • Applicants must hold a Master's degree equivalent to a Norwegian Master's degree in geography, human geography, Indigenous studies, environmental humanities, archaeology, anthropology, planning, GIScience, landscape studies, political ecology, heritage studies, environmental studies, digital humanities, or another relevant discipline. Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. You may still apply if you are in the final stages of the master’s degree, but the master’s thesis must be submitted for evaluation within the application deadline. You must submit the thesis and transcripts of grades for the master's degree with your application. 
  • Strong academic performance and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English. Nordic applicants can document their English capabilities by attaching their high school diploma. 
  • Demonstrated interest in Arctic, Indigenous, environmental, mobility, infrastructure, or landscape research. 
  • Ability to work independently while contributing actively to collaborative research.

Desired qualifications: 

  • Archival or historical research.
  • GIS and spatial analysis. 
  • Critical GIS, participatory mapping, or countermapping. 
  • Qualitative or ethnographic research. • Indigenous methodologies and community-based research. 
  • Political ecology, infrastructure studies, environmental humanities, or mobility studies. 
  • Visual methods, digital storytelling, or creative and arts-based research.
  • Skills in Norwegian, Swedish, Finnish, or a Sámi language

We also value applicants who are motivated to develop language skills relevant to the project's geographical and cultural contexts. Applicants with backgrounds in geography, archaeology, digital heritage, landscape studies, environmental humanities, Indigenous studies, anthropology, planning, and related disciplines are particularly encouraged to apply. ROADS is grounded in long-term collaboration with local and Sámi communities and engages critically with Indigenous knowledge systems and questions of self-determination and cultural heritage. We encourage applications from researchers whose experiences and perspectives can contribute to the project's commitment to plurality, community engagement, and inclusive knowledge production.

In the assessment, the emphasis is on the applicant's potential to complete a research education based on the master's thesis or equivalent, and any other scientific work. The project description will also be considered. In addition, professional experience and other experience of significance for the completion of the doctoral programme will be taken into consideration.

We will also emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position. We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have good collaboration skills
  • Have good communication and interaction with colleagues and students
  • Wants to contribute to a good working environment

As many people as possible should have the opportunity to undertake organized research training. If you already hold a PhD or have equivalent competence, we will not appoint you to this position.


Admission to the PhD programme 

For employment in the PhD position, you must be qualified for admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics and participate in organized doctoral studies within the employment period.

Admission normally requires:  

  • A bachelor's degree of 180 ECTS and a master's degree of 120 ECTS, or an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 30 ECTS for a master's degree of 120 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 20 ECTS for an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 

Grade requirements applies both to the master thesis as well as courses part of the master’s degree. The minimum requirements are grade B or better on the master’s degree, and an average grade of B or better on courses that are part of the master’s degree. For integrated master's degrees, applicants are required to have achieved a grade of B or higher on their master's thesis and an overall average grade of C or higher across all courses comprising the integrated degree programme. A more detailed description of admission requirements can be found here.  

If you are employed in the position, you will be provisionally admitted to the PhD programme. Application for final admission must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position. 

Applicants with a foreign education will be subjected to an evaluation of whether the educational background is equal to Norwegian higher education, following national guidelines from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills. Depending on which country the education is from, one or two additional years of university education may be required to fulfil admission requirements, e.g. a 4-year bachelor's degree and a 2-year master's degree. UiT normally accepts higher education from countries that are part of the Lisbon Recognition Convention.


Inclusion and diversity

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity are a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite at least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics.


We offer

The successful candidate will join an internationally connected and intellectually vibrant research environment at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, Handelshøgskolen, and the thematic network of Environmental Humanities at UiT. The successful candidate will become part of an innovative research project addressing pressing questions concerning infrastructure, mobility, cultural heritage, and environmental change in the Arctic.

  • The opportunity to contribute to a research project with strong academic and societal relevance
  • Close collaboration with researchers working across Arctic studies, mobility studies, infrastructure studies, environmental humanities, Indigenous studies, heritage research, and critical geography
  • Opportunities for international collaboration, conference participation, publication, and career development
  • Access to GIS and research infrastructure through UiT
  • Good career opportunities 
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • The remuneration for the position is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017 with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 580 000 to 600 000 (in a 100% position), with a 3% yearly increase

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information about working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility


Application 

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include: 

  • Cover letter explaining your motivation and research interests
  • Academic CV
  • Official diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language 
  • Official transcripts of grades/academic record for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language
  • Official translation of diplomas and transcripts of records (ToR) to English or a Scandinavian language, if applicable
  • Explanation of the grading system for foreign education (Diploma Supplement if available)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Documentation of proficiency in Norwegian (or a Scandinavian language) (if available)
  • References with contact information
  • Master’s thesis, and any other academic works
  • Publication list (if available)
  • Project description (3-5 pages)

Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. You may still apply if you are in the final stages of the master’s degree, but the master’s thesis must be submitted for evaluation within the application deadline. You must submit the thesis and transcript of grades for the master’s degree with your application.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 


Assessment 

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. 


General information 

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

Remuneration for the position of PhD Fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension: You may be entitled to financial support if you become ill or disabled, your family may be entitled to financial support when you die, you become insured against occupational injury or occupational disease, and you can get good terms on a mortgage. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

A shorter period of appointment may be decided when the PhD Fellow has already completed parts of their research training programme or when the appointment is based on a previous qualifying position PhD Fellow, research assistant, or the like in such a way that the total time used for research training amounts to three years. 

We process personal data given in an application or CV in accordance with the Personal Data Act (Offentleglova). According to the Personal Data Act information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. You will receive advance notification in the event of such publication, if you have requested non-disclosure. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics.The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

title: Familie søker nye hjelpende armer og ben for en "normal" hverdag. Vil du bli vår BPA?
description:
Familie søker nye hjelpende armer og ben til å bidra til en «normal» hverdag. Vil du bli vår BPA?

Hvem er vi?

Vi er en liten familie, bestående av to voksne og ett barn, som snart skal over til ungdomsskolen. Vi bor i vår tilrettelagte bolig i Stavanger, og har BPA-ordning som omfatter alle tre. Vi har nedsatt muskelstyrke og leddutfordringer, og har behov for rullestol som forflytningshjelpemiddel. Våre «topplokk» skal imidlertid være i «EU-godkjent» tilstand. Vi tar ikke oss selv så høytidelig og setter pris på litt sarkasme og galgen-humor. Vi er ellers en helt «vanlig» uvanlig familie; med skole, jobb, avtaler, fritidsaktiviteter og sosiale sammenkomster. Våre interesser omfatter bl.a. film, musikk og gaming, samt at vi alle er oppvokst i vann. Vi trenger assistanse til å bistå oss med gjennomføring av hverdagslige gjøremål og aktiviteter. Også funksjonsassistanse, som innebærer hjelp med praktiske oppgaver på arbeidssted. Vi søker nye sprudlende tilskudd til et finfint assistent-team, grunnet noen herlige folk som dessverre må flytte.

Hvem er du?

Vi søker etter positive personer, som ønsker å bidra til at andre mennesker får en bedre og enklere hverdag. Vi ser etter deg som liker litt morsomheter i hverdagen, og som har et glimt i øyet. Du bør ha et ønske om å jobbe med mennesker, helst over tid. Du må være stabil og bør ha forståelse for viktigheten av dette arbeidet. Vi setter pris på gjensidig fleksibilitet, så langt det lar seg gjøre. Du bør like rutiner, samtidig som du kan ta initiativ når du ser behovene oppstå. Vi har en stor, tilrettelagt bil, som vi er avhengig av at du kjører. Du må derfor ikke være redd for å prøve kjøring av litt stor bil (opplæring vil bli gitt). Det er særlig viktig at du er pålitelig, og at du kan starte dagvakter kl.7 på hverdager, dersom du skal ha faste dagvakter.

Hvilken type stilling ønsker du – mindre, medium eller ekstravikar?

  • Ledig timer: maks 25,5, fordelt på 1-3 stillinger (avhengig av sammensetningen av ønsker til de som ansattes).

  • Ledige vakter: mandag (kveld), tirsdag (dag), onsdag (kveld), torsdag (dag), og hver 4’de fredag kveld.

Vi søker deg som ønsker å jobbe fast deltidsstilling, eksempel på stilling:

  • Fast ca. 54 % stilling: 2 dagvakter (tirs + tors) & 1 kveld (ons) pr uke + hver 4. fredag kveld

  • Fast ca. 40 % stilling: 1 dagvakt (tors) & 1 kveldsvakt (ons)

  • Fast ca. 18 % stilling = 1 kveldsvakt per uke (man/ons) + hver 4’de fredag kveld

  • Fast ca. 16 % = 1 kveldsvakt per uke (ons)

  • Fast ca. 10 -12 % stilling = 1 dagvakt per uke (tirs)

  • Tilkallingsassistent, som ønsker litt ekstra inntekt i ferier og ved sykefravær.

Stillingene kan slås sammen eller deles opp. Vennligst spesifiser i søknadsbrev hvor stor stilling du søker.

Hva skal du gjøre?

  • Hjelpe vår datter til skolen, og være med henne på fritidsaktiviteter

  • Husarbeid og litt hagearbeid

  • Handling og matlaging

  • Av-/påkledning, hjelp til hårvask, osv.

  • Assistere på avtaler eller andre aktiviteter som familier gjør, i og utenfor hjemmet

  • Være med på reiser eller sykehus, etter avtale

Hva kreves av deg?

  • Du må ha førerkort, klasse B, automatgir

  • Du ønsker å jobbe i en familie, som har et sosialt barn i utvikling (og mulig vil få en hund i fremtiden)

  • Du ønsker å bidra til at vi får leve det livet som vi selv velger

  • Du har for det meste godt humør, og tar ikke deg selv for høytidelig

  • Du er ansvarsbevisst, pålitelig og punktlig. Personlig egnethet og modenhet vektlegges

  • Kvinnelige søkere oppfordres til å søke, grunnet arbeidets særskilte karakter

  • Referanser og gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før ansettelse


Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS og MOVA

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

title: Help us unravel the effects of environmental factors on immune health in children
description:
3-Year Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Exposome Research and Child Immune Health

Are you interested in understanding how environmental exposures during early life influence immune development and childhood health? We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to join an international Horizon Europe project investigating environmental determinants of immune-mediated diseases and immune health.

The EU Horizon Europe project EXPOSIM studies environmental stressors as causal determinants for immune-mediated diseases to map and prioritise evidence for knowledge-based policy-making. Child cohorts such as PreventADALL (Norway), ENVIRONAGE (Belgium) and FEPOS (Denmark) are included to study associations between early life environmental factors and immune health.

As a partner in EXPOSIM, the Department of Chemical Toxicology at the Norwegian Institute of Public Health (NIPH) will study children from the PreventADALL cohort. Exposome components such as air pollution, green spaces and noise exposure during pregnancy will be modelled by a partner, and associations with immune health until 3 years of age will be explored.

NIPH will integrate a novel set of outcomes of respiratory and immune development. These include foetal thoracic circumference, lung function, biomarkers of asthma, allergic diseases such as atopic dermatitis and food allergy, as well as immunosuppression assessed through vaccination responses to childhood vaccines. To strengthen causality between the observed exposure-health associations, high-dimensional immune cell profiling will be performed by in-depth single-cell (mass cytometry/CyTOF) and multiplex cytokine analyses.  

You will work with unique longitudinal data from the PreventADALL cohort and collaborate with leading European researchers in environmental health, epidemiology, immunology, medicine and bioinformatics. The position offers excellent opportunities to contribute to high-quality scientific publications and to develop advanced analytical skills in exposome research, immune profiling and multi-dimensional data integration.

The position starts on January 1, 2027.


Responsibilities
  • Analyse associations between environmental exposures and health outcomes using an exposome approach
  • Explore causal relationships by studying immune profiles (CyTOF) and inflammatory markers (OLINK) using supervised and unsupervised data analysis tools:
    • data-driven clustering, hierarchical and density-based algorithms
    • undirected network models for more mechanistic analyses
    • topological models to integrate cellular data with the other biological and clinical data
  • Publish scientific papers and internal reports and present scientific results at conferences
  • Participate in consortium meetings and present/discuss plans, status and results
  • Collaborate with scientists and engineers in the department and the NIPH mass cytometry platform
Qualifications

Required qualifications: 

  • PhD in a relevant field, such as epidemiology, environmental health, immunology, medicine or bioinformatics. The thesis must have been defended.
  • Hands-on experience in biostatistics and/or bioinformatics in exposome modelling
  • Hands-on experience with  R, and preferably STATA
  • Experience with writing and publishing scientific papers as the first author, with documented publications in the last 3 years
  • Good written and oral communication skills in English

Preferred qualifications: 

  • Experience with immune-mediated outcomes and knowledge of immunology
  • Experience with multi-omics integration for analysis of high dimensional data, multiple testing and causal frameworks 
  • Hands-on experience developing pipelines for single-cell analyses and/or exposome statistics 

The Norwegian Institute of Public Health (NIPH) collaborates with Semac to conduct background checks on relevant candidates. Any background check will be carried out only with your consent as an applicant and involves verifying your CV and other application documents in connection with the hiring process.

Personal attributes

We are looking for someone who:

  • has good cooperation skills to work efficiently with multiple partners nationally and internationally.
  • enjoys interdisciplinary research and collaboration
  • is proactive, structured and capable of working independently
  • has strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • communicates scientific results clearly
  • thrives in an international research environment

Personal suitability will be emphasised.

We offer

The Norwegian Institute of Public Health is a unique workplace with a significant social responsibility and plays an important role in the health and well-being of the population.

  • Access to unique national and international cohort data
  • Collaboration with leading European research institutions through the EXPOSIM consortium
  • Opportunities to develop expertise in exposome science, immune profiling and advanced integration of high-dimensional data
  • The opportunity to work alongside dedicated and highly competent colleagues who are supportive and help one another
  • Strong professional environments and emphasis on each employee's development and influence over their own working day
  • Full-time position (100%) as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow (Code 1352) for a period of three years, with a salary ranging from 730 000 - 780 000 NOK per year, based on the individual's qualifications, skills, and experience
  • Good pension schemes through the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (Statens pensjonskasse)
  • Flexible working hour arrangements and good employee welfare benefits, such as the opportunity to exercise during working hours

To submit your application, please click the blue "Søk på stillingen" button at the top of this page.

The Norwegian Institute of Public Health (FHI) aims to foster a culture of diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities for everyone. We believe this contributes to a broader range of perspectives, increased creativity, and better decision-making. Therefore, we seek employees with diverse skills, interdisciplinary backgrounds, life experiences, and perspectives to help us solve tasks even more effectively. If you have a disability, gaps in your CV, or an immigrant background, we encourage you to indicate this in Webcruiter when applying. If there are qualified applicants within these groups, we will invite at least one candidate from each group for an interview. We provide accommodations for employees who need them. Relevant accommodations may include technical aids, adapted furniture, or adjustments to routines, work tasks, and working hours. The information provided through these selections is used to generate anonymized statistics, which all government agencies report in their annual reports.

title: BPA-assistent søkes til sosial, aktiv og eventyrlysten 26-åring
description:
Vil du ha en jobb der du får bruke deg selv, bli kjent med en flott person og samtidig få oppleve mye? Da håper jeg du leser videre!

Jeg er en sosial, aktiv og eventyrlysten mann på 26 år som søker en ny BPA-assistent til teamet mitt. Jeg liker fart og spenning, men også rolige dager, gode samtaler og hyggelige stunder. Jeg er glad i å være ute, trene, reise og finne på nye ting – og familien min og jeg er ofte på farten.

Nå ser jeg etter deg som er positiv, trygg og fleksibel, og som har lyst på en variert og meningsfull jobb der ingen dager nødvendigvis er like.

Hva innebærer jobben?

Jeg har ledig en 100 % fast stilling i turnus, med vakter på dag og kveld og arbeid hver tredje helg. Dersom du ønsker en lavere stillingsprosent, er det også mulig å finne en løsning som passer for deg.

Som BPA-assistent blir du en viktig del av hverdagen min. Du vil være med på både helt vanlige hverdager hjemme og på aktiviteter, trening, turer og ulike opplevelser.

Noen ganger kan arbeidsdagen bestå av en rolig dag hjemme, mens andre dager kan by på mer fart og aktivitet. Det kan også bli aktuelt med helgeturer og lengre reiser, både i Norge og utlandet.

Kort sagt: Dette er en jobb for deg som liker variasjon, mennesker og opplevelser – og som synes det er givende å bidra til at en annen person kan leve livet sitt slik han ønsker.

Litt om meg

Jeg er en sosial og aktiv mann på 26 år som liker å ha ting å gjøre. Jeg trives godt med turer, sykling, ski, trening og andre aktiviteter, men setter også pris på rolige dager og hyggelig selskap.

Jeg liker mennesker med godt humør og positiv energi, og håper å finne en assistent som kan bli en trygg og god del av hverdagen min.

Familien min og jeg er mye på farten, så du må trives med at arbeidsplassen ikke alltid er den samme. Her kan det dukke opp både små og store eventyr!

Hvem ser jeg etter?

Jeg håper du:

  • har godt humør og en positiv innstilling
  • er trygg, pålitelig og tålmodig
  • liker å ta initiativ
  • trives med både rolige dager og dager med mer aktivitet
  • liker å være med på turer, trening og ulike aktiviteter
  • er fleksibel og komfortabel med en variert arbeidshverdag
  • har god fysisk helse

Du trenger ikke å kunne alt fra før. Det viktigste er hvem du er som person. Jeg ser etter deg som er motivert, lærevillig og som har lyst til å bidra til en trygg, aktiv og god hverdag.

Arbeidsoppgaver kan blant annet være

  • bistand ved måltider
  • personlig stell og daglige rutiner
  • aktivisering og aktiviteter inne og ute
  • trening og fysisk aktivitet
  • praktisk bistand i hverdagen
  • turer, utflukter og reiser ved behov

Kvalifikasjoner

  • flytende norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • førerkort klasse B
  • plettfri vandelsattest

Hva kan jeg tilby deg

  • 100 % fast stilling i turnus
  • gode lønns- og arbeidsvilkår gjennom tariffavtale
  • grundig opplæring og tett oppfølging
  • en variert og aktiv arbeidshverdag
  • et inkluderende og hyggelig arbeidsmiljø
  • mulighet til å være med på aktiviteter, turer og reiser
  • en jobb hvor du virkelig kan gjøre en forskjell

Kanskje dette er jobben du har lett etter?

Hvis du liker mennesker, aktivitet, variasjon og nye opplevelser, kan dette være en jobb som passer deg veldig godt.

Høres dette spennende ut? Da håper jeg du sender inn en søknad!

Søknader vurderes fortløpende, og oppstart skjer etter avtale.

Kanskje blir du min nye BPA-assistent – og en viktig del av mange små og store eventyr fremover? Jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg!


Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

title: Tre provisorfarmasøyter søkes til spennende satsing i hjemmetjenesten
description:
Drammen kommune satser på farmasøytkompetanse – vil du være med fra starten?
Sykepleietjenesten 24/7 er en viktig del av Drammen kommunes døgnkontinuerlige helsetjeneste. Nå styrker vi hjemmetjenesten med farmasøytkompetanse og søker tre engasjerte provisorfarmasøyter som vil bidra til trygg legemiddelhåndtering og bedre kvalitet i tjenestene.

Hjemmetjenesten er organisert i tre geografiske HUB-er, som hver består av fire hjemmetjenesteavdelinger. HUB nord er lokalisert sentralt i Mjøndalen, HUB sentrum holder til ved Hamborgstrøm bo- og servicesenter, og HUB sør er lokalisert ved Strømsø bo- og servicesenter. Hver farmasøyt vil være tilknyttet én HUB og samarbeide tett med ledere, sykepleiere og øvrige medarbeidere i de fire avdelingene.

Som provisorfarmasøyt får du en sentral rolle i arbeidet med å sikre trygg, effektiv og kunnskapsbasert legemiddelbehandling. Du vil samarbeide med blant andre sykepleiere, kommunefarmasøyt, fastleger og andre faggrupper. En viktig del av rollen blir å bidra til gode rutiner og enhetlig praksis på tvers av avdelingene. Farmasøytkompetansen skal styrke pasientsikkerheten og samtidig frigjøre sykepleierressurser til direkte pasientarbeid.

Vi ser etter deg som motiveres av å være med på å utvikle og forme en ny farmasøytrolle i hjemmetjenesten. Du ønsker å bruke kompetansen din i et tverrfaglig miljø og bidra til at innbyggerne mottar en trygg og helhetlig oppfølging av legemiddelbehandlingen.

Stillingene er på dagtid, mandag til fredag, og gir deg mulighet til å kombinere pasientnært arbeid med fag- og kvalitetsutvikling i et viktig samfunnsoppdrag

Velkommen som søker!

For stillinger med krav om politiattest, vil dette bli innhentet i henhold til gjeldende lovverk i forbindelse med signering av arbeidsavtale og før tiltredelse.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Bidra til en helhetlig, trygg og forsvarlig legemiddelkjede – fra bestilling og mottak til administrering, oppfølging og evaluering av legemiddelbehandling
  • Klargjøring, kontroll og kvalitetssikring av dosetter og multidoser i samarbeid med hjemmetjenestens team
  • Bestilling av legemidler
  • Elektronisk dialog med fastleger ved behov for reseptfornyelser og avklaringer knyttet til legemiddelbehandling
  • Gjennomføring av legemiddelsamstemming og oppfølging av legemiddellister ved endringer
  • Delta i og bidra til systematiske legemiddelgjennomganger
  • Delta i internkontroll og bidra til kvalitetssikring av legemiddelhåndteringen
  • Bidra i arbeid ROS-analyser, avvikshåndtering og kontinuerlig kvalitetsforbedring
  • Implementere og følge opp rutiner for medisinrom for å sikre enhetlig praksis i hjemmetjenesten
  • Samarbeide tett med sykepleiere og øvrige faggrupper
  • Planlegge og gjennomføre opplæring, kurs og veiledning for sykepleiere, studenter og øvrige medarbeidere
  • Bidra i arbeid med fagutvikling og forbedringsarbeid på tvers av tjenesten
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Norsk autorisert Provisorfarmasøyt (master i farmasi)
  • God digital kompetanse og evne til å bruke elektroniske pasientjournalsystemer og legemiddelrelaterte fagsystemer
  • Ønskelig med erfaring med legemiddelhåndtering og arbeid på medisinrom eller klinisk farmasi
  • Ønskelig med erfaring fra hjemmetjeneste, kommunehelsetjeneste eller annen pasientnær virksomhet
  • Kjennskap til relevante lover, forskrifter og retningslinjer innen legemiddelhåndtering

title: SERVICEHELTER SØKES TIL PALMEHAVEN
description:
Palmehaven er hjertet av Britannia Hotel og en av Norges mest ikoniske restauranter. Hver dag skaper vi minneverdige opplevelser gjennom førsteklasses service, mat og vertskap i verdensklasse. Vi søker nå serviceinnstilte og engasjerte tilkallings- og helgemedarbeidere som ønsker å bli en del av et profesjonelt miljø med høye ambisjoner. Hos oss får du muligheten til å lære av noen av bransjens beste og bidra til å skape minneverdige gjesteopplevelser hver dag.

Hos oss vil du få muligheten til å jobbe på tvers av flere spennende konsepter, blant annet frokost, lunsj og Afternoon Tea, søndagsmiddag, banketter og selskaper, samt spesialarrangementer som Champagne Brunch og vår populære serie «Artist in Residence».

Vi har et jevnt behov for medarbeidere gjennom året, med særlig mange vakter tilgjengelig i november og desember. Dette passer derfor godt for studenter eller andre som ønsker en fleksibel deltidsjobb med gode muligheter for ekstra arbeid.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Servering og oppfølging av gjester med fokus på en unik gjesteopplevelse.
  • Sikre at Britannias standarder for service, kvalitet og vertskap etterleves.
  • Bidra til godt samarbeid mellom kjøkken og servering.
  • Klargjøre, planlegge og følge opp egen stasjon.
  • Bidra til en positiv og profesjonell atmosfære i restauranten.
  • Bistå på tvers av restaurantens ulike konsepter og arbeidsområder.
  • Servering av mat og drikke, samt barista-, bar- og roomserviceoppgaver ved behov og ut fra erfaring.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Er fylt 18år eller eldre (dette på grunn av servering av alkohol). 
  • Behersker norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.
  • Erfaring fra restaurant, hotell, kafé eller annen servicevirksomhet er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
  • Fagbrev innen servitørfaget, reiselivsfaget eller tilsvarende relevant utdanning er en fordel.
  • Kompetanse innen kaffe/barista, bar eller vin er positivt
  • Har god arbeidskapasitet og trives i et høyt tempo.
Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi søker deg som brenner for gode gjesteopplevelser og trives i et miljø med høye ambisjoner og fokus på kvalitet. Du er positiv, serviceinnstilt og har en utpreget ja-holdning. Hos Britannia forventer vi at våre medarbeidere tar ansvar, samarbeider godt med andre og ser gjestens behov før de oppstår.

Du trives i et høyt tempo, har øye for detaljer og motiveres av å levere service på høyeste nivå. Erfaring er en fordel, men den rette holdningen og motivasjonen er det viktigste.

Det er en stor fordel om du har god tilgjengelighet i november og desember, inkludert helger og romjul.

Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende deltids- eller tilkallingsstilling ved et av Norges mest anerkjente luksushoteller.
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og lønn etter tariff.
  • Grundig opplæring gjennom Britannia Academy, intern opplæring og tett oppfølging fra erfarne ledere og kollegaer.
  • Muligheter for faglig utvikling innen service, mat, drikke og vertskap.
  • Et inkluderende, profesjonelt og ambisiøst arbeidsmiljø med fokus på kvalitet og samarbeid.
  • Erfaring fra flere av Britannias unike konsepter, arrangementer og selskaper.
  • Muligheter for økt stillingsprosent og videre karriereutvikling for de rette kandidatene.
  • Gode personalrabatter, inkludert ansattrabatt på hotellet.

Hos Britannia ønsker vi at et opphold hos oss skal være et verdifullt kapittel i din karriere – et sted hvor du bygger kompetanse, utvikler deg faglig og personlig, og tar med deg erfaringer som varer langt utover tiden hos oss. Her blir du en del av et team som hver dag jobber for å levere service og opplevelser i verdensklasse. Sammen skaper vi minner for våre gjester og setter standarden for moderne luksushoteller i Norge.

Vi behandler søknader fortløpende og oppfordrer interesserte kandidater til å søke så snart som mulig.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

title: CNC-programmerer
description:
Shape AS in Skodje is looking for an experienced CNC programmer to join our five-person team. We deliver precision machining for demanding industrial and defence projects, and you'll have direct influence over how we build and produce.

Hva vi ser etter

We're looking for someone who's self-driven, hands-on, and takes real ownership of their work. You're comfortable figuring things out independently, communicate clearly with the rest of the team, and enjoy solving problems as they come up on the shop floor. This role rewards people who like to automate repetitive tasks and think about production with a heuristic mindset --- spotting patterns and better ways of doing things rather than just following a fixed process. We value initiative and a genuine interest in your craft as much as years on paper --- if you're strong in some areas and still growing in others, we're open to that.

That said, here's what typically makes someone succeed in this role:

  • Experience as a CNC programmer using CAM (3+ years is a good guideline, not a hard cutoff --- training in NX CAM specifically will be provided if you have strong CAM experience on other platforms)

  • Strong understanding of CAD and machining principles

  • Comfortable working independently, at pace, and meeting tight deadlines

  • Good problem-solving instincts and interest in technical challenges

  • Strong communication skills

Arbeidsoppgaver

As a CNC Programmer with us, you will:

  • Develop and refine CNC programs using NX CAM
  • Optimize production processes to increase efficiency and reduce costs
  • Troubleshoot and resolve programming issues during production
  • Stay current with new CNC programming techniques and technology

You'll work closely with the rest of the team to push production forward, and you'll see the results of your work on the shop floor quickly.

Vi tilbyr
  • Competitive salary
  • Real influence , your work is visible and valued, not lost in a large hierarchy
  • Thorough training and genuine opportunities for professional development - Varied, hands-on work across industries
  • A tight-knit team and a great working environment

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Shape AS is a precision CNC job shop based in Skodje, delivering 3D modeling, prototyping, product development, reverse engineering, and mold/tooling production. Our five-person team works with modern machinery and technology across a wide range of industries, from vacuum forming and composite tooling to metal casting and complex machining. Our work regularly supports UAV, and other high-precision industrial projects. We're a small, close-knit team where every person's work is visible and valued. As we grow, we're looking for people who want real ownership over what they build, not just a seat in a large hierarchy.

Fokuset er på kommunens innbyggere og hvordan en kan løse utfordringene en møter på daglig på best mulig måte, både for tjenestemottakere, pårørende og for helsepersonell.
Våre tjenestemottakere er av varierende alder og med stort spenn i diagnoser og helseutfordringer, dette være seg både somatikk, psykiatri- og rusrelaterte utfordringer. 

Det er høy fagkompetanse i våre soner, og vi ønsker enda flere dyktige kollegaer som kan være med å skape et godt og lærende arbeidsmiljø. 
Hverdagsmestring for hver enkelt bruker står i sentrum og skal vise igjen i tjenestene vi gir.

Arbeidstid er på dag/kveld og hver 2. eller 3. helg med unntak av dem som jobber langvakter med helg hver 4. helg. Vi planlegger i stor grad vakter, møter og kompetansehevende tiltak inn i årsplan. 

Vil du være en del av vårt flotte team, så ta kontakt!


Arbeidsoppgaver

Pleie og omsorg til tjenestemottakere i eget hjem.

Dette kan innebære medisinske oppgaver, stell, observasjoner, veiledning og dokumentasjon m.m.
Oppfølging av brukere sammen med andre tjenester, internt og eksternt.
Samarbeid med kolleger på tvers av arbeidsgrupper.
Bruker- og pårørendesamarbeid.

Som ansatt i hjemmetjenesten må du gjennomføre og bestå medisinkurs, gjennomføre opplæringsvakter og du må kunne kjøre bil.

Hjemmetjenesten jobber ut i fra hjemmerehabiliteringprinsippet og hva som er viktig for hver enkelt innbygger.

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Førerkort
  • Gode norskkunnskaper skriftlig og muntlig
  • Stilling hos oss krever høy grad av tilstedeværelse
  • Tidligere erfaring fra helserelatert omsorg er ønskelig, men ikke et krav. Opplæring vil bli gitt.
  • Gode IT ferdigheter
 

 

Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er god på samarbeide
  • Du er punktlig og pliktoppfyllende
  • Du kan se andre mennesker
  • Du klarer å holde hodet kaldt når det koker litt ekstra
  • Du har omsorg å gi til dem som trenger litt ekstra
  • Personlig egnethet vektlegges
Vi tilbyr
  • Velferdsordninger og gode pensjons- og forsikringsvilkår
  • Lønn i henhold til KS garantilønnsstige og lokal lønnspolitikk

title: Project & Business Coordinator
employer: AVINCIS AVIATION NORWAY AS BASE TROMSØ
description:
Avincis is looking for a Project & Business Coordinator to join our Nordic organisation. This is a broad and highly collaborative role where you will work closely with our Nordic management team and colleagues across Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark. 

You will be at the centre of projects, business improvement initiatives and management activities that span functions and countries. From coordinating strategic projects and Management of Change processes to supporting business cases, contracts and performance reporting, you will help ensure that priorities move forward and that decisions are translated into action. 

For the right person, this is an excellent opportunity to gain broad exposure to a complex, international aviation business and work closely with senior management.

Location: Stockholm, Tromsø or Esbjerg

Reports to: Managing Director Nordics



The role

As our Project & Business Coordinator, you will support and coordinate strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects across the Nordic organisation. 

You will bring structure, follow-up and momentum to projects and business activities, while also supporting the Nordic management team with analysis, reporting, contracts and decision-making material. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Coordinating cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the Nordics 
  • Developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, budgets, risk registers and progress reporting 
  • Coordinating Management of Change (MOC) processes and ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up 
  • Supporting the preparation of business cases, investment proposals and cost-saving initiatives 
  • Facilitating project meetings, workshops and steering group meetings and following up agreed actions 
  • Supporting contract administration, negotiations, renewals and amendments 
  • Supporting commercial activities and tender processes 
  • Preparing management reports, presentations and decision-making material 
  • Analysing operational and financial performance and supporting KPI and dashboard reporting 
  • Identifying opportunities to improve, simplify and standardise processes across the Nordic organisation 
  • Supporting strategic planning, organisational development and change initiatives 
  • Acting as a connecting point between management, operational teams and support functions across countries 
Who are we looking for?

We believe you are a structured and proactive person who enjoys working in an environment where priorities can change and where collaboration is essential. 

You are comfortable coordinating several activities at the same time and know how to create clarity and progress without losing sight of the bigger picture. You enjoy working with people across different functions and levels of an organisation and are confident interacting with senior stakeholders. 

You probably have experience from project coordination, project management, business support, business development or a similar role. 

We would also like you to have: 

  • Strong organisational and project management or coordination skills 
  • An understanding of financial analysis and business cases 
  • Good analytical and problem-solving capabilities 
  • Experience or understanding of contract administration and commercial processes 
  • An understanding of risk management and governance 
  • Strong communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language 
  • Experience supporting management teams and senior stakeholders 
  • Experience from aviation or another regulated industry, tender or procurement processes, Management of Change and/or SAP is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What will make you successful? 

You are someone who takes ownership and makes things happen. You enjoy creating structure where there are many moving parts, following up on actions and ensuring that projects continue to move forward. 

At the same time, you are curious about the business behind the projects. You want to understand why we are doing something, not just what needs to be done. 

You are collaborative, pragmatic and comfortable working across different countries, functions and cultures. 

Why join Avincis?

At Avincis, our work has a clear purpose. We provide critical aviation services across Europe, supporting missions where aviation makes a real difference. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across our Nordic organisation and gain insight into many different parts of the business. You will work closely with Nordic management while collaborating with colleagues in operations, finance, safety, HR, procurement and other functions. 

It is a role with broad exposure, significant variety and the opportunity to influence how we work across the Nordics. 

If you are looking for a role where you can combine projects, business, analysis and collaboration – and where no two days are quite the same – we would love to hear from you. 

Ready to take the next step? Apply and become part of Avincis Nordics.

Project Manager / Delivery Assurance for SAP and Service Now (f/m/d)

Full or part time

At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we drive innovation – from advisory and implementation to managed services and beyond, powered by a global team of over 18,500 experts representing over 90 nations in more than 30 countries. We are part of NTT DATA, a $30+ billion business and technology services, AI and digital infrastructure leader. As a Global Top Employer, NTT DATA serves 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and, with experts in over 70 countries, co-innovates solutions that encourage experimentation and recognize great work.

With us, you have endless opportunities to think big, act bold and take ownership. Make this the place where you belong, learn, and build your network.

**Make this the place where you grow

**Location: **Germany, Poland, Bulgaria or Romania

What makes us special:

We have a holistic view of the individual needs of our employees. Here (https://nttdata-solutions.com/de/karriere/benefits/)  you can find a detailed overview of our wide variety of benefits during different life phases.

■ Flexible working hours and locations: workation, mobile working, part-time models, sabbaticals, etc.

■ Your further development by plan: topic-specific induction, targeted career development based on career models, programs and your own academy

■ Family first: e.g. daycare allowance, paid maternity leave and paternity network

■ SAP Platinum Partnership: strong SAP partnership, large knowledge network, and SAP Learning Hub and certification opportunities.

■ We take care: e.g. 25% subsidy for company pension plan, company health management and cooperation with fitness providers

■ We help you get from A to B: company car (depending on your role), discount on public transport and bicycle leasing via JobRad®.

Do you love challenges?

As Project / Delivery Assurance Manager for SAP and ServiceNow Projects and Managed Services, you will be responsible for:

■ Conducting risk and quality assessments for new and existing large customer engagements, ensuring SAP and ServiceNow-specific risks are addressed.

■ Providing feedback on the Deal Governance process to ensure that new projects and services meet agreed standards and quality expectations.

■ Supporting Red/Amber projects by developing and executing "Back to Green" action plans, including internal management reporting.

■ Managing customer escalations: leading top management customer escalations, supporting executive management in the de-escalation process, addressing root causes, and restoring customer confidence.

■ Defining the necessary quality checks for SAP and ServiceNow projects and services to ensure quality, speed and profitability

Convince us with your potential!

■ Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field

Several years of work experience in Delivery Assurance, Project and/or Services Management proves your:

■ Expertise in SAP and ServiceNow within complex enterprise environments

■ Delivery assurance skills, supported by certification (e.g. Six Sigma)

■ Strong project/service management and leadership abilities

■ Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach

■ Excellent communication and collaboration skills with technical and business stakeholders

■ Commitment to continuous improvement, attention to detail, and adaptability under pressure

■ Knowledge of IT standards and regulations (ISO 9001, CMMI, GDPR)

■ Proficiency in written and spoken English and German

title: Senior Accountant Manager  (Leiter/in - Finanz- und Rechnungswesen)
description:
Senior Accountant Manager

Opis firmy

Ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach, które imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast, a wszystko to w atrakcyjnej cenie. Jako założyciel i prekursor koncepcji budget design, z sukcesem rozwijamy się w metropoliach Europy i poza nią.

Opis oferty pracy

- Prowadzenie i nadzór nad księgowością operacyjną hoteli w Polsce zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami oraz wytycznymi Centrali;
- Uzgadnianie rejestru VAT zakupu i sprzedaży;
- Raportowanie wyników finansowych dla hoteli w Gdańsku i Warszawie do Centrali, w tym analiza odchyleń oraz rekomendowanie działań korygujących.
- Ścisła współpraca z działem Controllingu, audytorami i pozostałymi działami hotelowymi w zakresie zagadnień finansowych, w tym obsługi procesów KSeF.
- Przygotowywanie przelewów do płatności, księgowanie wyciągów, rozliczanie kart kredytowych
- Przygotowywanie tygodniowych, miesięcznych i rocznych raportów finansowych zgodnie z wymaganiami działu kontroli finansowej.
- Czynny udział w procesach zamknięcia miesiąca, obejmujący uzgadnianie kont, kontrolę kosztów, inwentaryzację oraz weryfikację danych operacyjnych hoteli.
- Zapewnienie terminowego przygotowania dokumentacji do składania deklaracji podatkowych oraz zgodności z przepisami prawa podatkowego.
- Wsparcie w bieżących analizach finansowych oraz projektach związanych z optymalizacją kosztów i efektywnością operacyjną hoteli.
- Dbanie o prawidłowy obieg dokumentów w firmie oraz weryfikacja prawidłowości dokumentów księgowych

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Kwalifikacje

- Wyższe wykształcenie ekonomiczne;
- Min. 4 lata doświadczenia w dziale kontrolingu, mile widziane w branży hotelarskiej;
- Praktyczna, zaawansowana znajomość pakietu MS Office (w szczególności Excel);
- Znajomość języka angielskiego lub niemieckiego - warunek konieczny;
- Znajomość specyfiki finansów hotelowych (USALI) oraz wskaźników charakterystycznych dla branży hotelarskiej;
- Wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności analitycznego myślenia;
- Samodzielność oraz dobra organizacja pracy;
- Odpowiedzialność i terminowość;
- Gotowość do odbywania delegacji służbowych.

title: Global Supplier Quality Manager (m/w/d) (Supply-Chain-Manager/in)
description:
Kelvion

Unsere Mission ist es, mit Innovationskraft und Nachhaltigkeit die industrielle Transformation voranzutreiben. Ob bei der Optimierung von Rechenzentren, der Weiterentwicklung der Wasserstoffproduktion oder der Neugestaltung von Kühl- und Klimatechniksystemen – unsere thermischen Schlüsseltechnologien stärken zahlreiche Branchen weltweit. Als „One Kelvion“ arbeiten wir kontinuierlich an Lösungen, die unsere Kunden noch erfolgreicher machen und gleichzeitig zu einer nachhaltigeren Zukunft beitragen.

Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsam

Stellenbeschreibung

Ihre Aufgaben:

➢ Globale Supplier-Quality-Strategie: Definition und Umsetzung einer global ausgerichteten Supplier-Quality-Strategie im Einklang mit den Qualitätszielen, operativen Prioritäten und Wachstumsanforderungen von Kelvion.

➢ Standardisierung & Governance: Entwicklung, Einführung und Harmonisierung globaler Supplier-Quality-Prozesse über Produktionsstandorte, Regionen und Business Units hinweg.

➢ Lieferantenqualifizierung & -entwicklung: Aufbau durchgängiger Standards für Lieferantenqualifizierung, Onboarding, Audits, APQP, PPAP, Lieferantenänderungsmanagement, Wareneingangsqualität, Non-Conformance-Management, CAPA und Performance Monitoring.

➢ Supplier Performance Excellence: Durchführung und Steuerung von Lieferantenentwicklungs- und Recovery-Programmen zur Verbesserung von Qualität, Liefertreue, Prozessfähigkeit und nachhaltiger Lieferantenperformance.

➢ Präventive Qualitätsarbeit: Weiterentwicklung der Supplier-Quality-Organisation von einem reaktiven, prüfungsgetriebenen Ansatz hin zu einem präventiven, strukturierten und datenbasierten Qualitätsmodell.

➢ Problemlösung & kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Stärkung von Root-Cause-Analysen, 8D-Problemlösung, CAPA-Disziplin und nachhaltiger Umsetzung von Korrekturmaßnahmen innerhalb der Lieferantenbasis.

➢ KPI, Reporting & Transparenz: Definition von Supplier-Quality-KPIs, Reporting-Strukturen, Dashboards und Governance-Routinen zur Schaffung von Transparenz, Verbindlichkeit und kontinuierlicher Steuerung.

➢ Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Procurement, Manufacturing, Engineering, Logistics, Operations sowie regionalen Quality-Teams zur frühzeitigen Identifikation und Reduzierung lieferantenbezogener Risiken.

➢ Audits & Compliance: Durchführung und Koordination von Lieferantenaudits, Prozessaudits, Performance Reviews und Benchmarking-Aktivitäten unter Berücksichtigung relevanter Kunden-, regulatorischer, Industrie- und Qualitätsmanagementanforderungen, insbesondere ISO 9001.

➢ Funktionale Führung: Fachliche Führung lokaler Supplier Quality Engineers und Förderung einer globalen Qualitätskultur, die auf Prävention, Verantwortung, kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und operativer Disziplin basiert.

Ihr Profil:

➢ Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium im Bereich Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.

➢ Mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung im Supplier Quality Management, Manufacturing Quality oder Quality Management in einem industriellen Produktionsumfeld.

➢ Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Aufbau, in der Weiterentwicklung oder Harmonisierung von Supplier-Quality-Organisationen über Standorte, Regionen oder Business Units hinweg.

➢ Fundierte Expertise in Supplier Quality Management, Lieferantenentwicklung, Lieferantenaudits, Prozessaudits, Lieferantenqualifizierung und Performance Improvement.

➢ Praktische Erfahrung mit APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, 8D, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, Risikomanagement und Qualitätsmanagementsystemen.

➢ Erfahrung in globalen Produktions- und Lieferantenstrukturen; Erfahrung aus der Automobilindustrie oder einem vergleichbar reifen Qualitätsumfeld ist von Vorteil.

➢ Fähigkeit, in einer Matrixorganisation fachlich zu führen, Stakeholder über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg zu beeinflussen und globale Standards pragmatisch umzusetzen.

➢ Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie Bereitschaft zu internationalen Reisen von ca. 30–50 %.

Unser Erfolg basiert auf Zusammenarbeit – wir fördern vielfältiges Denken, hören einander zu und schätzen jede einzelne Stimme. Kreativität entfaltet sich bei Kelvion dort, wo Menschen gehört, ihre Ideen willkommen geheißen und ihre Beiträge anerkannt werden.

Mit einem flexiblen Arbeitsansatz stellen wir das Wohlbefinden und die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeitenden in den Mittelpunkt. Dies stärkt die Bereitschaft sich einzubringen und eröffnet damit neue Karrierechancen Wir ermutigen engagierte Persönlichkeiten ihre Entwicklung selbst in die Hand zu nehmen, neue Wege zu gehen und gemeinsam mit uns Zukunft zu gestalten.

Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsam

English Version

Global Supplier Quality Manager (m/w/d)

Kelvion

Our mission is to lead the industrial transformation by championing innovation and sustainability. From optimising data centres and advancing hydrogen production to revolutionising refrigeration and HVAC systems, our mission-critical thermal solutions empower industries around the globe. United as “One Kelvion,” our global team delivers innovative solutions that drive customer success and support a sustainable future.

Together, We Shape the Future

Job Description

Your responsibilities:

➢ Global supplier quality strategy: Define and execute the global supplier quality strategy in line with Kelvion’s quality objectives, operational priorities and business growth requirements.

➢ Standardisation & governance: Develop, implement and harmonise global supplier quality processes across manufacturing sites, regions and business units.

➢ Supplier qualification & development: Establish end-to-end standards for supplier qualification, onboarding, audits, APQP, PPAP, supplier change management, incoming quality control, non-conformance management, CAPA and performance monitoring.

➢ Supplier performance excellence: Drive supplier development and recovery programmes to improve quality, delivery reliability, process capability and long-term supplier performance.

➢ Preventive quality approach: Further develop the supplier quality organisation from a reactive, incoming-inspection-driven approach towards a preventive, structured and data-driven quality model.

➢ Problem solving & continuous improvement: Strengthen root cause analysis, 8D problem solving, CAPA discipline and sustainable corrective action follow-up across the supplier base.

➢ KPIs, reporting & transparency: Define supplier quality KPIs, reporting structures, dashboards and governance routines to create transparency, accountability and continuous performance management.

➢ Stakeholder collaboration: Work closely with Procurement, Manufacturing, Engineering, Logistics, Operations and regional Quality teams to proactively identify and mitigate supplier-related risks.

➢ Audits & compliance: Conduct and coordinate supplier audits, process audits, performance reviews and benchmarking activities, ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, industry and quality management system requirements, including ISO 9001.

➢ Functional leadership: Provide functional leadership to local Supplier Quality Engineers and strengthen a global quality culture focused on prevention, accountability, continuous improvement and operational discipline.

Your profile:

➢ Master’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain or a related technical discipline.

➢ At least 6 years of experience in Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality or Quality Management within an industrial manufacturing environment.

➢ Proven experience in building, developing or harmonising supplier quality organisations across sites, regions or business units.

➢ Strong expertise in supplier quality management, supplier development, supplier audits, process audits, supplier qualification and performance improvement.

➢ Practical experience with APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, 8D, CAPA, root cause analysis, risk management and quality management systems.

➢ Experience in global manufacturing and supplier environments; experience in the automotive industry or a similarly mature quality environment is an advantage.

➢ Ability to lead functionally in a matrix organisation, influence stakeholders across functions and regions and implement global standards pragmatically.

➢ Fluent English skills and willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30–50 %.

At Kelvion we thrive on collaboration, embracing diversity of thought, and valuing every voice. Within Kelvion creativity shines because people are listened to, their contributions recognised, and their ideas welcomed. Our flexible approach to the way we work places people’s health and satisfaction as a priority, enhancing engagement and fostering career opportunities. We empower engaged individuals to grow, progress and carve their own paths within the company.

Together, We Shape the Future

title: Nurse (Poland) (Krankenschwester/-pfleger)
description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Nurse

Stellenbeschreibung:
Job Title: Nurse

International SOS is the world’s leading medical and security services company with over 12,000 employees working in 1,000 locations in 90 countries. International SOS Government Services administers the TRICARE Overseas Program providing high-quality, accessible health care services for U.S. Military service members, family members, retirees, and other eligible beneficiaries overseas.

About the role

- Perhaps you live abroad and would like to return to Poland?
- Do you have a Polish nursing license?
- Looking to apply your experience in a new environment?
- Is it time to move away from the demands of clinical care in a hospital environment?
- Do you speak Polish and English?

We are looking for a Nurse (known internally as a Near Patient Nurse) based in Poznan or within proximity, to support our global patient care program, TRICARE. You will be responsible for providing medical case management for patients, visiting them at healthcare provider sites, writing medical reports and providing medical updates.

This is a fantastic opportunity for nurses to move away from the demands of a clinical environment to an on-site case manager role using their medical expertise.

Key responsibilities

- The nurse would provide comprehensive in-patient clinical case management
- Develop and maintain effective relationships with providers, (medical and administrative) internal and external stakeholders and suppliers to ensure excellent delivery of service
- Regularly visit or contact the care providers (civilian and military treatment facility centers) to obtain updates for medical cases
- Liaise with patients to obtain detailed clinical information including past medical history to allow for accurate on-going case management
- Support the medical collection team in obtaining the discharge summary and medical records from the care provider

About you

- Registered General Nurse or equivalent with minimum 3 years of experience with registration to practice in Poland
- Recognized qualification to minimum diploma level or equivalence in practice demonstrated through portfolio/CV
- A demonstrable commitment to professional development
- Able to communicate Polish and proficiently in English
- Own a car and have a clean license
- Passionate about international healthcare

Benefits

- 15,900 PLN car allowance per annum
- 2,400 PLN home allowance per annum
- Structured career development track, with opportunities for progression and advancement
- Warm, supportive, and open company culture
- An opportunity to thrive in a global environment
- We celebrate diversity on a global scale and encourage every colleague to bring their personal best by creating an environment of inclusion and equal support

At International SOS, we offer a great working environment, thanks to our commitment to flexible working, diversity, and development.  We encourage every person to be their personal best by creating an environment of inclusion, equality and support.

title: Vice President Turbo Charging Research & Development (m/f/d)
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled, strategic and innovative Vice President R&D to lead and manage the research and development of new turbocharging products, components, and technologies within our organization.

In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the entire R&D process, including product performance testing, validation, and ensuring product safety and reliability. You will lead a team of ca 120 R&D employees and manage a budget of over 50 MUSD. You will collaborate closely with the division presidents and other senior leaders to ensure that all product releases meet the highest standards before launch. You and your experts will also support the process of technology scouting beyond turbocharging. Located in Baden, you will report to the CEO and be part of the extended management team.  

Your Responsibilities:

1. R&D Strategy and Leadership:

Lead and manage the turbocharging R&D department to drive the development of new products, components, technologies and engineering methodologies aligned with the company’s strategic goals.
Define and execute the TC R&D strategy ensuring it supports the company's vision and objectives.
Foster an innovative environment that encourages creative solutions, research breakthroughs, and efficient development processes.
Secure that the R&D budget is spent efficiently on related projects and initiatives.
Represent the company in industry organizations and initiatives, (eg. CIMAC Greenhouse Gas Strategy Group, Swissmem industry sector for the internal combustion engine industry), and support the Swiss IMO delegation.
2. Product Development and Innovation:

Oversee the development of new products from concept through to prototype, ensuring that each product meets performance, safety, and reliability standards.
Manage the research and design process to ensure efficient, cost-effective product development that reflects the customer needs and is in line with Accelleron Product Market Strategy.

3. Product Performance Testing and Validation:

Ensure that robust testing and validation processes are in place to assess product performance and reliability with adherence to safety and quality standards.
Maintain and continuously develop testing and computing infrastructure.
Focus on improving product performance, reliability and safety.
Identify potential risks and implement corrective actions throughout the product lifecycle.

4. Collaboration with Management:

Work closely with the Division Presidents and senior management to ensure alignment on product development goals and timelines.
Jointly approve and sign-off on all product releases with the Division Presidents to ensure that all products meet the required standards before market launch.
Enhance the opportunities that AI provides in collaboration with AI organization.
Collaborate with Vice President Strategy and Investor Relations on scouting of new technologies.

5. Continuous Improvement:

Identify opportunities for process improvements within the R&D department and across the organization to optimize efficiency and productivity.
Stay current on industry trends, research methodologies, AI and emerging technologies to maintain competitive advantage and drive innovation.
Build and maintain networks with diverse stakeholders such as universities, research institutions and associations to gain broad perspective of development and to represent the company.

6. Leadership and Development:

Lead, mentor, and manage the R&D team, ensuring that each member is supported in their professional development and empowered to contribute to the team’s success.
Secure that competences needed now and in the future are acquired and developed.
Foster a collaborative, high-performance and effective safety culture within the department.

​Your Qualifications:

In depth and proven knowledge of turbocharging technologies and research methodologies including an advanced degree in mechanical engineering.
Robust experience of leading R&D operations and engineering globally across a complex technology portfolio.
Strong track record of creating and leading technology strategies, investment prioritization and innovation portfolios, preferably on enterprise level and closely aligned with business strategy.
Experience of repeatedly leading technology development from concept through validation to market introduction, especially leading turbocharger programs successfully converting innovation into commercial outcomes.
Deep understanding of product performance testing, validation, safety, and reliability assessments as well as regulatory compliance.
Exceptional stakeholder and influencing skills based on having regularly interfaced with executive leadership, government agencies, universities, industry consortia and regulatory bodies while advising on technology and policy topics.
Excellent leadership skills with collaborative and people-focused leadership style proven in successfully leading sizable global teams.
Future technology and innovation orientation combined with strong business and investment acumen.
Curiosity, learning agility and entrepreneurial mindset.

Your benefits:

Attractive compensation & benefits
Employee Assistance Program
Global parental leave program
Flexible working models
We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about Accelleron, take another look at our website accelleron.com.
