Application

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Bartosz Kopczynski, tel. +358 44 027 4811, on Friday, 14 August 2026, between 15:00 and 16:00 (EEST), or Thursday, 20 August 2026, between 14:00 and 15:00 (EEST).

Ready to take your career to the next level at Dynava? Send your application and CV in English to our recruitment team. We look forward to hearing from you! Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis; we aim to respond within one week of the posting closing.

title: Senior Customs Compliance Advisor.
description:
Think Global, Work Local with Maersk Customs Service!

Are you ready to be part of an organization on an industry-defining transformation journey that will change the world?

Maersk, a global leader in logistics, is on a journey to transform the logistics industry and Customs Services is at the heart of this integrator strategy.  With end-to-end customs visibility, Maersk Customs Services, offer global reach and local expertise to help customers navigate customs processes, and seamlessly coordinate their supply chains, ensuring the timely movement of goods.

To work at Maersk Customs Services is to work with the world. With over 60,000 unique customers, actively trading in 139 countries worldwide with a global delivery network spread across 113 countries, you will be working in a truly international environment.

Our end-to-end logistics services is constantly improving and with that our growing suite of digital solutions as well, which you can use to your benefit as part of our team in Customs Services.

Find yourself welcome in our diverse and inclusive culture, working alongside a team of more than 2,200 trade and customs experts around the world, where you are valued for who you are and rewarded for what you bring.

Are you ready to play your part in this?

Are you passionate about customs regulations, compliance and risk management?

We are currently looking for a Senior Customs Compliance Advisor.

We are looking for an engaged and proactive Senior Customs Compliance Advisor who wants to play a key role in strengthening our compliance program and ensuring adherence to customs regulations, laws, regulations and internal policies.

As a Senior Customs Compliance Advisor, you will play a key role in ensuring compliance with applicable customs legislation, regulatory requirements, and internal processes. You will proactively identify and mitigate risks while supporting the business in meeting both regulatory and customer requirements.

The role requires a strong understanding of the customs strategy at the Customs Delivery level, with a particular focus on Customs Compliance within the assigned area. You will be responsible for leading and contributing to both internal and external projects, working closely with stakeholders across the organization and with customers.

The ideal candidate will bring solid experience and strong expertise within the customs field, combined with a thorough understanding of customs compliance, regulatory requirements, and business processes.

The Nordic Customs Compliance department currently consists of 16 employees, with a focus on understanding and interpreting legal requirements and regulatory changes to ensure compliance with applicable regulations, policies, and guidelines. We are an internal support function that assists the organization with customs-related matters and provides guidance on customs compliance issues.

Key Responsibilities

    Provide advice and support to the business on compliance and ethical matters.
    Monitoring regulatory changes and ensuring implementation in the organization, as well as assess their impact on the business.
    Conduct risk assessments and quality reviews.
    Support the Country Compliance Managers in the Area.
    Initiating and/or attending meetings with customers and authorities.
    Propose, participate, and lead customs related projects.
    Follow up on whistleblowing cases and support internal investigations when required.
    Contribute to reporting and presentations for management and relevant stakeholders.

Qualifications

    Education and/or experience relevant to compliance, customs regulations, risk management or international trade.
    Experience within compliance, internal controls, auditing, risk management or related disciplines.
    Solid understanding of relevant regulatory requirements and compliance frameworks.
    Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical business solutions.
    Excellent communication skills in one of the Scandinavian languages as well as English, written and spoken.

Personal Attributes

    Responsible and reliable, with a proactive mindset.
    Structured, self-driven and customer-focused with commitment to delivering high-quality service.
    Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build relationships across the organization.
    Comfortable challenging others and providing clear guidance when needed.
    Solution-oriented with a pragmatic approach.

What we Offer

An exciting role in a company with ambitious goals within compliance and sustainability. This position provides varied responsibilities and the opportunity to influence the development of our compliance program. We work in an inclusive and professional working environment, with excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.

We look forward to receiving your application and learning how you can contribute to strengthening our compliance team.

title: Data Center Technician
description:
Data Center Technician / Datacentertekniker

Diginext Sweden AB – Stockholm

Number of positions: 7

Employment form: Fixed-term employment (särskild visstidsanställning), 12 months

Start date: By agreement

Application deadline: 22 Aug 2026

About Diginext Sweden AB

Diginext Sweden AB is a Stockholm-based technology company specializing in data center infrastructure, structured cabling, and network solutions. We provide cutting-edge technical services to some of Scandinavia’s leading corporations, ensuring efficient and reliable data center operations.

As we continue to expand, we are looking for a skilled Data Center Technician to join our team and play a vital role in installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting data center infrastructure across Sweden and the broader Scandinavian region.

The role

As a Data Centre Technician at Diginext Sweden AB, you will be responsible for supporting the installation, maintenance, testing, and troubleshooting of critical data centre and network infrastructure. Your work will include structured copper and fibre-optic cabling, rack-and-stack activities, equipment installation, testing, documentation, and technical support.

You will work closely with project managers, team leaders, clients, and other contractors to ensure all tasks are completed safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. The role involves working at various project sites with flexibility required for travel, shift work, and weekends.

Main responsibilities

    Install, terminate, label and test copper (Cat6, Cat6A) and fibre-optic cabling.
    Carry out fibre splicing, patching and testing using OTDR and optical power meters.
    Certify copper cabling using Fluke test equipment and record test results accurately.
    Install racks, cabinets, patch panels, cable management systems and containment.
    Carry out rack-and-stack installation of servers, switches, routers and other network equipment.
    Perform hardware upgrades, replacements, decommissioning and equipment relocations.
    Troubleshoot cabling, connectivity, network hardware and infrastructure faults.
    Work from technical drawings, cable schedules, method statements and project instructions.
    Maintain accurate installation records, test reports, asset information and project documentation.
    Comply with data centre access controls, security policies and change management procedures.
    Follow all health and safety requirements, including correct use of PPE and safe working practices.
    Provide remote-hands and on-site technical support when required.
    Coordinate with project managers, team leaders, clients and other contractors so that work is completed efficiently.
    Use power tools, hand tools, cable-pulling equipment and fibre-cleaning tools safely and correctly.
    Maintain tools, equipment and materials, and keep a clean and organised work area.



Requirements

    Technical education in IT, telecommunications, networking, electrical engineering or a comparable field, or equivalent documented practical experience.
    Documented practical experience of copper and fibre-optic cabling installation, termination and testing.
    Working knowledge of network equipment, server hardware and data centre operations.
    Ability to work from technical drawings, cable schedules, work instructions and method statements.
    Working proficiency in Swedish or English, spoken and written, sufficient to follow written work instructions and safety documentation and to communicate on client sites.
    Driving licence category B.
    Availability for shift work, including night shifts, and for evening and weekend work when projects require it.
    Ability to carry out the physical tasks the role involves, including lifting equipment, pulling cables and working at height.

Meritorious

    Experience of fibre splicing and testing with OTDR and optical power meters.
    Experience of copper cable certification with Fluke test equipment.
    Basic understanding of TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, VLANs, switches and routers.
    MEWP/lift certification (liftutbildning according to SS-ISO 18878) or working-at-height training.
    Certification in fibre-optic installation or structured cabling from a recognised manufacturer or industry body.
    Experience of working in secure or access-controlled environments.



Personal and professional attributes

    Works in a structured, quality-focused manner, with the attention to detail required for accurate termination, testing and documentation.
    Works independently on assigned tasks while contributing effectively within a project team.
    Applies a methodical, solution-oriented approach to diagnosing and resolving technical faults.
    Maintains a dependable and professional standard of conduct on client premises, including punctuality and adherence to site rules and security procedures.
    Adapts readily to changing project requirements, locations and working hours.
    Communicates clearly and constructively with colleagues, clients and other contractors on site.
    Plans and prioritises own work to meet project deadlines and quality standards.
    Takes an active interest in developing skills in new technologies, tools and working methods.



Terms of employment

Salary, insurance cover and other terms of employment correspond to what is customary within the occupation and industry in Sweden (branschpraxis).

The employer provides, from the first day of employment:

    Health insurance (sjukförsäkring)
    Life insurance (livförsäkring)
    Occupational injury insurance (trygghetsförsäkring vid arbetsskada, TFA)
    Occupational pension (tjänstepension)

We also provide PPE, workwear and all necessary tools and equipment, technical training and professional certification, and a wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag).

What we offer

    Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.
    Opportunities to work on major data centre and network infrastructure projects across Scandinavia.
    Professional training, certification, and career-development opportunities.
    A supportive, multicultural, and collaborative working environment.
    Access to modern tools, equipment, and industry-leading technologies.
    Opportunities for career progression within a fast-growing international company.



How to apply

Application deadline: 23 Aug 2026

Submit your CV and cover letter to careers@diginext.se with the subject: "Application – Data Center Technician, Diginext Sweden AB."

Diginext Sweden AB is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applications from qualified individuals of all backgrounds.

title: Open call: Visiting Professors at Chalmers University of Technology
description:
Chalmers University of Technology invites applications from internationally distinguished professors to join the Academic Excellence Visiting Professor Programme 2027–2028. This highly selective university-wide initiative is designed to attract outstanding professors whose academic excellence, leadership and international networks can contribute to the development of world-leading research and education environments at Chalmers.

About Chalmers and our vision

Chalmers’ long‑term vision is to be “a globally outstanding university of technology, for a better world”, with academic quality at the highest European level and highly effective utilisation of research results in society. We are currently implementing a group strategy and major investments in excellence‑driven research to become a world‑class technical university by 2041, including strengthened base funding and outstanding conditions for research. Our campus and surrounding ecosystem form a dynamic innovation environment where researchers, students and external partners co-create sustainable solutions for industry and society.

The Academic Excellence Visiting Professor Programme is a strategic component of Chalmers’ internationalisation strategy. The programme aims to strengthen academic excellence by attracting internationally recognised academic leaders who can contribute to the long-term development of Chalmers’ research, education and international collaborations. Beyond individual academic achievements, the programme seeks to create lasting value through strategic partnerships, scientific leadership, mentorship and the development of strong academic environments.

The Visiting Professor role

As a Visiting Professor, you will contribute to the development of Chalmers’ academic environments through research leadership, international collaboration, mentorship, doctoral education and strategic academic engagement. Activities may include initiating new research collaborations, strengthening international networks, contributing to educational development, mentoring early-career researchers and supporting the long-term development of the host environment.

The Academic Excellence Visiting Professor Programme at Chalmers will run during 2027-2028.

The appointment is a part-time engagement, corresponding to up to 20% of a full-time position for a maximum of two years. Visiting professors are expected to maintain their affiliation with their home institution throughout the appointment. The level of engagement, duration and duties will be agreed jointly between the visiting professor, the host department and Chalmers. Financial arrangements will be tailored to the specific circumstances of each appointment.

Please note that the position concerns a Visiting Professor and not a regular professorship with permanent employment.

Qualifications

According to Chalmers’ Appointment Regulation for teaching and research staff, a Visiting Professor must:

    Hold a full professorship, or an equivalent appointment at the highest academic rank, at a reputable university.
    Be able to contribute to both research and education at Chalmers, including supervision and mentoring of students and early‑career researchers.
    Be prepared to take an active role in collaboration with external partners and in the academic life of the hosting department.

Who we invite

This is an open call aimed at established researchers who have an outstanding record of scientific achievement and are internationally recognised as an academic leader within their field and who wish to spend a period of time in Gothenburg.

Only a limited number of appointments will be made through this highly selective programme. Candidates will be assessed not only on their academic achievements and international standing, but also on their potential to contribute to the development of Chalmers’ academic environments and international position.

Expression of interest/application

If you are interested in exploring a Visiting Professor appointment at Chalmers, please submit an expression of interest including:

A brief cover letter describing:

    your motivation for applying for the visiting professorship;
    your proposed area(s) of collaboration and suggested research group(s).
    the part(s) of Chalmers' research, education, innovation, or other activities to which you would like to contribute; and
    your preferred timing and duration of the visit
    a short CV with selected key publications and major grants or honours
    a statement (1–2 pages) describing how you envision contributing to Chalmers’ development and its long‑term vision.

Applications will be evaluated by relevant departments after the application deadline. Shortlisted candidates will then be invited for a first digital interview.

Application deadline: August 15, 2026

Please note: Due to EU regulations (GDPR), we cannot accept applications via e-mail. Please register your application through the apply button below.

A background check may be conducted as part of the application process.

Welcome with your application.

Contact

For questions, please contact The Recruitment Unit at: rekr.stodet@chalmers.se

*** Chalmers declines to consider all offers of further announcement publishing or other types of support for the recruiting process in connection with this position. ***

Working at Chalmers

Chalmers provides a dynamic and inspiring environment in the coastal city of Gothenburg, combining academic excellence with a strong commitment to sustainability, equality, and collaboration.





Read more about working at Chalmers and our employee benefits. Learn more about life in Gothenburg and Sweden’s family-friendly policies, including generous parental leave, subsidized childcare, free education, and universal healthcare, at Move To Gothenburg.





Chalmers promotes gender balance and actively works with equality and inclusion initiatives, such as the GENIE Initiative for gender equality and excellence.

title: Senior Manager Scientific Engagement
description:
Join us to deliver a smoke- free future as Senior Manager Scientific Engagement!

We’ve chosen to do something remarkable. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future with one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and has been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.

In the Nordic region, we are around 1,800 employees based in Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway and together we are collaborating to deliver a smoke-free Nordics.



Role summary:

As Senior Manager Scientific Engagement, you will lead initiatives that use scientific evidence to support appropriate regulation and increase understanding of tobacco harm reduction and smoke-free products. You will build trusted relationships with key opinion leaders, shape clear and compelling scientific narratives, and engage regulators, the scientific community, and wider society through forums, conferences, publications, and other channels. You will also act as the local focal point for pre- and post-marketing scientific matters.



This role can be based in either Stockholm, Copenhagen or Olso.



Key responsibilities:

    Develop and drive the Nordic Scientific Engagement Strategy to support appropriate regulation and understanding of tobacco harm reduction.
    Develop the scientific communication strategy and localized narrative based on recent scientific developments and current and emerging external and internal needs.
    Build and maintain a network of international and local key opinion leaders to foster advocacy and support for tobacco harm reduction.
    Provide guidance, coaching, and training on the science of smoke-free products across the organization.
    Drive function-level projects and initiatives focused on developing and implementing new processes or standards both within and outside the function.
    Navigate complex tobacco and nicotine regulatory issues through rigorous analysis and cross-functional collaboration.
    Refine and improve existing scientific engagement processes through innovative problem-solving and conceptualizing new approaches to operational challenges.
    Drive the implementation of AI-tools in Scientific Engagement.
    Ensure compliance with relevant national legalization and global policies regarding scientific activities around tobacco and nicotine.



Who you are:

    Academic background in life sciences, public health, pharmacy, medicine, toxicology, regulatory science, or a related field
    5+ years of experience in a scientific, medical, regulatory, public affairs, or external engagement role.
    Experience working in a highly regulated industry, such as tobacco/nicotine, pharmaceuticals, medtech, healthcare, food, or chemicals.
    Proven ability to translate complex scientific evidence into clear, engaging messages for different audiences.
    Experience engaging with external partners, such as regulators, scientific experts, public health stakeholders or industry bodies.
    Experience working in a cross-functional and international/matrix environment.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and at least one Scandinavian language.
    Agile and confident to work in areas with uncertainty and a rapidly moving external environment.
    Willing to travel across the Nordics and to international events.
    High confidence in representing a company, which could initially be perceived as controversial, in external forums, meetings, conferences, or public-facing discussions.



To be successful in this role, you are an influential communicator with strong project management skills and the ability to translate complex scientific concepts into clear, engaging messages. You collaborate effectively across functions in a matrixed organization and can communicate confidently with a wide range of stakeholders, including scientists, clinicians, lawyers, government officials, and business leaders, in both written and spoken formats.

What we offer

Our success depends on the dedicated people who come to work every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join Swedish Match and you too can:

    Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.
    Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.
    Enjoy flexibility of hybrid way of working - split your time between working from our office or the comfort of your home, where it works best for you in line with business needs.
    Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provide endless opportunities to progress.
    Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to deliver a smoke-free future.

title: AD Sales Representative (EX-Googler)
description:
We are looking for an AD Sales Representative for the world’s leading search engine company in Stockholm. This is the consultant assignment starting in early August and 12 months ahead. Priority to Ex-Googlers who have experience with Google products

As an Account Executive Ad Sales, you practice and embody selling in both internal and customer settings. You use your working knowledge of advertising and your industry vertical to help your team identify and enable longer-term opportunities, account-level strategy, and annual activation plans, and to develop new customer relationships and new revenue streams. You support your team in sales strategy development, pitching, customer relationship growth, and opportunity sizing. You contribute to cross-team collaborations to support customer growth, align on opportunity/project timelines and goals, and ensure solutions are presented to customers. You develop relationships with customers, acting as a point of contact.

Experience:

    5 years of industry experience in digital advertising, consultative sales,business development, or digital marketing, or 6 years of experience with an advanced degree. Experience working with advertisers, agencies, or clients.
    Experience with digital media planning and managing advertising budgets and campaigns, with focus on performance and omnichannel marketing including measurement strategies and an understanding of the retail landscape.
    Ability to achieve sales goals to drive business growth, by building compelling narratives and utilizing storytelling based on business strategies and marketing objectives.
    Ability to navigate and influence organizations to shape aligned strategies and road map, and drive decisions and growth.
    Ability to build a trusted and meaningful relationship with customers, C-level and executive leadership.

Responsibilities include:

    Help serve as a strategic partner to customers to manage and analyze customer interactions and data to improve customer service relationships, assist in customer retention, and drive sales growth.
    Support identification of revenue and growth opportunities within the market and customer. Partner with internal stakeholders to determine and drive the sales, revenue growth, potential of opportunities, and marketing efficiency, as well as the incremental investment recommended to achieve customer business outcomes.
    Help draw interpretable insights from deep dives and data analysis, provide data-driven strategic and tactical recommendations to customers, partner teams, and leadership based on analysis and utilize insights to influence others and drive change.
    Support the development of strategies and tactics for creating account plans in collaboration with internal stakeholders and adjust plans as appropriate.
    Support team in identifying customer business objectives and setting sales strategies for specific markets and customers in collaboration with internal partners (e.g., account managers, product specialists) based on research and understanding of the customer.
    Continuously build knowledge and stay current on the advertising environment and competitive landscape through required training and other resources.
    drive key contributions to sharing and scaling of successes, opportunities for improvement, best practices, and learnings internally and externally as appropriate (e.g., case studies, industry events, training contributions).
    Create joint business plans for new business customers based upon client business objectives to help create deeper relationships with key stakeholders, with limited guidance. Ensure progress is being made against revenue goals.
    Start to develop a network with a function locally. Support opportunities to collaborate internally to strengthen internal communication.
    Help serve as a strategic partner to customers to build, grow, and maintain high impact and long-lasting relationships with customers by understanding the client´s opportunities and challenges. Share point of view on industry insights, consumer trends, and best practices to help strengthen and grow relationships.
    Help act as a point of contact for customers/agencies around all key areas (e.g., training, product enhancement, global/regional campaigns). Support cross-functional effort to identify, escalate and solve customer issues with limited guidance.
    Support team in crafting and delivering solutions to customers and agencies to achieve customer business objectives and drive revenue growth.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
About the Role
We are looking for a skilled Full-Stack Developer to join a development team in Gothenburg working on the evolution and reliability of business-critical workshop systems supporting an upcoming vehicle project. You will be involved throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements and technical analysis to development, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate has around 3-5 years of professional experience in full-stack development and strong expertise in at least one of TypeScript, C#/.NET, or Python. Experience with modern web development, backend or BFF solutions, cloud environments, and identity and access management is highly valuable.
Key Responsibilities
In this role, you will:

    Design, develop, and maintain new and existing software functionality.
    Build and maintain integrations with external systems and services.
    Investigate issues, troubleshoot applications, and improve existing solutions.
    Participate in code reviews and contribute to development best practices.
    Produce clean, maintainable, well-tested, and efficient code.
    Create and maintain relevant technical documentation.
    Contribute to requirements gathering, technical design, and solution analysis.
    Work closely with developers, product owners, analysts, testers, and other stakeholders.
    Help ensure reliable, high-quality deliveries that provide value to end users.

Required Skills & Experience

You should have strong hands-on experience in at least one of the following areas:

    TypeScript, particularly for frontend and BFF development, preferably with Next.js.
    C#/.NET for backend development.
    Python for backend and/or data-oriented development.

You should also have experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as:

    Azure
    AWS
    GCP

Nice to Have
Experience in any of the following areas would be an advantage:

    Identity and Access Management (IAM).
    Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
    Policy management and authorization.
    Microsoft Entra or similar identity platforms.
    Keycloak.
    Grafana and application monitoring.
    Generative AI and AI-assisted development tools.
    Automotive or OEM-related software environments.
    Cloud-based application architecture and services.

About You
We are looking for someone who is proactive, curious, and comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges.
You are not afraid to ask questions when requirements are unclear, and you are equally comfortable raising concerns when you identify potential risks or improvements. You enjoy investigating problems, working collaboratively, and finding practical solutions.
You are likely to be:

    A structured and responsible problem solver.
    Passionate about building reliable, user-focused software.
    Comfortable working in a dynamic and changing environment.
    A collaborative team player with strong communication skills.
    Quality-conscious and attentive to maintainability.
    Proactive and willing to take initiative.
    Comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Professional fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage.

Applications are reviewed continuously, and the position may be filled before the advertised closing date. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

title: Embedded developer
description:
About the Position:

Are you an experienced Embedded Developer with automotive experience? Then this opportunity might be just right for you!

As an embedded Developer at DevPort, you are a consultant and part of our area Digital solutions in Gothenburg. You will work with in-house teams or at one of our client sites with exciting projects.

In this role you need to be a responsible person who takes action and ownership of your work and deliverables. Collaboration with your team members and other teams is important as you will work on products and functions that depend on other engineers. We believe that you need to be a creative problem-solver who thinks outside-of-the-box.

Key Responsibilities:

    Develop and integrate new features into complex automotive system software.
    Ensure compliance with AUTOSAR standards and contribute to reducing defects through proactive code reviews.
    Work according to ISO 26262 functional safety standards.
    Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable and scalable solutions.
    Participate in project-based work and ensure timely and high-quality deliveries

We are looking for you who have:

    B.Sc or M.Sc in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
    5+ years of hands-on software development experience, preferably within the automotive sector.
    Strong proficiency in model-based development tools such as Matlab, Simulink, Stateflow, and TargetLink.
    Solid experience in Embedded Coder for application-level development.
    Skilled in C/C++ programming.

    Previous experience working in structured project environments.
    Fluent in both spoken and written English.

Digital Solutions at DevPort – Embedded Systems

Our embedded systems offering provides expertise across a wide range of areas, including software development, electronics development, and test & verification. We also offer specialized consulting services in specific technical and subject areas, such as functional safety, project management, and roles within agile methodology. With our strong foundation in the automotive industry, we have extensive knowledge to support our industrial clients in developing and quality-assuring advanced systems.

What We Offer:

    Versatile and challenging assignments: Participate in exciting projects across various clients and industries where your skills are highly valued.
    Flexible compensation: Choose between a higher salary or more vacation time—it's your choice!
    Inspiring work environment: Take part in fun activities and conference trips that strengthen the team and create memorable experiences.
    Continuous development: Enhance your skills through our special projects and lunch lectures covering topics from social skills and stress management to advanced battery technology.
    Innovative work tasks: Work with cutting-edge products and the latest technology in an environment that fosters creativity and innovation.

Application

If this sounds like something for you, apply by following the steps below.

We look forward to reading your application!

About DevPort

DevPort is a technology consulting company in an expansive growth phase, with headquarters in Gothenburg and offices in Stockholm, Linköping, Jönköping, Helsingborg, Karlskrona and Malmö. DevPort has broad expertise in several development-intensive industries and employs 350 people across three main areas of expertise: Digital solutions, product development and production development.

We take pride in our employees and our collaboration with some of the world’s leading automotive manufacturers, defense industry companies, and other development-intensive industries.

We are characterized by a close-knit culture with entrepreneurship, competence, security, and a sense of community that permeates our operations, contributing to a pleasant and inspiring workplace.

title: Sales Manager Automotive Direct Sales Sverige & Norge
description:
Arbetsbeskrivning


Vill du leda och utveckla försäljningen av smörjmedel för ett av världens största energibolag?
TotalEnergies söker nu en Sales Manager Automotive Direct Sales med ansvar för Sverige och Norge.

Det här är inte en traditionell säljchefsroll. Vi söker dig som vill kombinera affärsutveckling, ledarskap och strategi i en internationell organisation där du får möjlighet att påverka både människor och affärer.

Du kommer att leda TotalEnergies Nordic Automotive lubricants säljteam med fem Area Sales Managers, utveckla den kommersiella strategin för Sverige och Norge och samtidigt vara en aktiv del av våra största kunddialoger. Rollen passar dig som har byggt upp starka relationer inom fordonsbranschen och som motiveras av att utveckla både människor och affärer.

Hos TotalEnergies får du ett globalt varumärke i ryggen, samtidigt som du får friheten att driva verksamheten tillsammans med ditt team och sätta din prägel på den fortsatta utvecklingen.

Som Sales Manager Automotive Direct Sales ansvarar du för den direkta försäljningen av TotalEnergies smörjmedel i Sverige och Norge. Du leder tre Area Sales Managers i Sverige och två i Norge och arbetar nära den nordiska ledningen med att utveckla försäljningen, stärka marknadspositionen och skapa långsiktig tillväxt.

Rollen handlar lika mycket om människor som om affärer. Du coachar ditt team ute hos kund, utvecklar deras arbetssätt och säkerställer att ni tillsammans når uppsatta mål. Samtidigt arbetar du strategiskt med marknadsutveckling, nyckelkunder, budget och affärsplaner.

Du kommer bland annat att:

•    Ta fram och genomföra den kommersiella strategin för Sverige och Norge
•    Ansvara för budget, lönsamhet och försäljningsmål
•    Arbeta tillsammans med säljarna ute hos kund och utveckla nyckelkunder
•    Identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter och stärka TotalEnergies marknadsposition
•    Samarbeta med marknad, teknik, Supply Chain, Finance, HR och internationella funktioner inom koncernen
•    Säkerställa att verksamheten bedrivs enligt TotalEnergies höga krav på säkerhet, compliance och kvalitet

Rollen utgår från hemmakontor i Göteborgs- eller Stockholmsområdet. Resor sker främst inom Sverige, men även till Norge som en naturlig del av uppdraget.




Din Profil


Vi söker dig som redan idag leder försäljning eller har en senior kommersiell roll inom fordonsbranschen eller närliggande teknisk B2B-försäljning.

Du har förmågan att kombinera ett strategiskt affärsperspektiv med ett närvarande och coachande ledarskap. Du trivs ute hos kunder och motiveras av att hjälpa andra att lyckas.

Du har sannolikt erfarenhet från exempelvis:

•    Automotive
•    Reservdelar
•    Smörjmedel
•    Däck
•    Verkstadsutrustning
•    Lastbil
•    Entreprenad
•    Lantbruk
•    Andra tekniska produkter mot fordonsmarknaden

Erfarenhet av smörjmedel är meriterande men inget krav.

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är en trygg och inspirerande ledare med ett starkt affärsfokus. Du har förmågan att tänka strategiskt utan att tappa det operativa perspektivet och motiveras av att skapa resultat genom både människor och affärer. Du bygger långsiktiga relationer, arbetar strukturerat och tydligt i ditt ledarskap samt trivs i en internationell matrisorganisation med många kontaktytor. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska.



Om företaget


TotalEnergies is a global integrated energy company with more than 100,000 employees across 120 countries.
We produce and market energies: oil and biofuels, natural gas and green gases, renewables and electricity. Our purpose is to provide as many people as possible with energy that is more affordable, more reliable, and more sustainable.

We are committed to energy transition, harnessing the potential of CCS, offshore wind, hybrid power, and other renewable energies.

Vi kombinerar innovation, ansvar och säkerhet i allt vi gör, med värderingar som Safety, Respect, Pioneer Spirit, Stand Together och Performance Minded som genomsyrar hela organisationen. Marknaden för smörjmedel har stor potential och här får du möjligheten att vara med på resan, att bygga varumärket, skapa tillväxt och göra verklig skillnad.

Vi erbjuder:
•    Ett globalt varumärke med högkvalitativa produkter och starkt förtroende
•    En strategisk ledarroll med stort mandat och verklig möjlighet att påverka
•    Fast lön, prestationsbaserad bonus och tjänstebil
•    Hemmakontor och stor frihet under ansvar
•    Ett nordiskt ledningsteam
•    Internationella utvecklingsmöjligheter inom en av världens största energikoncerner
•    En arbetsgivare med höga ambitioner inom hållbarhet och framtidens energilösningar



Kontaktuppgifter


Denna rekrytering sker i samarbete med AutoExecutive. Frågor om tjänsten besvaras av Clemens Döring på clemens.doring@autorekrytering.se och Rebecka Fihn på rebecka.fihn@autorekrytering.se.

Vi arbetar med löpande urval, men på grund av semesterperioden kommer intervjuer att påbörjas i augusti. Har du frågor under tiden är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Rebecka Fihn.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.

title: Account Director
description:
Who are Benifex? 💚💜

We are a fast-moving technology company, and one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world. We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build workplace technology that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to build remarkable experiences that employees love. Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best, we need brilliant people on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀

Why should you apply? 🌟

    

Take ownership of a portfolio of strategic customers, driving both retention and revenue growth through renewals, upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

    

Partner with senior HR leaders, executives and key decision-makers, acting as a trusted commercial advisor and influencing long-term business outcomes.

    

Join a highly collaborative environment where you will work closely with Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Support and Leadership teams to deliver exceptional customer value.

    

Lead complex commercial engagements, negotiations and strategic account plans while helping shape the future growth of a market-leading SaaS platform.

    

Work for a profitable, fast-growing market leader in the online reward and employee benefits space.

Great benefits:

⚖️ A hybrid working model.

🧠 ITP1 pension.

❤️ Lifeplan - a leading financial advisory service that offers personalized advice for maximizing your pension savings.

📝 Collective agreement.

💸 Access to our comprehensive benefits portal.

🤸 Generous wellness allowance.

✈️ 30 vacation days / year.

💰 Referral bonuses.

🌟 Enhanced parental pay.

🙂 Volunteer Days – two paid days annually to give back to the community.

Role Overview 🚀

As an Account Director, you will be responsible for retaining and growing revenue across an assigned portfolio of existing customers. Owning the full commercial relationship, you will lead renewals, upsell and cross-sell opportunities while acting as the primary growth driver within your accounts. Working in close partnership with Customer Success Managers, you will ensure customers achieve value from the platform while identifying strategic opportunities to expand their use of Benifex solutions. You will build strong relationships with senior stakeholders, develop long-term account strategies and deliver predictable revenue growth. Please note that this is an individual contributor role with no direct people management responsibilities. Success in this position comes through commercial leadership, strategic customer engagement and cross-functional collaboration.

Responsibilities 🤘

    

Lead the end-to-end commercial sales cycle for renewals and expansions, including discovery, business case development, solution design, pricing, proposal creation, ROI cases, negotiations and contract closure.

    

Manage commercial activities including pricing, contract scope, commercial terms, invoicing accuracy and pipeline forecasting to support revenue growth and predictable performance.

    

Build and maintain strong relationships with senior HR leaders, executive sponsors, finance teams and procurement stakeholders. Lead Executive Business Reviews to demonstrate value delivered and identify future growth opportunities.

    

Develop and execute strategic account growth plans, identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities by understanding customer HR strategies, business objectives and workforce challenges.

    

Lead account planning sessions and internal commercial reviews, aligning stakeholders around opportunities, risks and priorities while ensuring effective collaboration across teams.

    

Use a consultative sales approach, including the MEDDIC methodology, to drive commercial success and position Benifex as a strategic long-term partner.

    

Share customer and market insights internally, support continuous improvement initiatives and ensure effective commercial handovers for new customers entering the portfolio.

What are we looking for? 🔎

    

Proven experience in B2B sales, account management or business development with a strong track record of retaining customers and driving revenue growth.

    

Demonstrated success delivering renewals, upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing customer portfolios.

    

Ability to manage complex buying journeys involving multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles and high-value contracts.

    

Strong commercial acumen with experience in forecasting, pipeline management, pricing and contract negotiations.

    

Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.

    

Fluency in both Swedish and English, with the ability to clearly communicate business value and ROI to senior audiences.

    

A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership and accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.

    

Strategic and solution-focused thinking, with the ability to connect customer challenges to business outcomes.

Bonus points for:

    

Experience within HR technology or Compensation & Benefits.

    

Experience within SaaS or other subscription-based business models.

    

Experience working with enterprise customers and managing large, long-term commercial relationships.

We want to make the application process as simple and fair as possible. That’s why we don’t ask for a cover letter for this role. Instead, you’ll find a few short questions in the application form. Your answers will help us understand your experience and skills in a more direct and relevant way.

Ready to make an impact? We’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments for interviews by replying to the email you will receive after you apply.

title: Logistikchef
description:
Arbetsbeskrivning

Rollen som logistikchef hos oss innebär ett helhetsansvar för logistikflödet – från planering till leverans – med fokus på leveransprecision, kvalitet och kostnadseffektivitet. Du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt – nära verksamheten, affären och våra samarbetspartners. Du blir en del av fabrikens ledningsgrupp och rapporterar direkt till Plant Manager. Du har också en Planeringschef underställd Logistikchef som ansvarar för ca 17 pers. På hela logistik arbetar det ca 130 pers inkl konsulter Verksamheten är en högvolymsfabrik som levererar över 550 000 artiklar per vecka till ett flertal stora kunder. Vi söker en ledare som vill vara med på vår utvecklings- och förändringsresa. Rollen är på 100 % och utgår från vår fabrik i Färgelanda.

Ansvarsområden:

    Resultat- och leveransansvar: Säkerställa hög leveransprecision, kundnöjdhet samt uppföljning av relevanta KPI:er kopplade till logistik och flöde.
    Logistikstyrning: Ansvara för lagerstyrning, kapacitetsplanering samt utveckling av effektiva material- och informationsflöden.
    Leverantörssamverkan: Säkerställa effektiva samarbeten med leverantörer och interna funktioner för att optimera flöden och tillgänglighet.
    Förbättringsarbete: Driva och implementera förbättringsinitiativ enligt våra principer.
    Hälsa och säkerhet: Driva och prioritera arbetsmiljö- och säkerhetsfrågor som en naturlig del av den dagliga verksamheten.

Kompetenser:

    Tydlig och kommunikativ ledare: Du är en trygg chef som sätter klara ramar och arbetsbeskrivningar, samtidigt som du coachar ditt team till att tänka nytt och fatta egna beslut.
    Prestigelös och handlingskraftig: Du är absolut "hands on" när det krävs, är lyhörd för organisationen men har samtidigt modet att stå fast vid fattade beslut.
    Analytisk och datadriven: Du fattar beslut baserat på fakta och data. Du har lätt för att göra analyser som räddar dagen här och nu, men också säkrar flödet för framtiden.
    Resultatorienterad: Du arbetar strukturerat mot uppsatta mål och följer upp verksamheten genom nyckeltal.

Kvalifikationer:

    Erfarenhet: Gedigen och stor erfarenhet inom logistik samt ett dokumenterat framgångsrikt ledarskap.
    Branschbakgrund: Erfarenhet från fordonsindustrin (Automotive) och förståelse för dess komplexa processer är starkt meriterande. Alternativt har du bakgrund från någon större logistikaktör.
    System och IT: God vana av SAP samt mycket starka kunskaper i Excel.
    Språk: Då vi arbetar på en internationell marknad krävs mycket goda kunskaper i både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
    Geografiskt fokus: Vi ser gärna att du bor i exempelvis Trollhättan, Uddevalla eller Stenungsund med omnejd då det passar bäst för pendling.

I den här rekryteringen samarbetar Artifex med Randstad. Då vi går in i en semesterperiod kommer urval och intervjuer ske med start under v32. Tjänsten kan komma att bli tillsatt innan sista ansökningsdag, ansök därför så snart som möjligt.

För information kontakta: Liza Dahlin, rekryteringskonsult e-mail: liza.dahlin@randstad.se



Ansvarsområden

    Resultat- och leveransansvar: Säkerställa hög leveransprecision, kundnöjdhet samt uppföljning av relevanta KPI:er kopplade till logistik och flöde.
    Logistikstyrning: Ansvara för lagerstyrning, kapacitetsplanering samt utveckling av effektiva material- och informationsflöden.
    Leverantörssamverkan: Säkerställa effektiva samarbeten med leverantörer och interna funktioner för att optimera flöden och tillgänglighet.
    Förbättringsarbete: Driva och implementera förbättringsinitiativ enligt våra principer.
    Hälsa och säkerhet: Driva och prioritera arbetsmiljö- och säkerhetsfrågor som en naturlig del av den dagliga verksamheten.




Kvalifikationer

    Erfarenhet: Gedigen och stor erfarenhet inom logistik samt ett dokumenterat framgångsrikt ledarskap.
    Branschbakgrund: Erfarenhet från fordonsindustrin (Automotive) och förståelse för dess komplexa processer är starkt meriterande. Alternativt har du bakgrund från någon större logistikaktör.
    System och IT: God vana av SAP samt mycket starka kunskaper i Excel.
    Språk: Då vi arbetar på en internationell marknad krävs mycket goda kunskaper i både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
    Geografiskt fokus: Vi ser gärna att du bor i exempelvis Trollhättan, Uddevalla eller Stenungsund med omnejd då det passar bäst för pendling.




Om företaget



Artifex Systems AB

Artifex Systems AB is a trusted partner in the European automotive supply chain, delivering high-quality components and systems to leading premium vehicle manufacturers. With three strategically located sites in Sweden—Låssby (Gothenburg), Skara, and Färgelanda—we operate as a unified and agile business unit, capable of managing the entire journey from concept design to finished products.
Our strength lies in combining engineering expertise with advanced manufacturing to provide complete, reliable solutions tailored to customer needs. Driven by a culture of continuous improvement, we are committed to sustainable innovation that balances performance with responsibility. By fostering long-term partnerships with global automotive brands, Artifex Systems AB positions itself as a future-ready supplier, dedicated to shaping the next generation of mobility.
Vision: Provide tailor-made interior and exterior solutions, driven by passion, precision and the power of our people. Driving Innovation with Purpose.
Mission: Create tailor-made interior and exterior solutions for the global automotive industry premium segment. With a strong focus on design, precision, and material quality, we deliver components that enhance both the experience and value of every vehicle.

title: Assistant General Manager
description:
Dream Big - Join Basta New Opening! 🍕

About Basta

Basta is more than a restaurant—it's a place where people connect. Inspired by the warmth and spirit of Italy, we bring together great food, genuine hospitality and passionate teams to create memorable experiences for every guest. Whether you're in the kitchen or on the floor, you'll be part of a team that brings energy, personality and pride to everything it does.

Part of Urban Italian Group

Urban Italian Group is one of Europe's fastest-growing hospitality groups, bringing together distinctive restaurant brands, passionate people and memorable guest experiences. As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities for those who want to build their careers with us.

The Role

As Assistant General Manager, you will support the General Manager in running a strong, efficient and high-energy restaurant. This is a hands-on operational role for someone who enjoys leading service, developing the team and keeping the restaurant moving with pace, warmth and control.

You will play an important part in keeping standards consistent, supporting cost control and helping the team grow through clear training, patience and strong day-to-day leadership.

What you'll be doing

    

Lead and support smooth, efficient service when the GM is not present.

    

Support the GM with scheduling, labour control and daily restaurant organisation.

    

Train, coach and support team members to improve performance and service standards.

    

Keep service standards, guest experience and restaurant routines consistent.

    

Use KPIs, cost awareness and operational judgement to support stronger results.

    

Create a positive, hands-on team culture where people feel supported and accountable.

You'll thrive in this role if you

We’re looking for someone who is service-led, practical and ready to grow with the restaurant.

    

Strong restaurant service background, ideally in a busy, fast-paced operation.

    

Confident leading the floor and supporting the team during service.

    

Good understanding of KPIs, labour, cost control and restaurant standards.

    

Flexible approach to scheduling and the rhythm of restaurant life.

    

Patient, team-focused and able to train people in a clear and supportive way.

    

Good English level; Swedish is a strong advantage, with willingness to keep learning.

    

Someone looking to stay, grow and build a long-term career with Basta.

Our culture and values

We believe we work with people, not food. Guided by our values of Trust, Inclusion, Passion and Entrepreneurship, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to grow.

What do we offer?

    

Be part of one of Europe’s fastest-growing hospitality groups.

    

Build your career across multiple brands and countries.

    

Work alongside talented people who genuinely love hospitality.

    

International career opportunities.

    

Referral bonus scheme.

    

Shared accommodation (where applicable).

    

Friends for life.

Sound like your kind of place?

If you are excited by joining us, we would love to hear from you. Bring your energy, personality and passion for Italian food to Basta.

Urban Italian Group is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the selection process, please tell our Talent Acquisition Team.

title: Vehicle Integration Test Engineer - 18752
description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Assignment Description

We are looking for a Software Tester / Vehicle Integration Test Engineer

What You Will Work On

What You Bring

    Experience with test execution, verification, and defect analysis

title: People Business Partner
description:
Are you a people-focused professional who thrives on making a difference?

As a People Business Partner, you will support parts of our business and handle all operational HR matters. Your main task is to coach and develop managers in your business functions, helping them succeed in their roles and responsibilities. With our people strategy in mind, you will drive and advise on all people aspects. Does this sound interesting? We look forward to your application!

Some of your key responsibilities:

    Provide day-to-day support for managers and employees in operational HR matters, including all investigation and requirements for disciplinary matters, compensation issues and rehabilitation
    Act as a single point of contact for managers in your business functions
    Guide, coach and advice managers in employee development, performance, employee relations and HR-issues, in line with the company policy
    Trade Union negotiations
    Facilitate training sessions for managers and employees
    Be part of people development projects across the company

What you will experience

As a Stena Line employee in Sweden, we offer you a salary package including pension benefit and benefits package consisting of travel concessions and onboard discounts, health cash plan and well-being activities.

Based in our Gothenburg office, this role follows an office-first approach, allowing you to work closely with a collaborative team of People Business Partners, People Rehab Partner and Talent Acquisition Partners, together, we support and work with the business to provide proactive, people-focused support where it matters most.

Who are you?

At Stena Line, your personal qualities matter just as much as your skills and expertise. Regardless of the role, being welcoming, caring, and reliable guides you in your everyday work and the challenges you face. We believe that you are result oriented with a solution focused mindset. You are a team-player and knows how to communicate and influence others.

Qualifications:

    Bachelor degree or equivalent within HR or similar area
    Solid experience from working as a People Business Partner or similar HR-role, preferable from a matrix organisation with operational focus
    Experience handling HR-matters such as rehabilitation, disciplinary actions, negotiations with unions and people administration
    Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken, and experienced user of MS Office
    Ability to travel on a regular basis
    Experience in shipping, logistics, and/or the transport sector is a plus

Interested?

This is a full-time, permanent position. You will be based in Gothenburg within our Scandinavian People department. To apply, please register your profile and send in your application in English as soon as possible but no later than August 23nd, 2026. Please note that due to GDPR we do not accept applications via e-mail or postal service.

If you have any questions regarding the position or about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact Hedwig Blixt, Talent Acquisition Partner, Hedwig.Blixt@stenaline.com.

Please note that we kindly decline any offers from recruitment or staffing agencies regarding this recruitment.

About Stena Line

As a leader in sustainable shipping, Stena Line has Europe's most comprehensive route network focusing on transportation of both passengers and freight. We have over 8,750 employees in our Stena Line family across Scandinavia, around the UK and the Baltics, making a contribution to our company.

Stena Line exists to be a trusted link between people, places and societies. We play a vital role in keeping everything connected. We make sure people and goods arrive where they need to be, enabling business to thrive and societies to grow. We connect family and friends, and make it, possible to explore new destinations or revisit favorite places. The journey starts with us.

Working at Stena Line means having a safe and stable workplace and a great work-life balance. We are committed to maintaining and developing a sustainable working environment, free from harassment, that gives equal opportunities to everyone. We embrace equality, diversity and inclusion – and welcome all applicants.

title: Senior IAM Engineer
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will join a highly skilled IAM team working at the heart of a complex enterprise environment where identity, security, and platform engineering are tightly connected. The team designs, builds, and operates Identity and Access Management platforms across both on-prem and cloud environments, with solutions that are deeply integrated into DevOps toolchains and digital platforms.

In this role, you will help evolve the IAM landscape by turning technical and business needs into secure, scalable solutions. You will work closely with development, security, cloud, and infrastructure teams, and play an important part in strengthening IAM capabilities that support the organization’s broader cloud journey. It is a great opportunity for you if you enjoy combining architecture, hands-on engineering, and security in a modern platform environment.

Job Description

    You will design and implement IAM solutions and architectures for hybrid environments.
    You will operate, maintain, and further develop IAM platforms and supporting infrastructure.
    You will support cloud and platform onboarding by establishing secure IAM patterns.
    You will troubleshoot identity-related issues across integrated systems and drive resolution in a structured way.
    You will work with compliance and security policies to ensure robust and secure access management.
    You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to improve the overall security posture.
    You will contribute to IAM capabilities that enable scalable, secure, and compliant cloud services.

Requirements

    5 years or more experience within IAM engineering, with expert hands-on experience in access management tools.
    Good knowledge of networking fundamentals such as TLS, DNS, proxies, firewalls, and VPNs.
    Advanced knowledge of certificate management and PKI, including handling SSL/TLS certificates.
    Advanced knowledge of identity federation technologies such as OpenID Connect and OAuth2.
    Experience managing different IDP solutions.
    Good knowledge of Single Sign-On and Multi Factor Authentication solutions, for example FIDO2.
    Advanced knowledge of DevSecOps tools and platform management with Kubernetes, Docker, Git, and GitHub Actions.
    Advanced knowledge in programming languages such as Java, Python, Go, Spring, or JavaScript.
    Good knowledge of Linux, LDAP, OpenShift, and infrastructure as code with Terraform, Ansible, and Helm.
    Experience working in hybrid and multi-cloud enterprise environments, including secure integration across multiple cloud providers and on-premises platforms.
    Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise identity platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Keycloak, or Curity.
    Experience operating in complex and highly integrated IT environments.
    Advanced troubleshooting capabilities and a strong understanding of IT infrastructure, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex identity and access issues across diverse systems and environments.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Payroll Specialist
description:
Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation, we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organisation reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.

Join us as we harness cutting-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.

Payroll specialist

At Maersk, we have a vision larger than the ocean: to be a true integrator of container logistics connecting and simplifying our customers’ supply chain. We count on our people to make it happen.

Besides focusing on creating value for our customers and the business, a key priority for us is to drive personal and professional development for our people to prepare for further career progression.

We value the diversity of our talent and will always strive to recruit the best person for the job.



We Offer

Energizing and pioneering, this is an environment that keeps you motivated.

You’ll be joining a genuinely diverse and talented team that is truly passionate about providing first class HR partnership to the business. And thanks to our global scale, you’ll be well-placed to explore Maersk opportunities around the world.

The many other highlights include industry-leading talent develop initiatives and competitive benefits.

You will be joining a Fortune 500 company and will get the opportunity to challenge yourself in a truly aspiring, international, and fast-paced environment with our team in Gothenburg and all over the world. In cooperation with colleagues and vendors your role will be to ensure a flawless payroll service to Swedish and Norwegian employees. This will give you a unique opportunity to interact with colleagues, across the globe and from all business areas within the Maersk group, all while having a continuous focus on your professional and personal development too.

Key Responsibilities

The purpose of the role is to support the regional payroll organization, working with a matrixed group of stakeholders and vendors to ensure great employee experience and regulatory compliance from a payroll delivery perspective. Key responsibilities:

    Manage pre-payroll, on-cycle payroll, off-cycle payroll processes
    Extract the T&A data and provide the same to payroll provider
    Validate payroll results & provide approvals for final pay credits based on control reports
    Annual payroll reconciliation and new Payroll Year preparation
    Ensure timely Social Insurance Tax Payment and Reporting
    Manage advance payments
    Adjust basic time configuration of systems after initial implementation, as approved/required
    Track vendor deliverables on payroll SLAs vide defined payroll metrics
    Be risk aware and help identify, report, mitigate and track risks in the payroll delivery process
    Support the Payroll team lead in providing necessary data and clarifications to questions raised by audit – internal and external
    Manage the timely submission of RICC controls  
    Participate in Time and Attendance initiatives including system upgrades, communication of changes to People Partners, testing and documenting all changes for historical and record retention policies, project support as needed
    Interfaces with People Partner to support employee/ manager queries
    Identify improvement opportunities in regional processes and raises them to global process managers

Who we are looking for

You are data, systems and process savvy in the Payroll, HR, Time & Attendance domain and are excited about putting your deep expertise at work in the transition into new technology and processes at Maersk.

You want to propel your career further by gaining unique project experience in an international environment and would like to play a key role in building the future payroll delivery landscape and solutions.

As we progress with the transformation you are comfortable with your role changing shape and scope. You will be responsible for high quality delivery of Payroll Services and continuously driving improvements to ensure great employee experience process optimization and compliance.

• 3-5 years of hands-on experience in managing Payroll, Time & Attendance and HR processes, within a complex international organization

• Knowledge of compliance and legal regulations for payroll & benefits

• Broader HR Operations experience as well as exposure to an outsourced payroll model would be a benefit

• Ability to effectively engage and mobilize diverse local HR stakeholders

• A proactive, ‘let’s get it done’ attitude geared towards continuous improvement

• Flexibility and adaptability to operate in a fast-paced, developing project environment, taking ownership and setting directions with minimal guidance

• Resilience: the change process, is anything but straightforward; accepting uncertainty and bouncing back from setbacks while keeping your enthusiasm is a tall order, but we need it

• Collaborative working style, fostering cooperation and teamwork to find solutions

• Fluency in Swedish and English is essential

• If you have worked with ‘transportavtalet’, is an advantage too

• Highly analytical approach with a strong eye for detail

• Structured working style and focus on delivering results as per agreed timescales and scope

Selection is ongoing, so we look forward to your application!

title: R&D Professional (Physical Metallurgy): Temporary Position
description:
At Alleima, we believe in delivering the highest quality products to our customers. That is why we invest heavily in research and development, and our unit for Physical Metallurgy is in the forefront of this effort. As part of our Strategic Research organization, the unit provides expert support to all of our divisions: Tube, Strip and Kanthal. We generate high-quality testing results, develop new and existing testing methods, and participate in cutting-edge research development projects, all to ensure we stay ahead of the curve.

If you hold a Master’s degree in Metallurgy, Materials Science, or Physics and are interested in working with surface analysis, heat treatment, and physical properties, we invite you to apply for a temporary position at the Strategic Research Labs at Alleima. We are looking for driven individuals with a strong commitment to delivering high-quality results. This is a great opportunity to gain valuable experience as part of our innovative team in Sandviken, Sweden—don’t miss your chance to join us!

This position is expected to start from 2026-09-01 to 2026-12-31.

Your Role

The unit Physical Metallurgy, which is an integral part of Strategic Research Labs consists of several characterization and analytical techniques. These include surface analysis techniques known as glow discharge optical emission spectroscopy (GD-OES), Physical property measurements, X-ray diffraction (XRD), light and electron microscopes (LOM+SEMs+TEM+EPMA), sample preparation laboratories and dilatometers. We have a group of highly competent and skillful engineers and technicians. The current position mainly involves collaborating with group members working with GD-OES, Interferometer, Physical & Magnetic properties and Heat Treatment. The responsibilities of the current position are as follows:

      -        Perform measurements according to the expectations of our clients and be able to communicate the results.

      -        Collaborate effectively with other laboratory engineers in planning and executing the measurements.

      -        Take responsibility for the machines & instruments by collaborating with the suppliers in the case of maintenance and breakdowns.

      -        Support other lab members in future investments in the areas you work with.

About You

We are looking for an enthusiastic individual with a Masters’s degree in Metallurgy, Materials Science, or Physics. While prior experience in our competence area is a plus, what matters to us is your eagerness to learn, develop and grow. If you have spent time in a laboratory environment, that´s an advantage. Knowledge of metallic materials, manufacturing processes, microstructures, that’s fantastic, but don´t worry if you´re not an expert just yet – we´re here to help develop those skills. Experience working with GD-OES, Interferometer, and instruments for measuring Physical properties can also be a merit. You should be able to communicate in Swedish, both verbally and in writing. As we work in a global environment, communication skills in English will be good/advantageous.

Your personal qualities are essential for this role. At our core, we value strong personal qualities such as curiosity, creativity, self-motivation, patience, and a solution-oriented mindset. You are well-organized and structured, with a clear sense of ownership and commitment to your responsibilities. You thrive both independently and as part of a team, demonstrating adaptability and a willingness to support others when needed. If you’re driven to thrive and grow in our dynamic environment, we´re excited to welcome you on board as the catalyst for our success!

We are a company with an open-minded culture, actively working to create a workplace that is characterized by diversity and inclusion.

Additional Information

As a part of the hire process alcohol and drug tests are conducted according to our procedures for a safe working environment.

For further information about this position, please contact:

About Alleima

At Alleima, our mission is much more than delivering high-quality products, technology and processes – through collaboration we develop the best solutions according to our customers' needs and that this is how we achieve our business goals is the best way to describe our daily work. With curious employees and safety as our first priority, we create a work environment where you can develop both as a person and in your work.

With a clear direction for our journey, where we use our position as technology leader, progressive business partner and where we are driving in terms of sustainability, we aim to become an even stronger company within our industry.

Are you ready to take on this challenge with us? Join us on our journey! www.alleima.com

title: 2nd Line Technical Support Agent to TaxiCaller
description:

We are now looking for a new 2nd line support person to our growing customer support team in Linköping.

About you

● You have excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think “outside the box”.

● You possess great computing skills and are interested in all things technical.

● You provide a high level of customer service and have a full understanding of its importance.

● You are a curious and fast learner.
