an international working environment with long tradition  
versatile activity in a future\-oriented environment with a lot of self\-responsibility  
good development opportunities and fair employment conditions  
a motivated team with mutual respect and good cooperation

description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

title: Philanthropy Advisor for Private Major Donors - German
description:
Join MSF OCG as a Philanthropy Advisor!
We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.
Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.
Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF
Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?
At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.
We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don’t fulfil every listed qualification.
We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.
MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.
Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.
As Philanthropy Advisor, you will secure and grow income from individual major donors in German-speaking Switzerland and Liechtenstein. You will manage a portfolio of assigned donors, build strong and lasting relationships, deepen their engagement with MSF’s social mission, and identify opportunities to increase their support. This includes organising meetings with MSF representatives, sharing relevant information on MSF projects and priorities, coordinating donor events and webinars, presenting funding opportunities, and directly soliciting financial contributions. You will also contribute to the effective use of the CRM system and prospect research to strengthen the team’s fundraising approach.
Tasks & Responsibilities
Qualification, cultivation and stewardship
•    Manages a portfolio of Major donors
•    Is accountable to deliver the best possible experience to MSF key donors in in order to increase their engagement.
•    Qualify each Major Donor and Major Donor prospect, in close cooperation with the Prospect Researcher
•    In coordination with the Team Coordinator, closely liaise with the Middle Donor manager to identify and update potential Major Donors
•    Prepare and facilitate one to one meetings, calls, presentations and other meaningful interactions with major donors or representatives (lawyers, wealth managers, etc.)
•    Establish relations with new potential major donors, including high-potential middle givers and other prospects, including ultra-high-net-worth individuals, to secure significant future support for MSF’s work
•    Interact and collaborate with key spokespersons within MSF (President, General Director, Director of Operations, other management team members), as well as field staff, with the aim of bringing donors closer to the organisation in an attempt to show them our live saving mission and work in the projects.
•    Define, propose and organise visits to MSF offices and projects, in line with MSF criteria and guidance
•    Ensure that the nature / identity of donors is in line with MSF gifts acceptance policy.
•    Ensure that the moves management runs smoothly, and donors are thanked and steward properly.
•    Keep the database up-to-date
•    Liaise with Writing Officers for the preparation, including proof reading and editing, of project briefings, reports, proposals, slideshows, infographics and any other creative way of presenting MSF and its mission to private major donors
•    Liaise with the Direct Marketing team to adequately leverage marketing appeals and to coordinate touch-points
Solicitation
•    Present and defend MSF’s cases for support to individual major donors in German speaking Switzerland and Lichtenstein.
•    Ensure that the major donors journey strategy is followed and that major donors are solicited according to their motivations in a personalised way.
Information and data management
•    Closely work with the System Support Team to ensure most efficient use of Customer Relationship Management Database
•    Support the Team Coordinator in income forecasting and quarterly analysis of results
Others
•    Participate in the Community of Practice for Individual Major Donors of MSF
•    Work proactively on projects as needed in the Unit, upon request by her/his supervisor.
Your profile
Education
•    University degree in Business Management, Marketing, Communications, Political Science, Law, International Relations or equivalent
Experience
•    Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in similar functions or in the fields of  high-level relational skills, like public relations, wealth management or sales/marketing/communications, high-level advocacy or humanitarian project work
•    Experience in using Microsoft Dynamics or other Customer Relationship Manager System: a plus
•    Experience and knowledge of humanitarian aid: a plus
Languages
•    (Swiss) German (native or equivalent),
•    English
•    French : a plus
•    Italian: a plus
Skills/ Technical competencies
•    Proven writing skills
•    Excellent in oral public presentations
•    Use of data base a plus
Personal Abilities/Qualities
•    Excellent interpersonal skills
•    Rigorous and good organizational skills
•    Empathic, enthusiastic, optimistic
•    Result orientation
•    Team spirit
•    Strong commitment to MSF’s social mission and values
Terms of employment
•    Full-time position 100% (40h/week)
•    Open-ended contract
•    Working place: Zürich
•    Ideal start date: asap
•    Gross annual salary (for 100%): from CHF 87’372.- to CHF 100’608.- (salary commensurate with equivalent experience and internal salary grid)
•    Paid vacation: 25 days per year, prorate temporis, plus any Swiss public holidays falling within the contract period.
•    Pension plan: pension contribution covered 3/4 by MSF, 1/4 by staff member.
•    Relocation support available for eligible candidates.
How to apply
Candidates are invited to submit their application exclusively through our recruitment platform, following these guidelines:
•    CV (maximum 2 pages)
•    Cover letter (maximum 1 page)
•    Documents must be submitted in either English or French.
The application deadline is 30th August, 2026.
We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if we receive a sufficient number of quality applications.
All applications will be treated confidentially.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Please note that we do not wish to use the services of recruitment or placement agencies.

title: Global Traffic & Creative Operations Manager
description:
Global Traffic \& Creative Operations Manager  
Born of a simple gesture in 1976, L'Occitane en Provence reveals the living power of flora, where the light of the sun meets the richness of the earth. With advanced expertise, we turn these natural treasures into sensorial, efficient experiences, as sustainable as possible and profoundly inspired by Haute Provencal nature.  
Our culture is built through everyday moments, how we behave, make decisions and show up for each other.  
With Trust as our foundation, Curiosity as our compass, Excellence as our standard, we create lasting Impact for the people around us and our planet. We create unique sensory experiences, to share precious moments with simplicity.  
With retail locations in over 90 countries, your career can take you anywhere. Proud to be B Corp certified, we are part of a global movement working towards a more inclusive, equitable and regenerative economy.  
L'Occitane en Provence is part of the L'OCCITANE Group, a leading international, multi\-brand manufacturer and retailer of premium beauty and wellness products.  
We offer diverse opportunities to grow and make a difference on a global scale.  
Context \& Mission  
We are looking for an experienced Global Traffic \& Creative Operations Manager to coordinate creative workflows across Headquarters and six international Creative Hubs.  
Joining the creative services team, this role sits at the center of the global creative ecosystem, ensuring clear prioritization, efficient delivery, and real\-time visibility across Creative Campaigns, Visual Merchandising, Store Design and Packaging. The position also drives smarter ways of working through streamlined processes, automation, AI\-enabled workflows, and connected tools.  
You will help creative teams deliver impactful brand experiences consistently across markets while improving operational efficiency through data, systems, and technology.  
You will report to the Head of Brand Creative Services \& Production.  
Key responsibilities  
Manage brief intake and project prioritization — validate creative requests, scope needs, align priorities, and balance business demand with team capacity.  
Own the HQ creative pipeline — track status, timelines, owners, risks, and delivery across disciplines from kick\-off to completion.  
Build and optimize operating systems — design intake forms, routing logic, approvals, automation, dashboards, and scalable traffic processes.  
Lead automation and AI\-enabled workflow initiatives — identify repetitive tasks and implement practical solutions with IT and technical partners.  
Improve time\-to\-market — identify bottlenecks, reduce lead times, and simplify recurring workflows without compromising quality.  
Facilitate traffic rituals and stakeholder alignment — lead status meetings, surface risks, and keep teams aligned with minimal operational friction.  
Maintain capacity and resource visibility — monitor team workload, flag bottlenecks, and anticipate surge needs with creative leads.  
Coordinate across six Creative Hubs — align priorities, timelines, and process standards for global and multi\-market projects.  
Drive tool adoption and change management — document processes, train users, and embed new ways of working sustainably.  
Track operational performance — report KPIs such as content volume, budget, time to market and efficiency gains.  
How you can fit  
Proven experience in traffic management, creative operations, project management, or a similar role in an international creative, marketing, digital, retail, or production environment.  
Strong understanding of creative production, retail design, visual merchandising, campaign development, and global cross\-functional collaboration.  
Excellent project management, organization, communication, and stakeholder\-influencing skills.  
Fluent English and French required; additional languages are a plus.  
Experience with project\-management, DAM, collaboration, automation, reporting, or workflow platforms.  
Interest or practical experience in automation, AI\-enabled productivity, and data\-driven workflow optimization.  
If you thrive in complex international environments and want to transform creative operations through systems, automation, and AI, we’d love to hear from you.  
What we offer  
As a Living Wage Certified employer, we guarantee that all our compensation practices meet or exceed established living wage and fairness standards  
We are committed to continuous learning and professional development to help every employee grow within our organization  
Staff discount to use on all your favorite L'Occitane en Provence products  
Permanent contract, starting asap  
Full\-time position (100%)

Véritable garant de leur bonne exécution, vous coordonnez les entreprises, les mandataires et les différents partenaires afin d’assurer le respect des coûts, des délais et des exigences de qualité. Intervenir dès les phases de devis général et d’appels d’offres afin de préparer les conditions optimales d’exécution des projets.  
Élaborer et piloter les plannings d’exécution, organiser les phasages, les installations de chantier et garantir le respect des délais.

Assurer une présence régulière sur les chantiers, anticiper les difficultés, proposer des solutions pragmatiques et veiller au bon déroulement des travaux.  
Entretenir une relation de confiance avec les maîtres d’ouvrage, les architectes, les mandataires et les entreprises tout au long de la réalisation des projets.  
Collaborer étroitement avec les Managers de projets afin d’assurer une exécution fluide et conforme aux objectifs fixés.  
Contribuer activement à la réussite de projets de construction complexes en garantissant le respect des coûts, des délais et du niveau de qualité attendu.  
Votre profil  
Au bénéfice d’une formation dans le domaine de la construction (architecte, ingénieur, technicien ES ou formation jugée équivalente), vous disposez de solides connaissances techniques et constructives.  
Vous justifiez d’une expérience confirmée en direction de travaux en Suisse, idéalement sur des projets complexes et d’envergure, notamment dans les secteurs publics ou parapublics.  
Vous maîtrisez la conduite de travaux TCE et êtes à l’aise dans le pilotage des coûts, des délais, de la qualité ainsi que dans la coordination des entreprises et des mandataires.  
À l’aise avec les outils informatiques, vous utilisez MS Project, Excel et idéalement Messerli.  
Fiable, engagé(e) et volontaire, vous faites preuve d’un fort sens des responsabilités et aimez être présent(e) sur le terrain afin de faire avancer les projets.  
Doté(e) d’un excellent relationnel, vous savez instaurer un climat de confiance avec les maîtres d’ouvrage, les architectes, les mandataires et les entreprises.  
Vous disposez d’une autorité naturelle et savez faire respecter les décisions avec tact, diplomatie et pragmatisme.  
Structuré(e), rigoureux(se) et à l’aise avec les chiffres, vous appréciez les environnements exigeants où l’anticipation, l’organisation et la réactivité sont essentielles.  
Animé(e) par des projets ambitieux, vous souhaitez contribuer à la réalisation d’ouvrages emblématiques en garantissant une exécution irréprochable.  
Vous êtes parfaitement à l’aise en français. De bonnes connaissances de l’allemand constituent un réel atout.  
Vous rejoindrez un environnement de travail particulièrement sain et collaboratif, où la proximité, la confiance et la communication ouverte feront partie du quotidien. L’organisation, peu hiérarchisée, offrira un accès direct à la direction et favorisera la prise d’initiative ainsi que le travail en équipe. Vous interviendrez sur des projets d’envergure, à forte qualité architecturale, intégrant des enjeux de durabilité et des approches innovatives, au sein d’une structure reconnue pour son professionnalisme en gestion de projets. Des perspectives d’évolution interne, des moments de partage (séminaires, événements) ainsi que des activités sportives viendront compléter un cadre de travail stimulant et humain.

Un\-e technicien\-ne en système de contrôle d'accès (100 %) \- CDI \- EVAM  
Un\-e technicien\-ne en système de contrôle d'accès (100 %) \- CDI  
L'EVAM (Établissement vaudois de l'accueil des migrants) est un acteur majeur du service public vaudois. Avec plus de 1'000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs engagés et un budget annuel de 360 millions de francs, nous assurons l'accueil, l'accompagnement et l'intégration des personnes migrantes dans le canton de Vaud.  
Chaque jour, nos équipes œuvrent avec ouverture et responsabilité pour répondre à des enjeux sociaux essentiels. Rejoindre l'EVAM, c'est mettre ses compétences au service d'une mission humaine et d'utilité publique, dans un environnement professionnel stimulant, diversifié et en constante évolution.  
Dans le cadre d'un remplacement, nous recrutons :  
Un\-e technicien\-ne en système de contrôle d'accès électronique et mécanique (100 %) \- CDI  
Lieu : Lausanne avec déplacements sur l'ensemble des sites de l'EVAM dans le canton de Vaud  
Entrée en fonction : Dès que possible  
Classe salariale : 5 (ce barème s'entend à prérequis validés, à défaut desquels l'enclassement se fait à hauteur de classe \-1\)  
Ce que vous apportez à notre mission  
En tant que technicien\-ne en système de contrôle d'accès électronique et mécanique, vous assurez la sécurité et le bon fonctionnement des installations de contrôle d'accès sur l'ensemble des sites de l'EVAM.  
Vous intervenez aussi bien sur de nouveaux projets que sur des installations existantes, en pilotant les aspects techniques, la coordination des travaux et la maintenance des équipements. Grâce à votre expertise, vous garantissez des infrastructures fiables, conformes aux normes en vigueur et adaptées aux besoins des utilisateurs.  
Vous évoluez dans une fonction variée, mêlant terrain, coordination de chantiers, dépannage et gestion technique, au sein d'une équipe autonome et orientée solutions.  
Le mot de votre futur responsable, Robin :  
« Rejoindre notre équipe, c'est intégrer un environnement où la sécurité est une priorité et où chacun contribue, par son expertise, à améliorer nos infrastructures. Aucune journée ne se ressemble : interventions de terrain, suivi de chantiers, projets techniques, nouvelles technologies et collaboration avec de nombreux partenaires rythment notre quotidien. Nous recherchons une personne rigoureuse, autonome, curieuse et orientée solutions, qui apprécie le travail d'équipe et souhaite s'investir durablement. Si vous aimez relever des défis concrets et évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, innovant et porteur de sens, nous serons ravis de vous accueillir. »  
Vos missions clés  
Vous pilotez les projets d'installation et de modernisation des systèmes de contrôle d'accès électroniques et mécaniques, de l'analyse des besoins jusqu'à leur mise en service.  
Vous assurez la maintenance préventive et curative des installations, diagnostiquez les pannes et intervenez rapidement afin de garantir leur bon fonctionnement et leur conformité.  
Vous coordonnez les chantiers et les différents intervenants, en veillant au respect des délais, des normes de sécurité et de la qualité des réalisations.  
Vous gérez les aspects techniques et administratifs des installations, notamment la programmation des systèmes, le suivi des dossiers, la gestion des stocks et le contrôle des coûts.  
Vous conseillez et accompagnez les utilisateurs ainsi que les partenaires internes et externes, en apportant votre expertise technique et des solutions adaptées aux besoins du terrain.  
Vous contribuez à l'amélioration continue des installations et des procédures, en proposant des optimisations techniques et en participant à l'évolution des infrastructures de l'EVAM.  
Votre profil  
CFC dans le domaine de la serrurerie, de la construction métallique ou dans un métier technique jugé équivalent.  
Expérience d'au moins 5 ans dans le domaine du contrôle d'accès ou dans une fonction similaire.  
Expérience en coordination d'équipes, conduite de travaux ou suivi de chantiers.  
Excellente capacité à lire et interpréter des plans d'architecture et schémas techniques.  
Permis de conduire indispensable.  
Ce que l'EVAM vous propose  
Un environnement de travail engagé  
Une politique de formation continue pour évoluer dans votre carrière  
Une politique de télétravail  
5 semaines de vacances (6 dès 50 ans)  
De très bonnes prestations sociales  
Des projets porteurs de sens dans un contexte interculturel stimulant  
Le processus de recrutement en 3 étapes :  
Entretien avec le chef d'équipe et la chargée de recrutement  
Une mise en situation  
Une immersion dans l'équipe

Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette mission ? Nous avons hâte de découvrir votre candidature et de construire ensemble un avenir solidaire.

Notre priorité est d’assurer votre réussite sur le long terme, que vous soyez en recherche d’un poste fixe chez un client ou comme consultant au sein de notre équipe.  
Description du poste  
Dans le cadre d'un important programme de modernisation de son système d'information, notre client recherche un(e) Chef(fe) de Projet Technique Infrastructure / DevOps. Vous évoluerez au sein d'une Direction des Systèmes d'Information en charge d'applications critiques et de plateformes techniques à forte disponibilité. Ce poste s'adresse à un professionnel issu des métiers de l'infrastructure ou du DevOps ayant progressivement évolué vers la gestion de projets techniques. Votre rôle sera de coordonner les projets d'infrastructure, accompagner les équipes techniques dans leurs évolutions, participer aux choix d'architecture et contribuer à la modernisation des plateformes ainsi qu'à la réduction de la dette technologique. Vos responsabilités En lien avec les architectes, les ingénieurs DevOps, les équipes de développement et les partenaires infrastructure, vous aurez notamment pour missions de : Piloter des projets techniques liés aux infrastructures, aux plateformes DevOps et aux environnements d'exécution des applications. Organiser et coordonner l'ensemble des phases des projets : analyse, conception, planification, mise en œuvre, recette, déploiement et mise en production. Assurer la coordination entre les équipes Infrastructure, DevOps, Développement, Architecture et les fournisseurs. Participer aux travaux d'architecture technique et contribuer aux orientations des plateformes d'hébergement et de déploiement. Accompagner les projets de modernisation des infrastructures et piloter les actions de réduction de la dette technique et de gestion de l'obsolescence. Superviser les évolutions des plateformes OpenShift, Linux et des chaînes d'intégration et de déploiement continu. Veiller à la disponibilité, aux performances, à la sécurité et à la résilience des infrastructures techniques. Suivre les risques, les dépendances et les indicateurs de pilotage des projets. Participer à la définition des bonnes pratiques DevOps, d'automatisation et d'industrialisation. Contribuer aux plans de continuité d'activité, aux procédures d'exploitation ainsi qu'à la documentation technique. Assurer une veille technologique afin d'identifier les solutions permettant d'améliorer les performances, la sécurité et l'efficacité opérationnelle.  
Profil recherché  
Formation supérieure en informatique, systèmes d'information ou domaine équivalent. Minimum 5 années d'expérience en gestion de projets techniques ou d'infrastructure. Expérience préalable en tant qu'Ingénieur Infrastructure, Ingénieur Systèmes, DevOps ou Architecte Technique. Solide expérience des environnements OpenShift ou Kubernetes on\-premise. Bonne maîtrise des environnements Linux et de leur administration. Expérience des chaînes d'intégration et de déploiement continu (GitLab CI, Jenkins ou équivalent). Connaissance des outils d'automatisation et de gestion de configuration tels qu'Ansible ou Puppet. Bonne compréhension des architectures d'infrastructure, des réseaux, de la sécurité et des environnements de production. Capacité à piloter des projets impliquant plusieurs équipes techniques et partenaires externes. Expérience dans la coordination d'équipes techniques et de fournisseurs. Excellentes capacités d'analyse, de synthèse et d'organisation. Très bonne maîtrise du français. Une expérience sur tout ou partie des technologies suivantes constituera un véritable atout : Red Hat Enterprise Linux OpenShift / Kubernetes GitLab CI, Jenkins Ansible, Puppet, RunDeck SonarQube CheckMK Splunk Oracle Database, PostgreSQL, MySQL ElasticSearch RabbitMQ Déploiement et exploitation d'applications Java ou Perl Scripting (Python, Bash, Perl, Ruby…) Ce que Sigmalis vous offre Un plan de prévoyance (LPP) particulièrement avantageux, Une prime variable annuelle liée à la performance individuelle et aux résultats de l’entreprise, La possibilité d'être en télétravail jusqu’à 40 % et de prendre des vacances sans solde sous réserve d’accord client Des avantages spécifiques selon la mission (abonnement de transport public, formation, etc.) ﻿ Si vous vous reconnaissez dans ce profil, nous recevrons avec plaisir votre candidature qui doit comprendre votre cv ainsi que votre dossier complet (copies de diplômes, certificats de travail, etc…). jpiddf5358bjm jpit0833jm jpiy26jm

title: Compliance Officer - Sanctions
description:
Compliance Officer \- Sanctions  
Building the bank of tomorrow takes more than skills.  
It means combining our differences to imagine, discuss, code, develop, test, learn... and celebrate every step together. Share our vibes? Join Swissquote to unleash your potential.  
We are the Swiss Leader in Online Banking and we provide trading, investing and banking services to\+500'000 clients, through our performant and secured digital platforms.  
Our \+1000 employees work in a flexible way, without dress code and in multicultural teams.  
By having a huge impact on the industry, they are growing their skills portfolio and boosting their career in a fast\-pace environment.  
We are all in at Swissquote. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives to join our team and contribute to our shared success.  
Are you all in? Don't be shy, apply!  
Compliance Officer \- Sanctions  
Are you eager to take up a new challenge? Join the Compliance Department as a Compliance Officer in the Compliance Support and Sanctions service. You will have multiple tasks and on top of the sanction topics, you will be exposed to a wide range of Compliance activities on the financial security aspect. Your role will include:  
Sanctions:  
Perform sanctions due diligence on clients and related parties during the onboarding phases as well as periodic or ad hoc review phases.  
Perform analysis on true sanctions hits escalated by the Compliance Monitoring as part of the sanction screening done on the client base and on the transactional activity of our clients.  
Assess potential exposure to sectoral sanctions, export controls, dual\-use goods and sanctioned industries  
Provide recommendations regarding acceptance, rejection or escalation of client relationship  
Support and advise other compliance officers on sanction related topics  
Regulatory monitoring on sanction news impacting the bank and analysis of the impact on our client base, and analyse the impact of new sanctions packages.  
Draft and maintain sanctions policies and procedures.  
Participate in the calibration and optimization of sanctions screening systems.  
Reporting:  
Contribute to the bank's monitoring of risk tolerance, risk analysis and key risk indicators.  
Support ad hoc reporting requests: special requests, audits, regulatory reviews etc.  
Others:  
Provide targeted training on sanctions  
Drafting of internal memos and presentations  
Support and advice to management  
Qualifications  
Expert in Financial Sanction.  
Good knowledge in Swiss banking and financial laws.  
Analytical and methodological approach.  
Very good writing and communication skills in French and English (Other languages is a plus).  
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.  
Excellent command of Powerpoint.  
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage high workloads.  
Strong team player who enjoys working in multicultural, dynamic, technological and international environment.  
Background  
Bachelor or Master Degree in Laws or Economics with appetite for data crunching and analysis.  
3 to 5\+ years of experience in the financial industry.  
SQ2

Du bringst stilsicheres Deutsch und ösisch mit (beide Sprachen sehr gut in Wort und Schrift) – gute Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit einem ERP\-System. Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig, behältst auch bei mehreren Aufgaben den Überblick und schätzt den Kontakt mit Kunden und Lieferanten.  
Wir bieten dir

IDFL Europe AG is a leading provider of textile laboratory testing, auditing, and certification services serving brands, manufacturers, suppliers, recyclers, farms, and retailers throughout Europe. -Provide overall leadership and strategic direction for IDFL Europe AG.
-Manage laboratory testing operations specializing in down and feather testing.
-Direct auditing and certification operations across multiple international sustainability standards.
-Maintain compliance with ISO accreditation and certification requirements.
-Lead business development initiatives throughout Europe.
-Manage financial performance, budgeting, and operational planning.
-Supervise technical, laboratory, auditing, and administrative personnel.
-Coordinate with IDFL’s global offices to ensure consistent technical standards and customer service.
-Maintain relationships with international brands, manufacturers, certification bodies, and other key stakeholders.

Required Qualifications - Applicants must demonstrate:

-Bachelor’s degree in Textile Engineering, Textile Technology, Materials Science, Industrial Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Supply Chain Management, or a closely related discipline.
-Advanced postgraduate qualification (Master’s degree or equivalent) in business management, engineering, sustainability, quality management, or a related field.
-Minimum 10 years of professional experience within the textile testing, auditing, certification, or textile supply chain industry.
-Minimum 5 years of management experience leading technical or auditing teams across multiple countries.
-Demonstrated responsibility for operational, financial, and personnel management within an international organization.
-Qualification as a lead auditor for multiple internationally recognized textile sustainability standards.
-Demonstrated experience making certification decisions or managing certification programs under internationally recognized certification schemes.
-Experience managing auditing operations across multiple European countries.
-Technical knowledge of textile laboratory testing.
-Experience working with international textile brands, manufacturers, and supply chain organizations.
-Fluent English (written and spoken).

-Textile Exchange
-Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS)
-Forest Stewardship Council (FSC)
-Better Cotton
-Higg Facility Environmental Module (Higg FEM)
-Zero Discharge of Hazardous Chemicals (ZDHC)
-Downpass, EDFA and J-TAS

-Experience with down and feather product supply chains, including raw material sourcing, processing, manufacturing, quality assurance, traceability, and certification.

-Experience integrating laboratory testing with certification and auditing activities.
-Experience supporting ISO-accredited quality management systems.
-Experience working in multinational organizations with geographically distributed teams.

-Management position within an internationally recognized organization.
-Opportunity to lead a growing European business.
-International collaboration with technical experts across more than 20 countries.
-Competitive compensation package consistent with Swiss executive management positions.
-Long-term career development within a global organization.

Welcome to SMG Swiss Marketplace Group!  
SMG is a pioneering network of online marketplaces and a leading European digital company that simplifies people’s lives with forward\-looking products.

Job Description  
As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you'll be a hands\-on technical leader with company\-level impact across our Real Estate vertical. You’ll shape and evolve the frontend architecture powering our portals, create shared frontend solutions adopted by multiple teams, and orchestrate complex initiatives.  
Meet the team!  
At SMG, our strength lies in our people. Meet the Manager with whom you could work:  
Yuliya Zvolskaya \- Engineering Manager \- LinkedIn  
At a high level, you will:  
Set technical direction for frontend across multiple teams, building alignment among engineers, product managers, designers and senior stakeholders.  
Influence roadmaps, investment decisions, and engineering priorities by connecting frontend strategy to business outcomes, delivery risk and customer impact.  
Defining and driving the culture of engineering excellence, while leading the evolution of our Real Estate frontend architecture to support future requirements, setting and improving SLAs/SLOs and anticipating ripple effects across systems together with other engineers and principals.  
Act as a trusted technical leader across teams and locations for frontend topics, shaping how web experiences are built across our organisation and influencing decisions at both team and leadership levels.  
Represent frontend engineering in cross\-functional and leadership discussions, helping the organisation make better long\-term technical trade\-offs.  
Design and create shared frontend libraries, components and tooling (e.g. design system, performance monitoring) that are widely used by internal teams, focusing on pragmatic, reusable solutions and driving their adoption.  
Orchestrate multi\-system refactors and migrations like framework upgrades, cross\-product harmonisation.  
Mentor and coach other engineers through structured mentorship, pairing, and feedback, helping them grow their skills and closing skill gaps you observe in the organisation by organising structured trainings for our people.  
Model a healthy feedback culture, helping people navigate tough conversations and conflicts in a constructive, blameless way.  
Challenge and improve team and cross\-team processes, suggesting changes that improve focus, quality, and speed when needed.  
You’ll still write plenty of code, but your impact will be measured just as much by how you multiply the effectiveness of others as by your individual output.  
Your day\-to\-day  
You'll be part of a product team, splitting time about half and half between product delivery and staff responsibilities, depending on the current needs and priorities  
Innovate, design, implement, and deploy frontend\-focused engineering solutions for our products, from discovery to production.  
Build alignment across teams with different goals and constraints, and unblock progress on ambiguous, cross\-cutting initiatives. Step in to create clarity, momentum, and shared ownership when needed.  
Own the end\-to\-end technical vision for key user journeys like Homegate and Immoscout24 and more, with a strong focus on performance, accessibility, UX quality, and reliability  
Lead cross\-team frontend initiatives (for example: shared design system improvements, cross\-brand UI harmonisation, performance budgets, or observability patterns).  
Identify and surface cross\-cutting technical bottlenecks, such as performance drags in the core user journey or build\-time inefficiencies, and advocate for their resolution at the leadership level.  
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other engineering teams to shape technical strategy and trade\-offs for new features and platform work  
Partner with DevX to co\-develop engineering 'blueprints' and health scorecards, setting the gold standard for what 'good' looks like in our frontend repositories  
Evaluate, prototype, and introduce new frontend technologies and approaches (frameworks, tooling, patterns), document your findings, and drive adoption where they make sense  
Own and evolve the Frontend ADR process, ensuring technical decisions are documented, socialised, and consistently implemented across our organisation  
Guide and review the work of other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, guild, and informal coaching.  
Help the team embrace and leverage AI \& large language models in our engineering workflows and products  
Contribute to and facilitate the frontend guild, tech chats, and other cross\-team knowledge\-sharing formats  
Promote a culture of high\-quality engineering: testing, monitoring with Datadog, observability, security, and operational excellence  
Our Tech Stack  
You’ll work primarily on the frontend, while collaborating with fullstack engineers:  
Frontend: mainly and some React, both with TypeScript as the language of choice. We run a mix of client\-side, server\-side, pre\-rendered, and hybrid web apps  
Backend: and TypeScript, serverless and microservices architecture in a cloud\-based environment using AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, S3, and more)  
Monitoring \& Observability: Mainly Datadog plus logging/alerting best practices  
AI \& Tooling: We actively adopt the latest developments in AI technology and expect you to embrace innovation offered by large language models in your daily work  
Qualifications  
8\+ years of professional experience with the or similar frameworks  
Proven track record of implementing and maintaining automated frontend testing, using tools such as Jest, Vitest, and/or Cypress  
Experience collaborating with designers using Figma ()

Proven track record of senior technical leadership in a Staff, Lead, or equivalent role: leading complex cross\-team initiatives, aligning diverse stakeholders, influencing decisions without direct authority, and taking responsibility from strategy through rollout and iteration.  
Deep understanding of modern CI/CD for frontend, including automated release strategies and feature flagging in a microfrontend environment.  
Demonstrated experience creating and driving adoption of shared frontend solutions (e.g. design system components, shared libraries, cross\-cutting tooling)  
Demonstrated experience influencing multiple teams or an entire product area, including driving alignment, adoption, and durable technical change across various teams.  
Experience mentoring senior engineers or tech leads, and raising the technical bar through coaching, feedback, and role modelling.  
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with Engineering\- and Product leadership, as well as non\-technical partners.

Excellent English communication skills, spoken and written.  
You can explain complex topics clearly to different audiences in an international team setting  
We value engineers who:

We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.
Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.
Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF
Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?
At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.

Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.
As Philanthropy Advisor, you will secure and grow income from individual major donors in German-speaking Switzerland and Liechtenstein. You will manage a portfolio of assigned donors, build strong and lasting relationships, deepen their engagement with MSF’s social mission, and identify opportunities to increase their support. This includes organising meetings with MSF representatives, sharing relevant information on MSF projects and priorities, coordinating donor events and webinars, presenting funding opportunities, and directly soliciting financial contributions. title: Senior Associate – Treasury Strategy & Technology
description:
Shape the Future of Treasury. Lead with Innovation.

Treasury functions are undergoing a profound transformation. The convergence of advanced technology, artificial intelligence, and evolving financial landscapes is redefining how global organizations manage liquidity, mitigate risk, and drive strategic value. We're looking for an exceptional Senior Associate to help our clients navigate this transformation - someone who combines deep financial expertise with cutting-edge technology knowledge and a passion for innovation.

What You Can Expect From Us

- Strategic Advisory at the Highest Level: You will advise international corporations on complex treasury, financial risk management, and cash management challenges, with a specific focus on treasury technology, systems architecture, and digital transformation.
- Transformational Impact: You will help drive large-scale, multi-stakeholder transformation initiatives at global companies - reshaping how treasury functions operate, create value, and leverage technology.
- AI & Innovation Leadership: You will be at the forefront of applying artificial intelligence and machine learning to treasury and financial processes - from cash flow forecasting and liquidity optimization to fraud detection, risk modeling, and intelligent automation.
- Thought Leadership: You will provide thought leadership and practical, actionable advice on treasury strategy, financial risk management, regulatory compliance, and the evolving role of technology in finance.
- Efficiency & Value Creation: You will improve the added value, operational efficiency, internal controls, and regulatory compliance of clients' treasury functions and their supporting technology ecosystems.
- Collaborative Excellence: You will collaborate with a diverse, global network of highly talented experts across strategy, technology, risk, and finance - sharing knowledge and building innovative solutions together.
- Diverse, International Environment: You will work across multiple industries, service areas, and geographies in a dynamic and stimulating professional setting.

What We Expect From You

Experience & Qualifications
- 3 - 6 years of relevant professional experience in treasury consulting, treasury technology, financial risk management, or within a corporate treasury function with a strong systems and technology focus.
- University degree (Master's preferred) in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Financial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
- Professional certification such as CFA, FRM, CTP, or equivalent qualification, demonstrating deep expertise in financial analysis, accounting, and financial risk management.

Technical & Domain Expertise
- Deep financial analysis and risk management skills, including a strong understanding of financial instruments, hedge accounting, valuation methodologies, interest rate and FX risk, and treasury-related accounting standards (IFRS 9, etc.).
- In-depth, hands-on knowledge of at least one leading Treasury Management System (TMS) such as FIS (Quantum/Integrity), Kyriba, Coupa Treasury, ION (IT2/Wallstreet Suite), SAP Treasury, or similar - including implementation, configuration, and optimization experience.
- Familiarity with treasury processes and operations, including cash and liquidity management, bank relationship management, payments and bank connectivity (SWIFT, host-to-host), debt and investment management, and intercompany financing.
- Deep knowledge of the application of AI and machine learning to financial processes, including predictive analytics for cash forecasting, anomaly detection, natural language processing for financial data, robotic process automation (RPA), and the integration of intelligent solutions into treasury workflows.
- Understanding of the broader treasury technology ecosystem, including ERP integration, data architecture, API connectivity, cloud-based solutions, and emerging fintech platforms.

Personal & Professional Attributes
- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to synthesize complex financial, operational, and technical information into clear, compelling recommendations.
- Strong presentation and communication skills, with confidence and credibility when interacting with senior client stakeholders, including C-suite executives and treasury leadership.
- An advisory and team-oriented mindset - you take ownership of workstreams, mentor junior team members, foster innovative thinking, and contribute to a culture of excellence.
- Comfort working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, both independently and as part of cross-functional, international teams.
- Fluent English (written and spoken) is required; German, French, or any additional language is a strong plus.
- A commitment to expanding our global business network and leveraging your personal and professional relationships to create opportunities and deepen client trust.

Why This Role?
This is not just a consulting role - it's an opportunity to sit at the intersection of finance and technology during one of the most exciting periods of transformation in corporate treasury. You will work on challenges that matter, with people who inspire, for clients who are shaping the global economy.

title: HR Generalist, EMEA
description:

vVARDIS is a Swiss\-based oral health company founded by Dr. Haleh and Dr. Golnar Abivardi, dentists, innovators, and award\-winning entrepreneurs. vVARDIS is the result of a combined 30 years of dental and entrepreneurial experience, and 20 years of laboratory and clinical research paired with the creative vision of its founders.  
At vVARDIS, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions that enhance oral health and well\-being, inspired by the vision of our founders to foster preventive rather than reparative dentistry. At the heart of our Company lies its patented, revolutionary biomimetic peptide technology. Scientifically proven in over 200 publications, this unique technology can treat early caries through enamel regeneration, like no other technology can do, offering a non\-invasive, pain\-free solution for patients of all ages. We offer a number of oral health products targeting dental professionals and their patients, as well as consumers, all based on our proprietary technology.  
We value our people and believe in fostering a positive and collaborative work environment, based on our core values of innovation, excellence, integrity, and empathy.  
We are located in Zug, Switzerland, with operations across Europe and the US. Join us on this exciting journey!  
Position Overview  
We are seeking a hands\-on HR Generalist to support the Director Human Resources in the day\-to\-day HR operations across our EMEA markets, starting with Switzerland, the UK, and Italy, and expanding as the company grows. This is a generalist role suited to someone who builds and improves processes rather than simply administering them — you'd rather fix a broken process than complain about it. You're comfortable holding direct, constructive conversations with managers when needed, while remaining approachable and collaborative.  
The role also includes acting as payroll deputy for the UK, Switzerland, and Italy, ensuring continuity when the primary contact for our external payroll providers is unavailable. The role reports directly to the Director, Human Resources, with close day\-to\-day collaboration on HR and payroll matters. We work mostly from the office — 60% a week on site, 40% remote.  
Key Responsibilities  
Payroll Deputy — UK, Switzerland \& Italy: Act as back\-up for payroll processing across the three countries, maintaining accurate documentation and liaising with external payroll providers and authorities as required.  
HR Operations \& Process Building: Build and continuously improve core HR processes (onboarding, leave, records, policies) and maintain accurate, compliant personnel records across our EMEA locations. Some of this still needs to be built from the ground up — you're comfortable turning a blank page into a working process.  
Employee Relations \& Manager Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for employees and managers on HR matters, mediate disputes and handle grievances fairly, and promote a respectful, open workplace culture.  
Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment: Manage end\-to\-end recruitment — job postings, sourcing, interviewing, offers, and onboarding — in close collaboration with hiring managers.  
Performance Management: Run a simple, effective performance review process and coach managers on delivering direct, fair feedback.  
Compensation \& Benefits: Support payroll processing with our external providers and administer employee benefits across EMEA, helping define pay structures that are fair, competitive, and easy to administer.  
Compliance \& HR Best Practices: Ensure compliance with employment law across the UK, Switzerland, Italy, and other EMEA markets, escalating regulatory changes and labor law challenges to external counsel where needed.  
Training \& Development: Organize onboarding and practical, ongoing learning support for employee development.  
Qualifications \& Skills  
Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience.  
3–5 years in an HR generalist or HR Manager role, ideally within a scale\-up or fast\-growing organization.  
Practical knowledge of payroll and employment law fundamentals in at least one of the UK, Switzerland, or Italy — you don't need to be a lawyer or payroll specialist, but you know when to bring one in.  
Proven ability to build and improve HR processes from the ground up.  
A clear, calm communicator who remains professional and approachable, including in demanding situations.  
Fluent in English and German and/or Italian an advantage given our presence in Switzerland and Italy.  
Proficient with HR/payroll software and HRIS tools.  
vVARDIS is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons.

Du entwickelst ein neu entstehendes DevOps Team aktiv mit und bringst deine Ideen für langfristig tragfähige Lösungen ein.

Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im DevOps oder DevOps\-nahen Umfeld  
Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder entsprechende Berufserfahrung (du kommst entweder aus der Softwareentwicklung und hast dich in Richtung DevOps entwickelt oder du bringst einen Infrastruktur\-Background mit starkem DevOps\-Engineering Verständnis mit)

Du gestaltest gerne mit und bringst deine Ideen ein  
Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem noch nicht alles abschliessend definiert ist, und gehst Themen proaktiv, analytisch und lösungsorientiert an.

Take responsibility for modules within the MSc Midwifery programme. You will design, plan, deliver, evaluate and ensure the quality of profession\-specific and interprofessional modules. To that end, you will develop scientifically sound module objectives, teaching content, didactic formats and assessment methods at EQF level 7\.  
Teach classes in the MSc Midwifery programme and, where required, in the BSc Midwifery. You will systematically integrate the latest research findings, blended learning, e\-learning and the considered use of artificial intelligence into your teaching and learning environments.  
Provide expert guidance to students on their master's theses, develope and evaluate assessments, and conduct resit examinations in accordance with the applicable quality and AI guidelines.  
Support the programme director in the strategic, organisational, curricular and didactic development of the MSc Midwifery programme. You will contribute to the further development of module curricula, quality assurance and AI integration, and actively represent the programme within the professional community.  
Your profile  
You hold a PhD in midwifery, psychology, health sciences, social sciences or a related field. Your scientific expertise focuses on midwifery care and/or sexual and reproductive health.  
You have successfully developed, secured funding for, conducted and led research projects, and are experienced in project planning, coordination and implementation.  
You have proven expertise in quantitative research methods and confidently apply health or social science methods, with nuance and a strong commitment to quality.  
You have experience in higher education teaching, ideally at master's level, and have completed a continuing education qualification in higher education didactics or a comparable qualification.  
The following would be advantageous:  
A recognised midwifery qualification as well as a sound understanding of the field's professional practice and current challenges facing the profession.  
Several years of professional experience as a midwife or other relevant professional experience outside the higher education sector.  
Enthusiasm for creatively developing and implementing innovative research projects, teaching formats and sustainable solutions.  
Experience in inter\- and transdisciplinary collaboration, as well as the willingness to productively combine different profession\-specific and practice\-based perspectives.  
This is what we stand for  
Zurich University of Applied Sciences ZHAW is one of Switzerland's largest multidisciplinary universities of applied sciences, with over 14'000 students and 3'400 faculty and staff.  
The ZHAW School of Health Sciences is one of the largest and most renowned centres for education and continuing professional development for health professions in the German\-speaking countries. More than 2,000 students and 300 employees benefit from unique degree and continuing education programmes as well as attractive job opportunities in teaching and research in the heart of Winterthur (Canton of Zurich).  
The Midwifery Research Unit promotes quality in obstetrics and midwifery through applied research and development projects by focusing on the best possible care for women, children and families during pregnancy and childbirth, the postpartum period and breastfeeding. We train midwives as well as the next generation of researchers, and develop innovative, sustainable solutions to ensure the delivery of high\-quality, patient\-centered and evidence\-based care by midwives and interprofessional teams. Another focus area is the promotion of sexual and reproductive health among the population.  
ZHAW is committed to gender\-mixed and diverse teams in order to promote equality, diversity and innovation.  
What you can expect  
We offer working conditions and terms of employment commensurate with higher education institutions and actively promote personal development for staff in leadership and non\-leadership positions. title: Senior Scientist Electronic Laboratory Systems (M&W)
description:
**As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day: enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.**

**We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, including protecting the environment, ensuring food safety, and helping find cures for cancer.**


**Job Description:**

**Join our Quality Control team at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where you will make meaningful contributions to our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.**

**As an Senior Scientist Electronic Laboratory Systems, you will perform technical support activities and validation exercise to ensure product quality in a GMP-regulated environment. You will work with analytical equipment and electronic laboratory systems, supporting the qualification, validation, operation, and lifecycle management of QC systems and applications.**


**Key Responsibilities:**

- Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot analytical laboratory equipment and electronic laboratory systems.
- Support qualification of analytical equipment and computerized system validation activities for QC laboratory systems.
- Generate, review, and maintain GxP documentation throughout the lifecycle of QC systems, equipment, and applications.
- Evaluate analytical data, document results accurately, and ensure compliance with applicable quality standards.
- Support investigations related to out-of-specification, out-of-expectation, deviations, change controls, and corrective and preventive actions.
- Provide timely technical support to QC laboratory units to ensure reliable laboratory operations.
- Support inspection and audit readiness activities, including gap assessments, remediation actions, and participation in customer or health authority inspections as needed.
- Contribute to the implementation of automated data flows, laboratory process improvements, and Practical Process Improvement initiatives.
- Support data integrity expectations by ensuring reliable, complete, accurate, and compliant laboratory records.
- Collaborate with Quality, Manufacturing, Manufacturing Science and Technology, Supply Chain, Maintenance and Facilities, Procurement, IT, and global laboratory systems teams.
- Adhere to cGMP, quality, EHSS, and site procedures.
- Actively contribute to continuous quality improvement, safety initiatives, deviation reporting, and near-miss follow-up.
- Demonstrate Thermo Fisher Scientific values through accountability, ethical behavior, customer focus, intellectual curiosity, and collaboration.

**Required Qualifications:**

- BSc or MSc in Lifes Sciences (Chemistry, Biochemistry, Physics, Microbiology or equivalent)
- Or IT/Automation background with strong knowledge and experience in the pharma industry
- Strong knowledge of GMP regulations, quality systems, and laboratory compliance requirements.
- Significant experience in a laboratory environment, experience in IT (Programming or Database)
- Computerized System Validation (CSV) and pharma industry Experience in Lab execution Systems as SM LIMS, Chromeleon, Lab X, Empower, etc. is a benefit
- Demonstrated ability to analyze data and support investigations of out-of-specification or atypical results.
- Strong documentation skills and ability to follow written and verbal procedures accurately.
- Familiarity with laboratory information management systems and electronic laboratory systems.
- Knowledge of relevant regulatory standards, including ISO, FDA, USP, and EP expectations.
- Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

title: Client Relations Manager
description:
Client Relations Manager  
At NEOVIVA, we believe that recovery is a journey best taken with dignity, skill, and genuine human connection. As a premium Private Recovery Clinic specialising in addiction and affective disorders, our mission is to help English\-speaking clients from Switzerland and across the globe regain their health and purpose. Located on the serene shores of Lake Lucerne, we offer a workplace defined by emotional safety and mutual respect. Here, helping others isn't just a job—it’s deeply personal.  
We currently have a vacancy for a Client Relations Manager 100% (onsite) to start immediately or by arrangement.  
Your profile  
Experience in healthcare, ideally within the mental health sector.  
You take pride in an unbiased, client\-centred and quality\-focused approach.  
An empathetic and caring personality with strong listening skills — helping others is your calling.  
Equally motivated by individual achievement and interdisciplinary teamwork, always with the best interests of our clients and the company in mind.  
A self\-starter who is never satisfied with the status quo, with a curious mindset, a willingness to explore new approaches, and a commitment to going the extra mile.  
Open\-minded, socially competent and appreciative in your interactions, with the ability to work effectively with international clients from diverse cultural backgrounds.  
Strong networking, relationship\-building and communication skills.  
Excellent command of English (C2 professional proficiency); additional languages are a plus.  
Eligible to work in Switzerland (Swiss nationality or EU/EFTA citizenship).  
Your responsibilities  
Respond to and follow up on enquiries from potential clients by phone or email in a timely and professional manner.  
Identify prospective clients’ needs and provide information, guidance and support to address their concerns.  
Coordinate with referring partners, partner hospitals and other services.  
Actively re\-engage prospects and reconnect with passive leads.  
Exercise sound judgement when handling complex client requests while remaining flexible, compassionate and non\-judgemental.  
Manage the admission, onboarding and discharge process in collaboration with the multidisciplinary team.  
Prepare proposals, quotations and invoices.  
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, their families, referring professionals and business partners.  
Maintain accurate records of all client\-related activities in the CRM system and manage databases of prospective, current and former clients, referring parties and business partners.  
Provide regular reports to management.  
Your application  
We are a young, dynamic company with a modern, forward\-thinking approach and at an exceptional working environment overlooking Lake Lucerne. You will have the opportunity to play a key role in the growth of an innovative treatment concept while making a meaningful difference in the lives of our clients and their families.  
Please send your application (CV with a photo, motivation letter in English and relevant diplomas) in English to Klaysner Fonseca, Head of Client more information visit us at . jpidaa1fa1djm jit0832jm jiy26jm

title: NGS Sales Specialist
description:
NGS Sales Specialist (m/f/d \| 100%)  
NGS Sales Specialist (m/f/d \| 100%)  
Are you ready to use innovation to improve the lives of millions of people?  
Do you think one step ahead, see opportunities where others see limits, and want to invest your energy in something meaningful? If so, INTEGRA is the right place for you.  
Our solutions are not created by chance – they are the result of passion, precision and team spirit. With every technology we develop, we help people around the world to research diseases, perform diagnoses and enable new therapies. Whether in diagnostics, research or quality control, our instruments – made in Switzerland and the USA – make laboratory work safer, more efficient and more sustainable.  
With us, you can make changes that will shape the world.  
Does this sound like what you're looking for? Then join our team and help to accelerate scientific discovery.  
What you can expect from the role  
Are you passionate about genomics and driven by results? As an NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) Sales Specialist, you’ll be at the forefront of advancing genomic research and clinical diagnostics. This isn’t just a sales role—it’s an opportunity to make a real impact in science and healthcare.  
Drive sales growth in select locations by executing strategic plans and expanding market share.  
Identify and develop opportunities through networking, events, campaigns, and direct outreach.  
Build strong relationships with researchers, lab directors, and key decision\-makers.  
Deliver impactful presentations, demos, and training to showcase NGS solutions.  
Manage the full sales cycle and maintain accurate CRM records.  
Provide hands\-on support for installations, troubleshooting, and post\-sales service.  
Collaborate with internal teams to enhance customer experience and influence product development.  
Stay ahead of NGS trends and share insights to guide innovation and strategy.  
What you offer  
Education: Bachelor's degree in molecular biology or related field (MS/PhD preferred).  
Experience: Minimum of 3 to 5 years with molecular biology techniques and NGS applications.  
Strong technical knowledge of NGS workflows and data interpretation.  
Proven sales or commercial experience in Life Sciences (preferred).  
Excellent communication, presentation, and time management skills.  
Self\-driven, collaborative, and able to work independently.  
Willing to travel extensively (\+ 50%, including overnight stays).  
Why choose INTEGRA / Your benefits  
Your new working environment – INTEGRA Campus  
Welcome to our brand new company campus in Zizers – 30,000 m² of concentrated high tech power and sustainability with a panoramic view of the Alps. The building envelope, solar panel installations and smart climate\-controlled system are designed to minimize our ecological footprint.  
What you can look forward to  
State\-of\-the\-art workspaces – light\-flooded rooms, ergonomic workstations and think tanks for creative brainstorming, all with a view of the Grisons Alps.  
La Pipetta – our in\-house restaurant – offers fresh, discounted meals every day. When the sun is shining, the large terrace is the perfect place to refuel.  
Easy commute – only 3 minutes from the A13 with free parking, direct connection to public transit and e\-charging stations. jpid9323a71jm jit0832jm jiy26jm

title: Lab Technician
description:
Lab Technician (GMP Analytics) (f/m/d)  
Lab Technician (GMP Analytics) (f/m/d)  
Work locaction: Kaiseraugst \| Workload: 100% \| Contract time: temporary Long\-term temporary employment with the option of a permanent position  
Who we are  
Solvias is an internationally recognized provider of integrated solutions for contract research. With its headquarters in Kaiseraugst near Basel, more than 500 highly qualified employees are proud to place science at the heart of customer service, helping to bring safe and high?quality products to market faster.  
At Solvias, we serve the world’s leading pharmaceutical innovators. That offers you the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the health of patients worldwide, working with brilliant scientists in a fast\-moving environment filled with stimulating challenges.  
Description of your role  
We are searching laboratory technicians to support analytical testing across multiple scientific teams (e.g., biologics, small molecules, parenterals, advanced therapies). This role offers the opportunity to work with a wide range of analytical techniques and to be deployed flexibly based on business needs and development opportunities.  
Your tasks  
Execute analytical testing in a GMP\-regulated laboratory environment  
Perform sample preparation, measurement, data evaluation, and documentation  
Ensure accurate and compliant data recording in LIMS and laboratory systems  
Support analytical development and quality control of new therapies (e.g., biologics, small molecules, parenterals, advanced therapies)  
Take responsibility for laboratory equipment (operation, maintenance, troubleshooting)  
Collaborate with scientists and peers across different analytical domains  
Our requirements  
Laboratory technician (EFZ/CTA/BTA) or equivalent scientific training  
First experience in a GMP or regulated environment is an advantage  
Experience with one or more of the following analytical techniques preferably under GMP  
Chromatography: HPLC, UPLC, SEC / AF4\-MALS  
Capillary Electrophoresis: CE\-SDS, cIEF, CZE  
Spectroscopy: UV/Vis, Fluorescence, IR, CD, nanoDSC  
Particle \& Imaging Techniques: Light obscuration, micro\-flow imaging (MFI), optical microscopy, SEM/EDX  
Biophysical / Molecular Characterization: DLS, AUC  
Mass Spectrometry (basic exposure desirable)  
Compendial / Physicochemical Testing: Osmolality, CCIT (e.g., vacuum/pressure decay, headspace analysis), clarity/color, pH or other compendial (Ph. Eur./USP) tests  
Fluent in English, German is a plus  
Structured, reliable, and detail\-oriented execution  
Ability to work independently while collaborating in teams  
High level of ownership and accountability  
Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and domains  
What we offer  
Fair and market?competitive compensation  
Opportunity for a permanent position, depending on mutual fit and business development  
State?of?the?art infrastructure at a modern work location  
Excellent staff restaurant offering high quality meals at fair prices  
Flat hierarchies and a collaborative and international working environment
